AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless workflow using Step Functions to send custom events to a custom EventBridge bus, with a rule forwarding all events to CloudWatch Logs.'
Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CustomEventBus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  CustomEventLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${AWS::StackName}-CustomEventBus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  CustomEventLogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: EventBridgeToLogsPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {
                    "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
                  },
                  "Action": [
                    "logs:CreateLogStream",
                    "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "${CustomEventLogGroupArn}",
                  "Condition": {
                    "ArnEquals": {
                      "aws:SourceArn": "${CustomEventBusArn}"
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - CustomEventLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CustomEventLogGroup.Arn
            CustomEventBusArn: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  CustomEventBusRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn:
      - CustomEventLogPolicy
    Properties:
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ''
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt CustomEventLogGroup.Arn
          Id: LogGroupTarget

  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsPutEventsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  CustomEventStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StateMachine'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "StartAt": "SendCustomEvent",
              "States": {
                "SendCustomEvent": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:eventbridge:putEvents",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "Entries": [
                      {
                        "EventBusName": "${CustomEventBusArn}",
                        "Source": "my.custom.source",
                        "DetailType": "CustomEvent",
                        "Detail": "{\"key1\": \"value1\", \"key2\": \"value2\"}"
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  "End": true
                }
              }
            }
          - CustomEventBusArn: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Resources:
  CustomActionType:
    Type: AWS::CodePipeline::CustomActionType
    Properties:
      Category: Deploy
      Provider: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Version: "1"
      ConfigurationProperties:
        - Name: Deploy-Bucket
          Required: true
          Key: false
          Secret: false
          Type: String
        - Name: OpsWorks-Stack-ID
          Required: true
          Key: false
          Secret: false
          Type: String
        - Name: OpsWorks-App-ID
          Required: true
          Key: true
          Secret: false
          Type: String
      InputArtifactDetails:
        MaximumCount: 1
        MinimumCount: 1
      OutputArtifactDetails:
        MaximumCount: 0
        MinimumCount: 0

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CustomActionJobWorkerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:PollForJobs
                  - codepipeline:GetJobDetails
                  - codepipeline:PutJobSuccessResult
                  - codepipeline:PutJobFailureResult
                  - opsworks:CreateDeployment
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          codepipeline = boto3.client('codepipeline')
          opsworks = boto3.client('opsworks')

          PROVIDER_NAME = os.environ.get('PROVIDER_NAME')
          CATEGORY = os.environ.get('CATEGORY', 'Deploy')
          VERSION = os.environ.get('VERSION', '1')

          def process_job(job_id, config):
              deploy_bucket = config.get('Deploy-Bucket')
              stack_id = config.get('OpsWorks-Stack-ID')
              app_id = config.get('OpsWorks-App-ID')

              logger.info(f'Processing job {job_id}: Deploy-Bucket={deploy_bucket}, Stack={stack_id}, App={app_id}')

              # Deploy to OpsWorks
              response = opsworks.create_deployment(
                  StackId=stack_id,
                  AppId=app_id,
                  Command={'Name': 'deploy'}
              )
              logger.info(f'Deployment created: {response["DeploymentId"]}')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  response = codepipeline.poll_for_jobs(
                      actionTypeId={
                          'category': CATEGORY,
                          'owner': 'Custom',
                          'provider': PROVIDER_NAME,
                          'version': VERSION
                      },
                      maxBatchSize=10,
                      queryParam={}
                  )
                  jobs = response.get('jobs', [])
                  logger.info(f'Found {len(jobs)} jobs')
                  for job in jobs:
                      job_id = job['id']
                      config = job['data']['actionConfiguration']['configuration']
                      try:
                          process_job(job_id, config)
                          codepipeline.put_job_success_result(jobId=job_id)
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.error(f'Job {job_id} failed: {str(e)}')
                          codepipeline.put_job_failure_result(
                              jobId=job_id,
                              failureDetails={
                                  'type': 'JobFailed',
                                  'message': str(e)
                              }
                          )
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f'Error polling jobs: {str(e)}')
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PROVIDER_NAME: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
          CATEGORY: 'Deploy'
          VERSION: '1'

  LambdaPermissionForEvents:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt ScheduleRule.Arn

  ScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(1 minute)'
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
          Id: LambdaTarget

  DbUsernameParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:GetParameter
                Resource:
                  !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/dbUsername'

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:

          import boto3

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "EFS-Subnet2-${AWS::StackName}"

  EfsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 2049
      ToPort: 2049
      CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  EfsKmsKey:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Serverless workflow to monitor EC2 instance state changes and trigger Step Functions with business logic placeholders"

Resources:
  # Log group for Step Functions execution logs
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/stepfunctions/${AWS::StackName}-EC2StateMachine"
      RetentionInDays: 7

  # IAM role for Step Functions execution (allows logging and basic execution)
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"

  # IAM role for EventBridge to invoke Step Functions
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeStepFunctions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  # Step Functions state machine (STANDARD type) with logging and placeholders
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DependsOn:
      - StateMachineExecutionRole
      - StateMachineLogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "EC2 instance state change workflow",
          "StartAt": "ClassifyState",
          "States": {
            "ClassifyState": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "running",
                  "Next": "RunningPlaceholder"
                },
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "stopped",
                  "Next": "StoppedPlaceholder"
                },
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "terminated",
                  "Next": "TerminatedPlaceholder"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "DefaultPlaceholder"
            },
            "RunningPlaceholder": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Business logic for running state goes here",
              "Result": {"action": "running", "status": "placeholder"},
              "End": true
            },
            "StoppedPlaceholder": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Business logic for stopped state goes here",
              "Result": {"action": "stopped", "status": "placeholder"},
              "End": true
            },
            "TerminatedPlaceholder": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Business logic for terminated state goes here",
              "Result": {"action": "terminated", "status": "placeholder"},
              "End": true
            },
            "DefaultPlaceholder": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Unhandled state - review event pattern",
              "Result": {"action": "unhandled", "status": "placeholder"},
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  # EventBridge rule on default event bus for EC2 state changes
  EC2StateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
            - stopped
            - terminated
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          Id: StepFunctionTarget

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Step Functions state machine"
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  EventRuleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the EventBridge rule"
    Value: !GetAtt EC2StateChangeRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create S3 bucket, Glue database, and Glue crawler for CloudTrail logs."
Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudtrail
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
  DBBaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudtrail
Resources:
  GlueRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-${Environment}-glue-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
  BucketKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
  Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref BucketKmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
  BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Join
              - ''
              - - 'arn:aws:s3:::'
                - !Ref Bucket
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Join
              - ''
              - - 'arn:aws:s3:::'
                - !Ref Bucket
                - '/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'
  GlueRoleS3Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: S3AccessForGlue
      Roles:
        - !Ref GlueRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Join
              - ''
              - - 'arn:aws:s3:::'
                - !Ref Bucket
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Join
              - ''
              - - 'arn:aws:s3:::'
                - !Ref Bucket
                - '/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: kms:Decrypt
            Resource: !GetAtt BucketKmsKey.Arn
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub "${DBBaseName}-kk-admin-db"
  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-${Environment}-crawler"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Targets:
        S3Targets:

          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-public-2'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-igw'

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-public-rt'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  Subnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Security groups
  AlbSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the ALB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-alb-sg'

  EcsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8000
          ToPort: 8000
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AlbSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-ecs-sg'

  # ECS Cluster
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Ref ServiceName

  # Task Definition
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${ServiceName}-task'
      Cpu: '1024'  # 1 vCPU
      Memory: '2048'  # 2 GB
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Sub 'public.ecr.aws/aws-samples/hello-app-runner:${ImageTag}'
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 8000
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  # IAM role for task execution (required for Fargate)
  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  # CloudWatch Log Group
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  # Internal Application Load Balancer (shortened name)
  LoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ServiceName}-a'
      Scheme: internal
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: idle_timeout.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref AlbSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-alb'

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ServiceName}-tg'
      Port: 8000
      Protocol: HTTP
      TargetType: ip
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckPort: '8000'
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: '200'

  # Self-signed certificate for ALB HTTPS listener
  SelfSignedCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName

  Listener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Port: 443
      Protocol: HTTPS
      SslPolicy: ELB-SecurityPolicy-2016-08
      Certificates:
        - CertificateArn: !Ref SelfSignedCertificate
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  # ECS Service
  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - Listener
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: 1
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PublicSubnet1
            - !Ref PublicSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref EcsSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: 8000
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 0
        MaximumPercent: 100

  # WebACL for CloudFront (WAFv2)
  WebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ServiceName}-webacl'
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        MetricName: HelloAppRunnerWebACL
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true

  # CloudFront distribution to provide public HTTPS access
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_All
        Comment: !Sub 'CloudFront distribution for ${ServiceName}'
        Origins:
          - Id: ALBOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: ALBOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          MinTTL: 0
          MaxTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 0
        Aliases: []
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn

    Description: The public endpoint URL of the hello-app-runner service.
    Value: !Join ['', ['https://', !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName]]

        - PolicyName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-UnauthenticatedPolicy

              - Effect: Allow

                  - lex:PostText
                  - translate:TranslateText
                  - comprehend:DetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:DetectEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:DetectDominantLanguage
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectEntities
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectDominantLanguage

        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:

    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ChatbotIdentityPool

Description: "Core event-driven architecture for retail demo store - EventBridge custom bus, logging, archive, schema discovery, and SSM parameter."

Resources:
  # IAM Role for the Lambda that creates/deletes the event bus (with robust cleanup)
  CreateBusLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateBusPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:CreateEventBus
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:DescribeEventBus
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:DeleteEventBus
                  - events:ListRules
                  - events:ListTargetsByRule
                  - events:RemoveTargets
                  - events:DeleteRule
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/retaildemostore-bus"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:DeleteArchive
                  - events:DescribeArchive
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:archive/retaildemostore-bus-archive"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # Lambda function to create/delete the event bus with stuck-deletion handling
  CreateBusFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CreateBusLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import time
          import boto3

          BUS_NAME = 'retaildemostore-bus'
          ARCHIVE_NAME = 'retaildemostore-bus-archive'

          def send_response(event, context, status, data, physical_id):
              response_body = {

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Cognito User Pool and Identity Pool for Kibana/Elasticsearch authentication."

Resources:
  # Cognito User Pool: KibanaUsers
  KibanaUsers:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: KibanaUsers
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  # Cognito User Pool Client
  KibanaUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: KibanaAppClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref KibanaUsers
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # Cognito Identity Pool
  KibanaIDPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: KibanaIDPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !Sub "cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${KibanaUsers}"
          ClientId: !Ref KibanaUserPoolClient

  # Authenticated IAM Role
  CognitoKibanaAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CognitoKibanaAuthenticatedRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref KibanaIDPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KibanaESAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - es:ESHttp*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:es:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*"

  # Unauthenticated IAM Role (deny-all)
  CognitoKibanaUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CognitoKibanaUnauthenticatedRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref KibanaIDPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DenyAll
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Deny

                Resource: "*"

  # Identity Pool Role Attachment

    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for a Step Functions standard workflow that puts
  and gets an item from a DynamoDB table (testing purposes).
Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-table
    Description: Name for the DynamoDB table.
Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
  StepFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "Comment": "Step Functions workflow to put and get item from DynamoDB",
              "StartAt": "PutItem",
              "States": {
                "PutItem": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:putItem",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "TableName": "${TableName}",
                    "Item": {
                      "id": {"S.$": "$.id"},
                      "description": {"S.$": "States.Format('Formatted description for {}', $.id)"}
                    }
                  },
                  "Next": "GetItem"
                },
                "GetItem": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:getItem",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "TableName": "${TableName}",
                    "Key": {
                      "id": {"S.$": "$.id"}
                    }
                  },
                  "ResultPath": "$.getItemResult",
                  "Next": "ReturnItem"
                },
                "ReturnItem": {
                  "Type": "Pass",
                  "InputPath": "$.getItemResult.Item",
                  "End": true
                }
              }
            }
          - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  ExecutionRoleArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Chaos Engineering Workflow: terminate EC2 instance, wait, check ECS service health, alert via SNS'

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: ChaosTest
    Description: Prefix for resource names
  AMIID:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized_ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended
    Description: Amazon ECS-optimized AMI ID from SSM (resolves per region)

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-VPC

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-PublicRT

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Subnet
  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-Subnet

  # Security Group
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-SG

  # IAM Role for EC2
  EC2RoleForECS:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-EC2Role

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2RoleForECS

  # EC2 Instance with public IP via NetworkInterfaces
  EC2Instance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIID
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref InstanceProfile
      NetworkInterfaces:
        - AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
          DeviceIndex: 0
          SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
          GroupSet:
            - !Ref SecurityGroup
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: !Sub |
          #!/bin/bash
          echo ECS_CLUSTER=${AppName}-Cluster >> /etc/ecs/ecs.config
          systemctl enable --now ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-Instance

  # ECS Cluster
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${AppName}-Cluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-Cluster

  # ECS Task Definition
  ECSTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${AppName}-Task
      NetworkMode: bridge
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: nginx
          Image: nginx:latest
          Memory: 256
          Cpu: 256
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp

  # ECS Service
  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: EC2Instance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${AppName}-Service
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ECSTaskDefinition
      LaunchType: EC2
      DesiredCount: 1

  # KMS Key for SNS
  SNSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SNS topic encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-SNSKey

  # SNS Topic
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub ${AppName}-AlertTopic
      DisplayName: !Sub ${AppName} ECS Health Alert
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SNSKey.Arn

  # IAM Role for Termination Lambda
  TerminateLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerminateInstancePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/${EC2Instance}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AppName}-TerminateInstance*

  # Termination Lambda
  TerminateLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-TerminateInstance
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt TerminateLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              instance_id = event['instance_id']
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              return {'status': 'terminated', 'instance_id': instance_id}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-TerminateLambda

  # IAM Role for HealthCheck Lambda
  HealthCheckLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: HealthCheckPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:service/${ECSCluster}/${ECSService}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt SNSKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AppName}-HealthCheck*

  # HealthCheck Lambda
  HealthCheckLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-HealthCheck
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt HealthCheckLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              cluster = event['cluster']
              service = event['service']
              topic_arn = event['topic_arn']
              ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
              sns = boto3.client('sns')
              response = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service])
              service_desc = response['services'][0]
              running = service_desc['runningCount']
              desired = service_desc['desiredCount']
              if running < desired:
                  message = f"Service {service} is unhealthy. Running: {running}, Desired: {desired}"
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=topic_arn, Message=message, Subject='ECS Service Health Alert')
                  return {'status': 'unhealthy', 'alert_sent': True}
              else:
                  return {'status': 'healthy'}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-HealthCheckLambda

  # Step Functions State Machine
  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub ${AppName}-ChaosWorkflow
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Comment": "Chaos Engineering Workflow",
              "StartAt": "TerminateInstance",
              "States": {
                "TerminateInstance": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "${TerminateLambdaArn}",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "instance_id.$": "$.instance_id"
                  },
                  "Next": "Wait"
                },
                "Wait": {
                  "Type": "Wait",
                  "Seconds": 300,
                  "Next": "CheckHealth"
                },
                "CheckHealth": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "${HealthCheckLambdaArn}",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "cluster.$": "$.cluster",
                    "service.$": "$.service",
                    "topic_arn.$": "$.topic_arn"
                  },
                  "End": true
                }
              }
            }
          - TerminateLambdaArn: !GetAtt TerminateLambda.Arn
            HealthCheckLambdaArn: !GetAtt HealthCheckLambda.Arn

  # IAM Role for State Machine
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateLambda.Arn
                  - !GetAtt HealthCheckLambda.Arn
        - PolicyName: CreateLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: '*'

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, os, json

          def handler(event, context):

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Lambda-based CI/CD deployment environment using CodeDeploy blue/green traffic
  shifting with automated pre-traffic and post-traffic validation hooks.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: lambdacicd
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9]{2,19}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 3-20 characters, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only
      lowercase alphanumeric characters.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9]{1,7}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 2-8 characters, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only
      lowercase alphanumeric characters.
  LogLevel:
    Type: String
    Default: INFO
    AllowedValues:
      - DEBUG
      - INFO
      - WARNING
      - ERROR

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key for the artifact bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt CodeDeploy deployment artifacts.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Artifact bucket for CodeDeploy revisions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}-artifacts
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main (deployment target) Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-main
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  MainFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-main-lambda-role
      Description: Execution role for the blue/green deployment target function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  MainFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-main
      Description: Blue/green deployment target function managed by CodeDeploy.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures:
        - x86_64
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt MainFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
          LOG_LEVEL: !Ref LogLevel
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: Text
        LogGroup: !Ref MainFunctionLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os


          def handler(event, context):
              """Deployment target handler for the blue/green pipeline."""
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps(
                      {
                          "message": "Hello from the blue/green deployment target",
                          "environment": os.environ.get("ENVIRONMENT", "unknown"),
                          "logLevel": os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"),
                          "event": event,
                      }
                  ),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  MainFunctionVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      Description: !Sub Immutable version of ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-main retained for rollback.

  MainFunctionAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    UpdatePolicy:
      CodeDeployLambdaAliasUpdate:
        ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
        DeploymentGroupName: !Ref CodeDeployDeploymentGroup
    Properties:
      Name: live
      Description: Live alias used by CodeDeploy for blue/green traffic shifting.
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MainFunctionVersion.Version

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Validation hook functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PreTrafficHookLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-pre-traffic-hook
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PostTrafficHookLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-post-traffic-hook
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  HookFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-hook-lambda-role
      Description: Execution role shared by the CodeDeploy lifecycle validation hooks.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: HookValidationPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteHookLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PreTrafficHookLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub ${PreTrafficHookLogGroup.Arn}:*
                  - !GetAtt PostTrafficHookLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub ${PostTrafficHookLogGroup.Arn}:*
              - Sid: ReportLifecycleEventStatus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codedeploy:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deploymentgroup:${CodeDeployApplication}/${CodeDeployDeploymentGroup}
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PreTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-pre-traffic-hook
      Description: CodeDeploy BeforeAllowTraffic validation hook.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures:
        - x86_64
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
          LOG_LEVEL: !Ref LogLevel
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: Text
        LogGroup: !Ref PreTrafficHookLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          import boto3

          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")


          def handler(event, context):
              """Validate the new version before any production traffic shifts."""
              deployment_id = event.get("deploymentId")
              hook_execution_id = event.get("lifecycleEventHookExecutionId")

              status = "Succeeded"
              try:
                  if not deployment_id or not hook_execution_id:
                      raise ValueError(
                          "Missing deploymentId or lifecycleEventHookExecutionId"
                      )
                  # Pre-traffic validation logic goes here (smoke tests, config
                  # checks, dependency probes, etc.).
                  print("Pre-traffic validation passed for %s" % deployment_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  status = "Failed"
                  print("Pre-traffic validation failed: %s" % exc)

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=deployment_id,
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=hook_execution_id,
                  status=status,
              )

              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"status": status})}
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PostTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-post-traffic-hook
      Description: CodeDeploy AfterAllowTraffic validation hook.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures:
        - x86_64
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
          LOG_LEVEL: !Ref LogLevel
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: Text
        LogGroup: !Ref PostTrafficHookLogGroup

          import boto3

          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")

      Tags:

          Value: !Ref Environment

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CodeDeployAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaRole

                Resource:

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-main:live
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-pre-traffic-hook
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-post-traffic-hook
              - Sid: ManageAliasRouting

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-main

              - Sid: DecryptDeploymentArtifacts

      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CodeDeployApplication:

Description: 'CloudFormation template for GitHub Actions OIDC integration with read-only S3 access to facia-tool-store bucket for guardian/facia-scala-client repository'

Resources:
  GitHubOIDCProvider:
    Type: AWS::IAM::OIDCProvider
    Properties:
      Url: 'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com'
      ClientIdList:
        - 'sts.amazonaws.com'
      ThumbprintList:
        - '6938fd4d98bab03faadb97b34396831e3780aea1'

  FaciaToolStoreKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 's3.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'

  FaciaToolStoreBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref FaciaToolStoreKmsKey

    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FaciaToolStoreBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGitHubActionsRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
              - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${FaciaToolStoreBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${FaciaToolStoreBucket}/DEV/*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${FaciaToolStoreBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${FaciaToolStoreBucket}/*'
            Condition:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: 'GitHubActionsFaciaScalaClientRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Condition:

              StringLike:

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3ReadOnlyFaciaToolStore
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadOnlyAccessToBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${FaciaToolStoreBucket}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${FaciaToolStoreBucket}/DEV/*'
                  - !GetAtt FaciaToolStoreKmsKey.Arn

    Default: "sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Description: Rate or cron expression for the SSM association schedule.
    Default: "rate(30 days)"
Resources:
  CustomInventoryDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: Custom-Inventory-Processes-Doc
      DocumentType: Command
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "2.2"
        description: "Collects running database and caching process inventory from Windows and Linux EC2 instances."
        parameters:
          LinuxProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: "Comma-separated Linux process keywords."
            default: "CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
          WindowsProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: "Comma-separated Windows process keywords."
            default: "sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: collectLinuxProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/bin/bash
                  set -eu

                  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                    TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600" || true)
                    if [ -n "${TOKEN:-}" ]; then
                      INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                    else
                      INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                    fi
                  elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                    INSTANCE_ID=$(wget -q -O - http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                  else
                    echo "No curl or wget available to query instance metadata" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi

                  if [ -z "${INSTANCE_ID:-}" ]; then
                    echo "Failed to retrieve instance ID" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi

                  KEYWORDS="{{ LinuxProcessKeywords }}"
                  CUSTOM_DIR="/var/lib/amazon/ssm/$INSTANCE_ID/inventory/custom"
                  mkdir -p "$CUSTOM_DIR"
                  CAPTURE_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
                  OUTPUT_FILE="$CUSTOM_DIR/custom.json"

                  printf '[\n' > "$OUTPUT_FILE"
                  FIRST=1

                  while IFS= read -r KW; do
                    KW=$(printf '%s' "$KW" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
                    if [ -z "$KW" ]; then
                      continue
                    fi

                    COUNT=0
                    if command -v pgrep >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                      PATTERN=$(printf '%s' "$KW" | sed 's/./[&]/')
                      for pid in $(pgrep -f "$PATTERN" 2>/dev/null || true); do
                        if [ "$pid" != "$$" ]; then
                          COUNT=$((COUNT+1))
                        fi
                      done
                    else
                      COUNT=$(ps -eo pid=,args= | grep "$KW" | grep -v grep | awk -v self=$$ '$1 != self { count++ } END { print count+0 }')
                    fi

                    if [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
                      if [ "$FIRST" -eq 0 ]; then
                        printf ',\n' >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
                      fi
                      FIRST=0
                      printf '  { "CaptureTime": "%s", "InstanceId": "%s", "SchemaVersion": "1.0", "TypeName": "Custom:ProcessInventory", "Content": { "Process": { "Name": "%s", "State": "running", "Count": "%s" } } }' "$CAPTURE_TIME" "$INSTANCE_ID" "$KW" "$COUNT" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
                    fi
                  done <<EOF
                  $(printf '%s' "$KEYWORDS" | tr ',' '\n')
                  EOF

                  printf '\n]\n' >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: collectWindowsProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

                  try {
                    $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -Headers @{ "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds" = "21600" } -ErrorAction Stop
                    $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -Headers @{ "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token" = $token }
                  } catch {
                    $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id"
                  }

                  if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($instanceId)) {
                    throw "Failed to retrieve instance ID"
                  }

                  $keywords = "{{ WindowsProcessKeywords }}"
                  $keywordArray = $keywords -split ',' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne "" }

                  $customDir = "C:\Program Files\Amazon\SSM\Inventory\Custom"
                  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $customDir -Force | Out-Null
                  $outputFile = Join-Path $customDir "custom.json"
                  $captureTime = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")

                  $entries = @()
                  foreach ($keyword in $keywordArray) {
                    $processes = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {
                      $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and (
                        ($_.Name -like "*$keyword*") -or
                        ($_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like "*$keyword*")
                      )
                    }
                    $count = @($processes).Count
                    if ($count -gt 0) {
                      $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{
                        CaptureTime   = $captureTime
                        InstanceId    = $instanceId
                        SchemaVersion = "1.0"
                        TypeName      = "Custom:ProcessInventory"
                        Content       = @{
                          Process = @{
                            Name  = $keyword
                            State = "running"
                            Count = "$count"
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }

                  if ($entries.Count -gt 0) {
                    $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $entries -Depth 5
                  } else {
                    $json = '[]'
                  }

                  $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
                  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($outputFile, $json, $utf8NoBom)

    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
      AssociationName: Custom-Inventory-Processes
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      Targets:
        - Key: InstanceIds
          Values:
            - "*"
      Parameters:
        LinuxProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        WindowsProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'App Mesh colorteller demo with Cloud Map discovery, 50/50 traffic split'

Resources:
  # App Mesh Mesh named after the stack
  Mesh:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # Cloud Map HTTP Namespace for service discovery
  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::HttpNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}.local"

  # Cloud Map service named colorteller
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller
      NamespaceId: !Ref CloudMapNamespace

  # Virtual node: colorteller-blue-node
  BlueNode:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    DependsOn:
      - CloudMapService
      - Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}"
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-blue-node
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}.local"
            ServiceName: colorteller

  # Virtual node: colorteller-green-node
  GreenNode:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    DependsOn:
      - CloudMapService
      - Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}"
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-green-node
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}.local"
            ServiceName: colorteller

  # Virtual router
  Router:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualRouter
    DependsOn:
      - Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}"
      VirtualRouterName: colorteller-router
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http

  # Route with 50/50 traffic split
  Route:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Route
    DependsOn:
      - BlueNode
      - GreenNode
      - Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}"
      VirtualRouterName: colorteller-router
      RouteName: colorteller-route
      Spec:
        HttpRoute:
          Match:
            Prefix: /
          Action:
            WeightedTargets:
              - VirtualNode: colorteller-blue-node
                Weight: 1
              - VirtualNode: colorteller-green-node
                Weight: 1

  # Virtual service: colorteller.<stackname>.local
  VirtualService:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualService
    DependsOn:
      - Mesh
      - Router
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}"
      VirtualServiceName: !Sub "colorteller.${AWS::StackName}.local"
      Spec:
        Provider:
          VirtualRouter:
            VirtualRouterName: colorteller-router

  # Virtual gateway: colorgateway
  Gateway:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualGateway
    DependsOn:
      - Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}"
      VirtualGatewayName: colorgateway
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000

  # Gateway route: forwards traffic to virtual service
  GatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::GatewayRoute
    DependsOn:
      - Gateway
      - VirtualService
      - Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}"
      VirtualGatewayName: colorgateway
      GatewayRouteName: colorgateway-route
      Spec:
        HttpRoute:
          Match:
            Prefix: /
          Action:
            Target:
              VirtualService:
                VirtualServiceName: !Sub "colorteller.${AWS::StackName}.local"

            Resource: "*"

        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:

        Rules:
