        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "kms:ViaService": !Sub "s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"

  DataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Join
        - "-"
        - - "quicksight-admin-console"
          - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !Split
              - "-"
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - "/"
                  - !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref S3EncryptionKey
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  DataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt DataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${DataBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": false

  QuickSightFullAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: "Grants full access to QuickSight for the admin data prep pipeline."
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "quicksight:*"
            Resource: "*"

  QuickSightAdminDataPrepRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - !Ref QuickSightFullAccessPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSGlueConsoleFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Join
          - ""
          - - "quicksight_admin_db_"
            - !Select
              - 0
              - !Split
                - "-"
                - !Select
                  - 2
                  - !Split
                    - "/"
                    - !Ref "AWS::StackId"
        Description: "Database backing the QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline."

  CloudTrailTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: "cloudtrail_logs"
        TableType: "EXTERNAL_TABLE"
        Parameters:
          EXTERNAL: "TRUE"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/cloudtrail/"
          InputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"
          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: "org.openx.data.jsonserde.JsonSerDe"
          Columns:
            - Name: eventVersion
              Type: string
            - Name: userIdentity
              Type: string
            - Name: eventTime
              Type: string
            - Name: eventSource
              Type: string
            - Name: eventName
              Type: string
            - Name: awsRegion
              Type: string
            - Name: sourceIPAddress
              Type: string
            - Name: userAgent
              Type: string
            - Name: requestParameters
              Type: string
            - Name: responseElements
              Type: string
            - Name: resources
              Type: string
            - Name: eventType
              Type: string
            - Name: recipientAccountId
              Type: string
        PartitionKeys:
          - Name: region
            Type: string
          - Name: year
            Type: string
          - Name: month
            Type: string
          - Name: day
            Type: string

  # PythonShell jobs (GlueVersion 4.0 for Python 3.9)
  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-group-membership"
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSightAdminDataPrepRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/quicksight-admin-group-membership.py"
      GlueVersion: "4.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/temp/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
        "--enable-metrics": "true"
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-enable"
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-object-access"
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSightAdminDataPrepRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/quicksight-admin-object-access.py"
      GlueVersion: "4.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/temp/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
        "--enable-metrics": "true"
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-enable"
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-folder-assets"
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSightAdminDataPrepRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/quicksight-admin-folder-assets.py"
      GlueVersion: "4.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/temp/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
        "--enable-metrics": "true"
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-enable"
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  # Glue ETL jobs (GlueVersion 5.0, G.1X workers)
  FolderLookupJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-folder-lookup"
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSightAdminDataPrepRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/quicksight-admin-folder-lookup.py"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/temp/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
        "--enable-metrics": "true"
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-enable"
        "--enable-spark-ui": "true"
        "--spark-event-logs-path": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/spark-logs/"
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  FolderPathJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-folder-path"
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSightAdminDataPrepRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/quicksight-admin-folder-path.py"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/temp/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
        "--enable-metrics": "true"
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-enable"
        "--enable-spark-ui": "true"
        "--spark-event-logs-path": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/spark-logs/"
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  # Scheduled Triggers (every 3 hours)
  GroupMembershipTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-group-membership-trigger"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GroupMembershipJob

  ObjectAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-object-access-trigger"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref ObjectAccessJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-folder-assets-trigger"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  FolderLookupTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-folder-lookup-trigger"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderLookupJob

  FolderPathTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: "quicksight-admin-folder-path-trigger"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderPathJob

Outputs:
  GroupMembershipS3Path:
    Description: "S3 path for group membership data"
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/group-membership/"
  ObjectAccessS3Path:
    Description: "S3 path for object access data"
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/object-access/"
  FolderAssetsS3Path:
    Description: "S3 path for folder assets data"
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/folder-assets/"
  FolderLookupS3Path:
    Description: "S3 path for folder lookup data"
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/folder-lookup/"
  FolderPathS3Path:
    Description: "S3 path for folder path data"
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/folder-path/"
  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: "Name of the Glue table for CloudTrail logs"
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailTable
  CloudTrailS3Location:
    Description: "S3 location for CloudTrail logs"
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/cloudtrail/"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline for custom Amazon Linux 2 ECS optimized AMIs with Chef recipe execution, daily scheduling, image scanning/tests, lifecycle deprecation, and required IAM roles.

Parameters:
  RecipeBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Base name for the S3 bucket; the AWS account ID is appended automatically.
    Default: imagebuilder-chef-recipe
  ComponentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the custom Image Builder component.
    Default: chef-recipe-component
  ImageRecipeName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the Image Builder image recipe.
    Default: amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-image-recipe
  InfrastructureConfigurationName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the Image Builder infrastructure configuration.
    Default: production-image-builder-infrastructure
  DistributionConfigurationName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the Image Builder distribution configuration.
    Default: production-image-builder-distribution
  ImagePipelineName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the Image Builder image pipeline.
    Default: production-image-builder-pipeline
  LifecyclePolicyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the Image Builder lifecycle policy.
    Default: production-image-builder-lifecycle-policy
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS region to distribute and share the AMI in.
    Default: us-east-1
  ParentImageAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Description: AWS public SSM parameter that resolves to the latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI ID.
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
  AmiName:
    Type: String
    Description: Base name for the distributed AMI.
    Default: production-ecs-ami
  ChefCookbookName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Chef cookbook in the downloaded recipe archive.
    Default: my_cookbook
  BuildInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Description: EC2 instance type used by Image Builder for builds.
    Default: t3.micro
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Description: Root volume size in GiB.
    Default: 50
    MinValue: 20
    MaxValue: 1024
  RootVolumeType:
    Type: String
    Description: Root volume type.
    Default: gp3
    AllowedValues:
      - gp2
      - gp3
      - io1
      - io2
      - sc1
      - st1
      - standard
  ImageTestsTimeoutMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Description: Timeout for Image Builder tests in minutes.
    Default: 120
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 1440
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch Events cron expression for the daily image pipeline schedule.
    Default: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
  LifecycleRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Days to keep generated AMIs before they are deprecated.
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
  LifecycleRetainAtLeast:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum number of recent AMIs to retain from lifecycle deprecation.
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10

Resources:
  S3EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for Image Builder recipe bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Project
          Value: ImageBuilder

  RecipeBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${RecipeBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref S3EncryptionKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Project
          Value: ImageBuilder

  RecipeBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RecipeBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderListRecipeBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ImageBuilderBuildRole.Arn
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}"
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderReadChefRecipes
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ImageBuilderBuildRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetObjectVersion
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}/recipes/*"

  ImageBuilderBuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3RecipeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}/recipes/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Project
          Value: ImageBuilder

  ImageBuilderBuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderBuildRole

  ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLifecycleExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:Get*
                  - imagebuilder:List*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:EnableImageDeprecation
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Project
          Value: ImageBuilder

  ChefComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Description: Downloads and executes a Chef recipe from S3, updates SSM Agent, and collects metadata.
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ChefRecipeExecutor
        description: Downloads and executes a Chef recipe, updates SSM Agent, and collects metadata.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      aws s3 cp s3://${RecipeBucket}/recipes/chef-recipe.tar.gz /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz
                      mkdir -p /tmp/chef-recipe
                      tar -xzf /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz -C /tmp/chef-recipe
              - name: ExecuteChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      if command -v chef-client >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                        cd /tmp/chef-recipe
                        sudo chef-client --local-mode --runlist "recipe[${ChefCookbookName}::default]" || true
                      else
                        echo "Chef client not found; recipe execution skipped."
                      fi
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      curl -sSf https://s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/ec2-downloads-linux/SSMAgent/latest/linux_amd64/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm -o /tmp/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm
                      sudo yum localinstall -y /tmp/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm
              - name: CollectMetadata
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      sudo uname -a > /var/log/imagebuilder-metadata.log
                      cat /etc/os-release >> /var/log/imagebuilder-metadata.log
                      echo "Metadata collection complete" >> /var/log/imagebuilder-metadata.log
      Tags:
        Environment: Production
        Project: ImageBuilder

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Description: Builds an Amazon Linux 2 ECS optimized AMI with the custom Chef recipe component.
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageAmiId
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ChefComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: !Ref RootVolumeType
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Environment: Production
        Project: ImageBuilder

  ImageBuilderVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Project
          Value: ImageBuilder

  ImageBuilderSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InspectorEnablerPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:Enable
                  - inspector2:Disable
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Project
          Value: ImageBuilder

  InspectorEnablerLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt InspectorEnablerLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event.get('RequestType')
                  properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
                  region = properties.get('Region')
                  resource_types = properties.get('ResourceTypes', ['EC2'])
                  inspector2 = boto3.client('inspector2', region_name=region)

                  if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      logger.info('Enabling Inspector for resource types %s', resource_types)
                      inspector2.enable(ResourceTypes=resource_types)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      logger.info('Disabling Inspector for resource types %s', resource_types)
                      try:
                          inspector2.disable(ResourceTypes=resource_types)
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.info('Best-effort disable did not complete: %s', e)

                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception('Inspector enabler custom resource failed')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Project
          Value: ImageBuilder

  InspectorEnablerCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt InspectorEnablerLambda.Arn
      Region: !Ref AWS::Region
      ResourceTypes:
        - EC2

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration

      Name: !Ref InfrastructureConfigurationName
      Description: Infrastructure configuration that terminates build instances on failure.
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceType
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderBuildInstanceProfile
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet1
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      ResourceTags:
        Environment: Production
        Project: ImageBuilder
      Tags:
        Environment: Production
        Project: ImageBuilder

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DistributionConfigurationName
      Description: Distributes the AMI to the target region and shares launch permissions with the current account.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub "${AmiName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: !Sub "${AmiName} distributed to ${TargetRegion}"
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref AWS::AccountId
            AmiTags:
              Environment: Production
              Project: ImageBuilder
              Lifecycle: Active
      Tags:
        Environment: Production
        Project: ImageBuilder

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    DependsOn: InspectorEnablerCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImagePipelineName
      Description: Daily Image Builder pipeline with image scanning and tests enabled.
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: !Ref ImageTestsTimeoutMinutes
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Status: ENABLED
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Tags:
        Environment: Production
        Project: ImageBuilder

  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref LifecyclePolicyName
      Description: Deprecates AMIs based on age while honoring the Lifecycle=Retain tag exclusion.
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Lifecycle: Active
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref LifecycleRetentionDays
            Unit: DAYS
            RetainAtLeast: !Ref LifecycleRetainAtLeast
          ExclusionRules:
            Amis:
              IsPublic: false
              TagMap:
                Lifecycle: Retain
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Environment: Production
        Project: ImageBuilder

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the custom Image Builder component.
    Value: !GetAtt ChefComponent.Arn

    Value: !Ref RecipeBucket

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Provisions five private EC2 instances with NAT-based internet access, a CloudWatch VPC endpoint, and CloudWatch alarms for CPU, status check failures, and EBS volume reachability."

Parameters:
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.nano
      - t3.micro
      - t3.small
      - t3.medium
      - t3.large
    Description: EC2 instance type for the monitored instances.

  SSHLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR range allowed to SSH into the instances.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

Mappings:
  RegionMap:
    us-east-1:
      AMI: ami-0c02fb55956c7d316

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: monitoring-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: monitoring-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: monitoring-private-subnet

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: monitoring-public-subnet

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: monitoring-private-route-table

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: monitoring-public-route-table

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: monitoring-nat-eip

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn:
      - DefaultPublicRoute
      - PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: monitoring-nat-gateway

  NATRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - NATGateway
      - DefaultPublicRoute
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for monitoring EC2 instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref SSHLocation
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: monitoring-instances-sg

  CloudWatchEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the CloudWatch VPC endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: cloudwatch-endpoint-sg

  CloudWatchEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring"
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref CloudWatchEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KeyPair:
    Type: AWS::EC2::KeyPair
    Properties:
      KeyName: !Sub "monitoring-key-${AWS::StackName}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "monitoring-key-${AWS::StackName}"

  MetricsPublishRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: publish-cloudwatch-metrics
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: "*"

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref MetricsPublishRole

  MonitoringInstance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn:
      - NATGateway
      - NATRoute
      - DefaultPublicRoute
      - CloudWatchEndpoint
      - PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation
      - InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      ImageId:
        Fn::FindInMap:
          - RegionMap
          - Ref: AWS::Region
          - AMI
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      KeyName: !Ref KeyPair
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref InstanceProfile
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda

            VolumeSize: 8
      Tags:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: CloudFormation template for a DynamoDB table with comprehensive CloudWatch alarms.

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottleEvents"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when WriteThrottleEvents >= 1 for the DynamoDB table"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Content-level PII classification scanner for S3 Access Point using Amazon Comprehend, DynamoDB, and optional SNS notifications.'

Parameters:
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Memory size (MB) for the scanner Lambda function.
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    Description: Timeout (seconds) for the scanner Lambda function.
  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    Description: Language code for Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities.
  MaxFilesPerInvocation:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    Description: Maximum number of files to scan per Lambda invocation.
  DeployInVpcMode:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: If true, deploy the scanner Lambda inside a VPC and create VPC resources.
  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
    Description: If true and DeployInVpcMode is true, create VPC endpoints for S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, and SNS.
  SnsEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Email address for SNS notifications. Leave empty to skip SNS topic creation.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC (used only when DeployInVpcMode is true).

Conditions:
  VpcMode: !Equals [!Ref DeployInVpcMode, 'true']
  CreateEndpoints: !And [!Condition VpcMode, !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, 'true']]
  HasSnsEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsEmail, '']]

Resources:
  ScannerKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Description: KMS key for S3 bucket encryption
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PII-Scanner-S3-Key

  SnsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Description: KMS key for SNS topic encryption
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PII-Scanner-SNS-Key

  ScannerBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ScannerKmsKey

  ScannerBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScannerBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ScannerBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ScannerBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                's3:DataAccessPointArn': !GetAtt ScannerAccessPoint.Arn

  ScannerAccessPoint:
    Type: AWS::S3::AccessPoint
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScannerBucket
      VpcConfiguration: !If
        - VpcMode
        - VpcId: !Ref ScannerVpc
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ScannerVpc:
    Condition: VpcMode
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PII-Scanner-VPC

  ScannerSubnet1:
    Condition: VpcMode
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ScannerVpc
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 2, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PII-Scanner-Private-Subnet-1

  ScannerSubnet2:
    Condition: VpcMode
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ScannerVpc
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 2, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PII-Scanner-Private-Subnet-2

  ScannerSecurityGroup:
    Condition: VpcMode
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for PII scanner Lambda
      VpcId: !Ref ScannerVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PII-Scanner-SG

  ScannerRouteTable1:
    Condition: VpcMode
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ScannerVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PII-Scanner-Private-RT-1

  ScannerRouteTable2:
    Condition: VpcMode
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ScannerVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PII-Scanner-Private-RT-2

  ScannerRouteTableAssociation1:
    Condition: VpcMode
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ScannerSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref ScannerRouteTable1

  ScannerRouteTableAssociation2:
    Condition: VpcMode
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ScannerSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref ScannerRouteTable2

  ScannerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ScannerPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ScannerAccessPoint.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ScannerAccessPoint.Arn}/object/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ScannerReportsTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: '*'

  ScannerReportsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: object_key
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: scan_timestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: object_key
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: scan_timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ScannerLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ScannerLambda}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  ScannerLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Environment:
        Variables:
          REPORT_TABLE: !Ref ScannerReportsTable
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !If [HasSnsEmail, !Ref ScannerSnsTopic, '']
          COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFilesPerInvocation
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !GetAtt ScannerAccessPoint.Arn
      VpcConfig: !If
        - VpcMode
        - SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref ScannerSecurityGroup
          SubnetIds:
            - !Ref ScannerSubnet1
            - !Ref ScannerSubnet2
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, os, json, datetime, math, sys, traceback
          from botocore.config import Config

          config = Config(retries={'max_attempts': 10})
          s3 = boto3.client('s3', config=config)
          s3control = boto3.client('s3control', config=config)
          comprehend = boto3.client('comprehend', config=config)
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          sns = boto3.client('sns', config=config)

          table = None
          sns_topic_arn = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN')
          table_name = os.environ['REPORT_TABLE']
          language = os.environ['COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE_CODE']
          max_files = int(os.environ['MAX_FILES'])
          access_point_arn = os.environ['ACCESS_POINT_ARN']

          parts = access_point_arn.split(':')
          region = parts[3]
          account_id = parts[4]
          ap_name = parts[5].split('/')[1] if 'accesspoint/' in parts[5] else parts[5]

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ap = s3control.get_access_point(Name=ap_name, AccountId=account_id)
              if ap.get('NetworkOrigin') == 'VPC':
                  raise Exception(f"Access point {ap_name} is VPC-only but Lambda is not deployed in the matching VPC.")
              if sns_topic_arn != '':
                  sns_client = sns
              else:
                  sns_client = None
              table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
              paginator = s3.get_paginator('list_objects_v2')
              page_iterator = paginator.paginate(Bucket=access_point_arn, PaginationConfig={'MaxItems': max_files})
              count = 0
              for page in page_iterator:
                  if 'Contents' not in page:
                      continue
                  for obj in page['Contents']:
                      if count >= max_files:
                          break
                      key = obj['Key']
                      size = obj['Size']
                      if size == 0:
                          continue
                      try:
                          response = s3.get_object(Bucket=access_point_arn, Key=key)
                          data = response['Body'].read()
                          text = data.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                          chunks = [text[i:i+95000] for i in range(0, len(text), 95000)]
                          all_entities = []
                          for chunk in chunks:
                              if len(chunk) == 0:
                                  continue
                              resp = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(Text=chunk, LanguageCode=language)
                              all_entities.extend(resp.get('Entities', []))
                          item = {
                              'object_key': key,
                              'scan_timestamp': datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                              'file_size': size,
                              'pii_entities': all_entities,
                              'pii_count': len(all_entities)
                          }
                          table.put_item(Item=item)
                          count += 1
                          if sns_client:
                              sns_client.publish(
                                  TopicArn=sns_topic_arn,
                                  Message=json.dumps({
                                      'object_key': key,
                                      'pii_count': len(all_entities),
                                      'scan_timestamp': item['scan_timestamp']
                                  })
                              )
                      except Exception as e:
                          print(f"Error processing {key}: {e}")
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'files_scanned': count})
              }

  ScannerSnsTopic:
    Condition: HasSnsEmail
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: PII-Scanner-Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SnsKmsKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Glue databases and tables for property graph and RDF data.

Parameters:
  LPGDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph_database
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Database name must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
  RDFDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph_database_rdf
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Database name must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

Resources:
  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref LPGDatabaseName
        Description: Database for property graph (LPG) tables.

  RDFDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RDFDatabaseName
        Description: Database for RDF tables.

  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        Description: Airport vertices.
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: latitude
              Type: double
            - Name: longitude
              Type: double
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
        Parameters:
          classification: gremlin
          gremlin.labelType: vertex

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        Description: Country vertices.
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: name

          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

              Type: string
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
        Parameters:
          classification: gremlin
          gremlin.labelType: vertex

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        Description: Route edges.
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: source
              Type: string
            - Name: destination
              Type: string
            - Name: distance
              Type: double
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
        Parameters:
          classification: gremlin
          gremlin.labelType: edge
          gremlinQuery: |-
            g.V().hasLabel('airport').as('src').outE('route').as('e').inV().as('dst').select('src','dst').by('code').limit(10)

  CustomAirportTable:

    Properties:

            - Name: timezone

          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
        Parameters:
          classification: gremlin
          gremlin.labelType: view

  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref RDFDatabase

          Columns:

            - Name: country
              Type: string

              Type: double
            - Name: longitude

          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
        Parameters:
          classification: rdf
          stripUriPrefix: 'true'
          separatorChar: ','
          queryMode: class
          classuri: 'class:Airport'

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref RDFDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        Description: RDF route table with prefixes.
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode

            - Name: outcode

            - Name: dist

          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:

        Parameters:
          classification: rdf
          stripUriPrefix: 'true'
          separatorChar: ','
          queryMode: sparql
          prefixClass: 'http://www.openlinksw.com/air-routes/ontology/class/'
          prefixDatatypeProperty: 'http://www.openlinksw.com/air-routes/ontology/datatypeProperty/'
          prefixObjectProperty: 'http://www.openlinksw.com/air-routes/ontology/objectProperty/'
          sparqlQuery: |-
            SELECT ?src ?dst ?dist
            WHERE {
              ?route objectProperty:from ?src .

              ?route datatypeProperty:distance ?dist
            }

  RouteRdfNopfxTable:

    Properties:

      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        Description: RDF route table without prefixes in query.
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: integer
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
        Parameters:
          classification: rdf
          stripUriPrefix: 'true'
          separatorChar: ','
          queryMode: sparql
          sparqlQuery: |-
            SELECT ?src ?dst ?dist
            WHERE {
              ?route <http://www.openlinksw.com/air-routes/ontology/objectProperty/from> ?src .
              ?route <http://www.openlinksw.com/air-routes/ontology/objectProperty/to> ?dst .
              ?route <http://www.openlinksw.com/air-routes/ontology/datatypeProperty/distance> ?dist
            }

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email

          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Public Route 53 hosted zone and production DNS records for radiotopia.fm,
  with optional CloudFront distributions, ACM certificates, and WAF protection
  for media, tower, v1, and plus subdomains. Deploy in us-east-1.

Parameters:
  ProvisionCloudFront:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Set to false for initial DNS-only deployment, then update to true after
      registrar delegation is live.
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
  SpfRecord:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Complete SPF TXT value for radiotopia.fm. This must remain a single
      string containing one valid SPF policy.
    Default: "v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:servers.mcsv.net include:spf.mandrillapp.com include:cmail1.com include:mail.zendesk.com ~all"
    NoEcho: true
  GoogleWorkspaceVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Google Workspace domain ownership verification TXT value issued by
      Google Workspace.
    Default: "google-site-verification=8f7N2bD9YwLqT5pRzXcV3mKsH6jG4nB8uEaQ0tZ"
    NoEcho: true
  ApexOwnershipToken2Value:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Second apex domain ownership verification TXT value issued by the
      provider, normally an ms= token.
    Default: "ms=83901234567890"
    NoEcho: true
  DmarcRua:
    Type: String
    Description: DMARC aggregate report URI.
    Default: "mailto:dmarc@radiotopia.fm"
  DmarcRuf:
    Type: String
    Description: DMARC forensic report URI.
    Default: "mailto:dmarc@radiotopia.fm"
  MxRecords:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited MX values with priority and fully-qualified exchange
      hostname.
    Default: "1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.,5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.,5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.,10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.,10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
  WebsiteIPv4Addresses:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      Static IPv4 addresses published by the third-party website hosting
      service for apex A records.
    Default: "198.185.159.144,198.185.159.145,198.185.159.146,198.185.159.147"
  WebsiteCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Fully-qualified CNAME target for www, with trailing dot, published by
      the third-party website hosting service.
    Default: "ext-cust.squarespace.com."
  PodcastFeedLabel:
    Type: String
    Description: Exact left-hand label for the podcast feed CNAME record.
    Default: "feeds"
  PodcastFeedCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Fully-qualified feed proxy hostname supplied by the podcast hosting
      provider, with trailing dot.
    Default: "feeds.simplecast.com."
  EventSubdomainLabel:
    Type: String
    Description: Exact left-hand label for the special event subdomain.
    Default: "live"
  EventIPv4Address:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 address supplied for the special event A record.
    Default: "34.120.194.162"
  ZendeskVerificationHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Left-hand label for Zendesk verification.
    Default: "_zendesk-domain-verification"
  ZendeskVerificationType:
    Type: String
    Description: Record type generated by Zendesk.
    Default: CNAME
    AllowedValues:
      - CNAME
      - TXT
  ZendeskVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Value generated by Zendesk. For CNAME use a fully-qualified target with
      a trailing dot. For TXT record, omit surrounding quotes.
    Default: "_zendesk-domain-verification.zendesk.com."
    NoEcho: true
  MailChimpVerificationHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Left-hand label for MailChimp domain verification.
    Default: "_dnskey"
  MailChimpVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: MailChimp domain verification TXT value issued by MailChimp.
    Default: "MC_HOST_radiotopia-fm-8f3k2l9m"
    NoEcho: true
  MailChimpDkimSelector1:
    Type: String
    Description: First MailChimp DKIM selector.
    Default: k1
  MailChimpDkim1Value:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      First MailChimp DKIM TXT value issued by MailChimp, normally
      v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...
    Default: "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEA1234567890abcdef"
    NoEcho: true
  MailChimpDkimSelector2:
    Type: String
    Description: Second MailChimp DKIM selector.
    Default: k2
  MailChimpDkim2Value:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Second MailChimp DKIM TXT value issued by MailChimp, normally
      v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...
    Default: "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEA9876543210fedcba"
    NoEcho: true
  SquarespaceVerificationHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Left-hand host label for Squarespace verification.
    Default: "verify.squarespace.com"
  SquarespaceVerificationType:
    Type: String
    Description: Record type generated by Squarespace.
    Default: CNAME
    AllowedValues:
      - CNAME
      - TXT
  SquarespaceVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Value shown in Squarespace. For CNAME use a fully-qualified target with
      a trailing dot. For TXT omit surrounding quotes.
    Default: "verify.squarespace.com."
    NoEcho: true
  CampaignMonitorVerificationHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Left-hand label for Campaign Monitor verification.
    Default: "cm-verification"
  CampaignMonitorVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: Campaign Monitor verification TXT value issued by Campaign Monitor.
    Default: "campaignmonitor.com"
    NoEcho: true
  CampaignMonitorDkimSelector:
    Type: String
    Description: Campaign Monitor DKIM selector issued by Campaign Monitor.
    Default: "selector1"
  CampaignMonitorDkimValue:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Campaign Monitor DKIM TXT value issued by Campaign Monitor, normally
      v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...
    Default: "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEA1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    NoEcho: true
  GoogleWorkspaceDkimValue:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Google Workspace DKIM TXT value for google._domainkey, normally
      v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...
    Default: "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEA9z8y7x6w5v4u3t2"
    NoEcho: true

Conditions:
  ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref ProvisionCloudFront
    - "true"
  ZendeskVerificationIsCname: !Equals
    - !Ref ZendeskVerificationType
    - CNAME
  ZendeskVerificationIsTxt: !Equals
    - !Ref ZendeskVerificationType
    - TXT
  SquarespaceVerificationIsCname: !Equals
    - !Ref SquarespaceVerificationType
    - CNAME
  SquarespaceVerificationIsTxt: !Equals
    - !Ref SquarespaceVerificationType
    - TXT

Resources:
  PublicHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public hosted zone for radiotopia.fm production DNS

  RadiotopiaWaf:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia-waf
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      Description: WAF ACL for radiotopia.fm CloudFront distributions
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: radiotopiaWaf
      Rules:
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: radiotopiaCommonRuleSet

  Certificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    DependsOn: PublicHostedZone
    Properties:
      DomainName: media.radiotopia.fm
      SubjectAlternativeNames:
        - tower.radiotopia.fm
        - v1.radiotopia.fm
        - plus.radiotopia.fm
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: media.radiotopia.fm
          HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
        - DomainName: tower.radiotopia.fm
          HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
        - DomainName: v1.radiotopia.fm
          HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
        - DomainName: plus.radiotopia.fm
          HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone

  MediaDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        WebACLId: !GetAtt RadiotopiaWaf.Arn
        Aliases:
          - media.radiotopia.fm
        Comment: media.radiotopia.fm CloudFront distribution
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: mediaOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 86400
          MaxTTL: 31536000
          Compress: true
        Enabled: true
        IPV6Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - Id: mediaOrigin
            DomainName: radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
              OriginReadTimeout: 30
              OriginKeepaliveTimeout: 5
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref Certificate
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021

  TowerDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        WebACLId: !GetAtt RadiotopiaWaf.Arn
        Aliases:
          - tower.radiotopia.fm
        Comment: tower.radiotopia.fm CloudFront distribution
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: towerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 86400
          MaxTTL: 31536000
          Compress: true
        Enabled: true
        IPV6Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - Id: towerOrigin
            DomainName: radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
              OriginReadTimeout: 30
              OriginKeepaliveTimeout: 5
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref Certificate
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021

  V1Distribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        WebACLId: !GetAtt RadiotopiaWaf.Arn
        Aliases:
          - v1.radiotopia.fm
        Comment: v1.radiotopia.fm CloudFront distribution
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: v1Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 86400
          MaxTTL: 31536000
          Compress: true
        Enabled: true
        IPV6Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - Id: v1Origin
            DomainName: radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
              OriginReadTimeout: 30
              OriginKeepaliveTimeout: 5
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref Certificate
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021

  PlusDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        WebACLId: !GetAtt RadiotopiaWaf.Arn
        Aliases:
          - plus.radiotopia.fm
        Comment: plus.radiotopia.fm CloudFront distribution
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: plusOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 86400
          MaxTTL: 31536000
          Compress: true
        Enabled: true
        IPV6Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - Id: plusOrigin
            DomainName: radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
              OriginReadTimeout: 30
              OriginKeepaliveTimeout: 5
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref Certificate
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021

  WebsiteApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords: !Ref WebsiteIPv4Addresses

  ApexSpfRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      SetIdentifier: spf
      MultiValueAnswer: true
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SpfRecord}"'

  ApexGoogleWorkspaceVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      SetIdentifier: google-site-verification
      MultiValueAnswer: true
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleWorkspaceVerificationValue}"'

  ApexOwnershipToken2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      SetIdentifier: ms-verification
      MultiValueAnswer: true
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ApexOwnershipToken2Value}"'

  DmarcRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: _dmarc.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=reject; adkim=s; aspf=s; fo=1; rf=afrf; rua=${DmarcRua}; ruf=${DmarcRuf}; pct=100"'

  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords: !Ref MxRecords

  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: www.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WebsiteCnameTarget

  PodcastFeedRecordSetGroup:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    DependsOn: PublicHostedZone
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      RecordSets:
        - Name: !Sub "${PodcastFeedLabel}.radiotopia.fm."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 300
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref PodcastFeedCnameTarget

  EventSubdomainARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub "${EventSubdomainLabel}.radiotopia.fm."
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref EventIPv4Address

  MediaAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: media.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !GetAtt MediaDistribution.DomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  MediaAliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: media.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !GetAtt MediaDistribution.DomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  TowerAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: tower.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !GetAtt TowerDistribution.DomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  TowerAliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: tower.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !GetAtt TowerDistribution.DomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  V1AliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: v1.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !GetAtt V1Distribution.DomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  V1AliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: ProvisionCloudFrontEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
