AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for managing client connections and session state
Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ConnectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ConnectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: WebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"
  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/*/*'
  ConnectLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WebSocketConnect
      Runtime: nodejs22.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
            const dynamodb = new AWS.DynamoDB.DocumentClient();
            const connectionId = event.requestContext.connectionId;
            const ttl = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 86400;
            await dynamodb.put({
              TableName: process.env.TABLE_NAME,
              Item: {
                ConnectionId: connectionId,
                ttl: ttl
              }
            }).promise();
            return { statusCode: 200 };
          };
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
          API_ID: !Ref WebSocketApi
          STAGE_NAME: "api"
          REGION: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
  DefaultLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WebSocketDefault
      Runtime: nodejs22.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
            const apiGateway = new AWS.ApiGatewayManagementApi({
              endpoint: `https://${process.env.API_ID}.execute-api.${process.env.REGION}.amazonaws.com/${process.env.STAGE_NAME}`
            });
            const connectionId = event.requestContext.connectionId;
            const message = JSON.parse(event.body).message;
            await apiGateway.postToConnection({
              ConnectionId: connectionId,
              Data: JSON.stringify({ message: message })
            }).promise();
            return { statusCode: 200 };
          };
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
          API_ID: !Ref WebSocketApi
          STAGE_NAME: "api"
          REGION: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
  DisconnectLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WebSocketDisconnect
      Runtime: nodejs22.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
            const dynamodb = new AWS.DynamoDB.DocumentClient();
            const connectionId = event.requestContext.connectionId;
            await dynamodb.delete({
              TableName: process.env.TABLE_NAME,
              Key: {
                ConnectionId: connectionId
              }
            }).promise();
            return { statusCode: 200 };
          };
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
          API_ID: !Ref WebSocketApi
          STAGE_NAME: "api"
          REGION: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt ConnectLambda.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: "1.0"
  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt DefaultLambda.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: "1.0"
  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt DisconnectLambda.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: "1.0"
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "$connect"
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "$default"
      RouteResponseSelectionExpression: "$default"
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultIntegration}'
  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "$disconnect"
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'
  DefaultRouteResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::RouteResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteId: !Ref DefaultRoute
      RouteResponseKey: "$default"
  DefaultIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref DefaultIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: "$default"
  ConnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ConnectLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/*/*'
  DefaultPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/*/*'
  DisconnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DisconnectLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/*/*'
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Initial deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - ConnectIntegration
      - DefaultIntegration
      - DisconnectIntegration
      - DefaultRouteResponse
      - DefaultIntegrationResponse
  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: "api"
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS FIS experiment template that blocks application network traffic
  from the local deployment region to a target region and pauses cross-region
  replication for S3 and DynamoDB. Resource discovery, disruption, delay, and
  restore logic is performed by SSM Automation documents that FIS starts through
  aws:ssm:start-automation-execution. The automation documents target resources
  tagged ChaosAllowed=true, including transit gateways, subnets, S3 buckets, and
  DynamoDB global tables. The template also provisions IAM roles, an encrypted
  CloudWatch log group, and a dedicated KMS key for experiment logging.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Provide a valid AWS region code, for example us-west-2.
    Description: The target region to which traffic and replication should be disrupted.

  PauseDurationMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 20
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 600
    Description: Number of minutes to block traffic and pause replication.

  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/fis/experiments
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_./-]+$'
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group used for FIS experiment logging.

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt AWS FIS experiment CloudWatch logs.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: FisLogEncryptionKeyPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: "*"

  ExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 14

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAutomationChaosPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3BucketDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                Resource: "*"

  PauseS3ReplicationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: FIS-PauseS3Replication
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Pauses S3 replication for buckets tagged ChaosAllowed=true for the
          configured duration and then restores the original replication settings.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role used by this automation.
          PauseDurationMinutes:
            type: Integer
            description: Number of minutes to pause replication.
          TargetRegion:
            type: String
            description: AWS region to use for API calls.
        mainSteps:
          - name: BuildSleepDuration
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 60
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: build_duration
              InputPayload:
                minutes: '{{ PauseDurationMinutes }}'
              Script: |
                def build_duration(events, context):
                    minutes = int(events.get('minutes', '0'))
                    return {'duration': 'PT{}M'.format(max(minutes, 0))}
            outputs:
              - Name: duration
                Selector: $.duration
                Type: String

          - name: PauseS3Replication
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: pause_replication
              InputPayload:
                target_region: '{{ TargetRegion }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def pause_replication(events, context):
                    target_region = events.get('target_region')
                    s3 = boto3.client('s3', region_name=target_region)
                    state = {}

                    try:
                        buckets = s3.list_buckets().get('Buckets', [])
                    except ClientError as e:
                        raise RuntimeError('Failed to list S3 buckets: {}'.format(e))

                    for bucket_info in buckets:
                        bucket = bucket_info['Name']

                        try:
                            tagging = s3.get_bucket_tagging(Bucket=bucket).get('TagSet', [])
                        except ClientError as e:
                            if e.response['Error']['Code'] in ('NoSuchTagSet', 'NoSuchBucket'):
                                continue
                            raise

                        if not any(t['Key'] == 'ChaosAllowed' and t['Value'] == 'true' for t in tagging):
                            continue

                        try:
                            replication = s3.get_bucket_replication(Bucket=bucket)
                        except ClientError as e:
                            if e.response['Error']['Code'] in ('ReplicationConfigurationNotFoundError', 'NoSuchBucket'):
                                continue
                            raise

                        original_config = replication['ReplicationConfiguration']
                        paused_config = json.loads(json.dumps(original_config))

                        for rule in paused_config.get('Rules', []):
                            rule['Status'] = 'Disabled'

                        s3.put_bucket_replication(Bucket=bucket, ReplicationConfiguration=paused_config)
                        state[bucket] = original_config

                    return {'state': json.dumps(state)}
            outputs:
              - Name: state
                Selector: $.state
                Type: String

          - name: Sleep
            action: aws:sleep
            inputs:
              Duration: '{{ BuildSleepDuration.duration }}'

          - name: RestoreS3Replication
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: restore_replication
              InputPayload:
                target_region: '{{ TargetRegion }}'
                state: '{{ PauseS3Replication.state }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json

                def restore_replication(events, context):
                    target_region = events.get('target_region')
                    s3 = boto3.client('s3', region_name=target_region)
                    state = json.loads(events.get('state', '{}'))

                    for bucket, replication_config in state.items():
                        s3.put_bucket_replication(Bucket=bucket, ReplicationConfiguration=replication_config)

  PauseDynamoDBReplicationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: FIS-PauseDynamoDBReplication
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Pauses DynamoDB global table replication to the target region for the
          configured duration and then recreates the removed replicas.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role used by this automation.
          PauseDurationMinutes:
            type: Integer
            description: Number of minutes to pause replication.
          TargetRegion:
            type: String
            description: AWS region whose replica should be removed and recreated.
        mainSteps:
          - name: BuildSleepDuration
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 60
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: build_duration
              InputPayload:
                minutes: '{{ PauseDurationMinutes }}'
              Script: |
                def build_duration(events, context):
                    minutes = int(events.get('minutes', '0'))
                    return {'duration': 'PT{}M'.format(max(minutes, 0))}
            outputs:
              - Name: duration
                Selector: $.duration
                Type: String

          - name: PauseDynamoDBReplication
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: pause_replication
              InputPayload:
                target_region: '{{ TargetRegion }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def pause_replication(events, context):
                    target_region = events.get('target_region')
                    client = boto3.client('dynamodb', region_name=target_region)
                    state = {}

                    try:
                        global_tables = client.list_global_tables().get('GlobalTables', [])
                    except ClientError as e:
                        raise RuntimeError('Failed to list DynamoDB global tables: {}'.format(e))

                    for gt in global_tables:
                        name = gt.get('GlobalTableName')
                        if not name:
                            continue

                        try:
                            description = client.describe_global_table(GlobalTableName=name)['GlobalTableDescription']
                        except ClientError:
                            continue

                        table_arn = description.get('GlobalTableArn')
                        if not table_arn:
                            continue

                        try:
                            tags = client.list_tags_of_resource(ResourceArn=table_arn).get('Tags', [])
                        except ClientError:
                            continue

                        if not any(t['Key'] == 'ChaosAllowed' and t['Value'] == 'true' for t in tags):
                            continue

                        replicas = description.get('ReplicationGroup', [])
                        target_replicas = [r for r in replicas if r.get('RegionName') == target_region]
                        if not target_replicas:
                            continue

                        replica_state = []
                        for r in target_replicas:
                            replica_details = {'RegionName': r['RegionName']}
                            if r.get('KMSMasterKeyId'):
                                replica_details['KMSMasterKeyId'] = r['KMSMasterKeyId']
                            if r.get('ProvisionedThroughputOverride'):
                                replica_details['ProvisionedThroughputOverride'] = r['ProvisionedThroughputOverride']
                            replica_state.append(replica_details)

                        try:
                            client.update_global_table(
                                GlobalTableName=name,
                                ReplicaUpdates=[{'Delete': {'RegionName': target_region}}]
                            )
                        except ClientError as e:
                            code = e.response['Error'].get('Code', '')
                            if code not in ('ReplicaNotFoundException', 'ValidationException'):
                                raise

                        state[name] = replica_state

                    return {'state': json.dumps(state)}
            outputs:
              - Name: state
                Selector: $.state
                Type: String

          - name: Sleep
            action: aws:sleep
            inputs:
              Duration: '{{ BuildSleepDuration.duration }}'

          - name: RestoreDynamoDBReplication
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: restore_replication
              InputPayload:
                target_region: '{{ TargetRegion }}'
                state: '{{ PauseDynamoDBReplication.state }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json

                def restore_replication(events, context):
                    target_region = events.get('target_region')
                    client = boto3.client('dynamodb', region_name=target_region)
                    state = json.loads(events.get('state', '{}'))

                    for name, replica_states in state.items():
                        updates = []
                        for r in replica_states:
                            create = {'RegionName': r['RegionName']}
                            if 'KMSMasterKeyId' in r:
                                create['KMSMasterKeyId'] = r['KMSMasterKeyId']
                            if 'ProvisionedThroughputOverride' in r:
                                create['ProvisionedThroughputOverride'] = r['ProvisionedThroughputOverride']
                            updates.append({'Create': create})

                        if updates:
                            client.update_global_table(GlobalTableName=name, ReplicaUpdates=updates)

  DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivityDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: FIS-DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Disrupts transit gateway routes toward the target region for a configured
          duration by replacing static routes with blackhole routes and disabling
          route table propagations. The original configuration is restored afterward.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role used by this automation.
          TargetRegion:
            type: String
            description: AWS region whose routes should be disrupted.
          PauseDurationMinutes:
            type: Integer
            description: Number of minutes to keep connectivity disrupted.
        mainSteps:
          - name: BuildSleepDuration
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 60
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: build_duration
              InputPayload:
                minutes: '{{ PauseDurationMinutes }}'
              Script: |
                def build_duration(events, context):
                    minutes = int(events.get('minutes', '0'))
                    return {'duration': 'PT{}M'.format(max(minutes, 0))}
            outputs:
              - Name: duration
                Selector: $.duration
                Type: String

          - name: DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: disrupt_connectivity
              InputPayload:
                target_region: '{{ TargetRegion }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def disrupt_connectivity(events, context):
                    target_region = events.get('target_region')
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', region_name=target_region)
                    state = {}

                    try:
                        tgws = ec2.describe_transit_gateways().get('TransitGateways', [])
                    except ClientError as e:
                        raise RuntimeError('Failed to list transit gateways: {}'.format(e))

                    for tgw in tgws:
                        tgw_id = tgw['TransitGatewayId']

                        rt_paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_transit_gateway_route_tables')
                        try:
                            rt_pages = rt_paginator.paginate(
                                Filters=[{'Name': 'transit-gateway-id', 'Values': [tgw_id]}]
                            )
                        except ClientError:
                            continue

                        for rt_page in rt_pages:
                            for rt in rt_page.get('TransitGatewayRouteTables', []):
                                rt_id = rt['TransitGatewayRouteTableId']

                                try:
                                    tags = ec2.describe_tags(
                                        Filters=[{'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [rt_id]}]
                                    ).get('Tags', [])
                                except ClientError:
                                    tags = []

                                if not any(t['Key'] == 'ChaosAllowed' and t['Value'] == 'true' for t in tags):
                                    continue

                                state[rt_id] = {
                                    'original_routes': [],
                                    'propagations': []
                                }

                                try:
                                    prop_paginator = ec2.get_paginator('get_transit_gateway_route_table_propagations')
                                    for prop_page in prop_paginator.paginate(TransitGatewayRouteTableId=rt_id):
                                        for prop in prop_page.get('TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagations', []):
                                            attachment_id = prop['TransitGatewayAttachmentId']
                                            state[rt_id]['propagations'].append({
                                                'TransitGatewayAttachmentId': attachment_id
                                            })
                                            ec2.disable_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation(
                                                TransitGatewayRouteTableId=rt_id,
                                                TransitGatewayAttachmentId=attachment_id
                                            )
                                except ClientError:
                                    pass

                                try:
                                    route_paginator = ec2.get_paginator('search_transit_gateway_routes')
                                    for route_page in route_paginator.paginate(
                                        TransitGatewayRouteTableId=rt_id,
                                        Filters=[{'Name': 'type', 'Values': ['static']}]
                                    ):
                                        for route in route_page.get('Routes', []):
                                            dest = route.get('DestinationCidrBlock')
                                            if not dest:
                                                continue

                                            attachments = route.get('TransitGatewayAttachments') or []
                                            attachment_id = attachments[0].get('TransitGatewayAttachmentId') if attachments else None

                                            state[rt_id]['original_routes'].append({
                                                'DestinationCidrBlock': dest,
                                                'TransitGatewayAttachmentId': attachment_id,
                                                'Blackhole': route.get('Blackhole', False)
                                            })

                                            try:
                                                ec2.delete_transit_gateway_route(
                                                    TransitGatewayRouteTableId=rt_id,
                                                    DestinationCidrBlock=dest
                                                )
                                            except ClientError:
                                                pass

                                            try:
                                                ec2.create_transit_gateway_route(
                                                    TransitGatewayRouteTableId=rt_id,
                                                    DestinationCidrBlock=dest,
                                                    Blackhole=True
                                                )
                                            except ClientError:
                                                pass
                                except ClientError:
                                    pass

                    return {'state': json.dumps(state)}
            outputs:
              - Name: state
                Selector: $.state
                Type: String

          - name: Sleep
            action: aws:sleep
            inputs:
              Duration: '{{ BuildSleepDuration.duration }}'

          - name: RestoreTransitGatewayConnectivity
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: restore_connectivity
              InputPayload:
                target_region: '{{ TargetRegion }}'
                state: '{{ DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity.state }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def restore_connectivity(events, context):
                    target_region = events.get('target_region')
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', region_name=target_region)
                    state = json.loads(events.get('state', '{}'))

                    for rt_id, info in state.items():
                        try:
                            route_paginator = ec2.get_paginator('search_transit_gateway_routes')
                            for route_page in route_paginator.paginate(
                                TransitGatewayRouteTableId=rt_id,
                                Filters=[{'Name': 'type', 'Values': ['static']}]
                            ):
                                for route in route_page.get('Routes', []):
                                    if route.get('Blackhole'):
                                        ec2.delete_transit_gateway_route(
                                            TransitGatewayRouteTableId=rt_id,
                                            DestinationCidrBlock=route['DestinationCidrBlock']
                                        )
                        except ClientError:
                            pass

                        for original in info.get('original_routes', []):
                            kwargs = {
                                'TransitGatewayRouteTableId': rt_id,
                                'DestinationCidrBlock': original['DestinationCidrBlock']
                            }
                            if original.get('TransitGatewayAttachmentId'):
                                kwargs['TransitGatewayAttachmentId'] = original['TransitGatewayAttachmentId']
                            else:
                                kwargs['Blackhole'] = original.get('Blackhole', False)

                            try:
                                ec2.create_transit_gateway_route(**kwargs)
                            except ClientError:
                                pass

                        for prop in info.get('propagations', []):
                            try:
                                ec2.enable_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation(
                                    TransitGatewayRouteTableId=rt_id,
                                    TransitGatewayAttachmentId=prop['TransitGatewayAttachmentId']
                                )
                            except ClientError:
                                pass

  DisruptSubnetConnectivityDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: FIS-DisruptSubnetConnectivity
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Blocks application network traffic from subnets tagged ChaosAllowed=true
          by associating a temporary deny-all network ACL. The original network ACL
          association is restored after the configured duration.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role used by this automation.
          TargetRegion:
            type: String
            description: Target region whose connectivity should be disrupted.
          PauseDurationMinutes:
            type: Integer
            description: Number of minutes to keep connectivity disrupted.
        mainSteps:
          - name: BuildSleepDuration
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 60
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: build_duration
              InputPayload:
                minutes: '{{ PauseDurationMinutes }}'
              Script: |
                def build_duration(events, context):
                    minutes = int(events.get('minutes', '0'))
                    return {'duration': 'PT{}M'.format(max(minutes, 0))}
            outputs:
              - Name: duration
                Selector: $.duration
                Type: String

          - name: DisruptSubnetConnectivity
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: disrupt_connectivity
              InputPayload:
                target_region: '{{ TargetRegion }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def disrupt_connectivity(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    state = {}

                    try:
                        tags = ec2.describe_tags(
                            Filters=[
                                {'Name': 'key', 'Values': ['ChaosAllowed']},
                                {'Name': 'value', 'Values': ['true']}
                            ]
                        ).get('Tags', [])
                        subnet_ids = [t['ResourceId'] for t in tags if t.get('ResourceType') == 'subnet']
                    except ClientError as e:
                        raise RuntimeError('Failed to discover tagged subnets: {}'.format(e))

                    if not subnet_ids:
                        return {'state': json.dumps(state)}

                    try:
                        subnets = ec2.describe_subnets(SubnetIds=subnet_ids).get('Subnets', [])
                    except ClientError as e:
                        raise RuntimeError('Failed to describe subnets: {}'.format(e))

                    for subnet in subnets:
                        subnet_id = subnet['SubnetId']
                        vpc_id = subnet['VpcId']

                        try:
                            acls = ec2.describe_network_acls(
                                Filters=[{'Name': 'association.subnet-id', 'Values': [subnet_id]}]
                            ).get('NetworkAcls', [])
                        except ClientError as e:
                            raise RuntimeError('Failed to describe network ACLs: {}'.format(e))

                        original_acl_id = None
                        current_association_id = None

                        for acl in acls:
                            for assoc in acl.get('Associations', []):
                                if assoc.get('SubnetId') == subnet_id:
                                    original_acl_id = acl['NetworkAclId']
                                    current_association_id = assoc['NetworkAclAssociationId']
                                    break
                            if original_acl_id:
                                break

                        if not original_acl_id or not current_association_id:
                            continue

                        try:
                            temp_acl_id = ec2.create_network_acl(VpcId=vpc_id)['NetworkAcl']['NetworkAclId']
                            ec2.create_network_acl_entry(
                                NetworkAclId=temp_acl_id,
                                RuleNumber=100,
                                Protocol='-1',
                                RuleAction='deny',
                                Egress=False,
                                CidrBlock='0.0.0.0/0'
                            )
                            ec2.create_network_acl_entry(
                                NetworkAclId=temp_acl_id,
                                RuleNumber=100,
                                Protocol='-1',
                                RuleAction='deny',
                                Egress=True,
                                CidrBlock='0.0.0.0/0'
                            )
                            ec2.replace_network_acl_association(
                                AssociationId=current_association_id,
                                NetworkAclId=temp_acl_id
                            )
                        except ClientError as e:
                            raise RuntimeError('Failed to disrupt subnet connectivity: {}'.format(e))

                        state[subnet_id] = {
                            'original_acl_id': original_acl_id,
                            'temp_acl_id': temp_acl_id
                        }

                    return {'state': json.dumps(state)}
            outputs:
              - Name: state
                Selector: $.state
                Type: String

          - name: Sleep
            action: aws:sleep
            inputs:
              Duration: '{{ BuildSleepDuration.duration }}'

          - name: RestoreSubnetConnectivity
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: restore_connectivity
              InputPayload:
                state: '{{ DisruptSubnetConnectivity.state }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def restore_connectivity(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    state = json.loads(events.get('state', '{}'))

                    for subnet_id, info in state.items():
                        try:
                            acls = ec2.describe_network_acls(
                                Filters=[{'Name': 'association.subnet-id', 'Values': [subnet_id]}]
                            ).get('NetworkAcls', [])
                        except ClientError:
                            continue

                        current_association_id = None
                        for acl in acls:
                            for assoc in acl.get('Associations', []):
                                if assoc.get('SubnetId') == subnet_id:
                                    current_association_id = assoc['NetworkAclAssociationId']
                                    break
                            if current_association_id:
                                break

                        if current_association_id:
                            try:
                                ec2.replace_network_acl_association(
                                    AssociationId=current_association_id,
                                    NetworkAclId=info['original_acl_id']
                                )
                            except ClientError:
                                pass

                        try:
                            ec2.delete_network_acl(NetworkAclId=info['temp_acl_id'])
                        except ClientError:
                            pass

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC network foundation for Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS'

Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-on-eks
    Description: Name of the EMR on EKS cluster (used for Kubernetes tags)
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-on-eks
    Description: Prefix for resource Name tags
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/26
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in first AZ
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.64/26
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in second AZ
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.128/26
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in first AZ
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in second AZ

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ClusterName}'
          Value: shared

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ClusterName}'
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ClusterName}'
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ClusterName}'
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ClusterName}'
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: EC2 Image Builder test pipeline with Chef Client custom component, custom build workflow, and lifecycle policy.
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-vpc

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-build-subnet

  BuildRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-build-rt

  BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 Image Builder build instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-sg

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref BuildRouteTable

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  LifecyclePolicyFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  LifecyclePolicyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import logging
          import re

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          client = boto3.client('imagebuilder')

          def send(event, context, status, data, physical_resource_id, reason=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or ('OK' if status == 'SUCCESS' else 'See details'),
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or 'NO_PHYSICAL_ID',
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'ResponseData': data or {}
              }).encode()
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'],
                  data=body,
                  headers={'Content-Type': ''},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(request)

          def is_valid_arn(arn):
              pattern = r'^arn:aws(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*:imagebuilder:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]:(?:[0-9]{12}|aws):lifecycle-policy/[a-z0-9-_]+$'
              return bool(re.match(pattern, arn or ''))

          def build_filter(prop_filter):
              return {
                  'type': prop_filter.get('Type', 'AGE'),
                  'value': int(prop_filter.get('Value', 180)),
                  'unit': prop_filter.get('Unit', 'DAYS')
              }

          def handler(event, context):
              print(json.dumps(event))
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')

              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      if not is_valid_arn(physical_id):
                          send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)
                          return
                      client.delete_lifecycle_policy(lifecyclePolicyArn=physical_id)
                      send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)
                      return

                  pd_list = props.get('PolicyDetails', [])
                  pd = pd_list[0] if pd_list else {}
                  action = pd.get('Action', {})
                  filter_obj = pd.get('Filter', {})

                  policy_details = [{
                      'action': {'type': action.get('Type', 'DEPRECATE')},
                      'filter': build_filter(filter_obj)
                  }]

                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Update':
                      if not is_valid_arn(physical_id):
                          raise RuntimeError('Update received without a valid lifecycle policy ARN')
                      client.update_lifecycle_policy(
                          lifecyclePolicyArn=physical_id,
                          executionRole=props.get('ExecutionRole', ''),
                          resourceType=props.get('ResourceType', 'AMI_IMAGE'),
                          resourceSelection={'tagMap': props.get('TagMap', {})},
                          policyDetails=policy_details,
                          status=props.get('Status', 'ENABLED')
                      )
                      send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)
                      return

                  # Create
                  response = client.create_lifecycle_policy(
                      name=props.get('Name', 'sample-lifecycle-policy'),
                      executionRole=props.get('ExecutionRole', ''),
                      resourceType=props.get('ResourceType', 'AMI_IMAGE'),
                      resourceSelection={'tagMap': props.get('TagMap', {})},
                      policyDetails=policy_details,
                      status=props.get('Status', 'ENABLED')
                  )
                  arn = response.get('lifecyclePolicyArn')
                  if not arn and isinstance(response.get('lifecyclePolicy'), dict):
                      arn = response['lifecyclePolicy'].get('arn')
                  if not arn:
                      raise RuntimeError('create_lifecycle_policy did not return lifecyclePolicyArn: ' + json.dumps(response))
                  send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, arn)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception(e)
                  reason = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                  send(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)}, physical_id, reason)

  LifecyclePolicyFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LifecyclePolicyFunction
      Principal: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/${AWS::StackName}/*

  ArtifactBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable root account permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-artifact-bucket-key

  SampleArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ArtifactBucketKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ArtifactLoaderFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ArtifactLoaderS3AndLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${SampleArtifactBucket}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactBucketKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*

  ArtifactLoaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt ArtifactLoaderFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 600
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          s3 = boto3.client('s3')

          def send(event, context, status, data, physical_resource_id):
              body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': 'See details' if status == 'FAILED' else 'OK',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'ResponseData': data or {}
              }).encode()
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'],
                  data=body,
                  headers={'Content-Type': ''},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(request)

          def handler(event, context):
              print(json.dumps(event))
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, event.get('PhysicalResourceId'))
                      return
                  bucket = props['Bucket']
                  chef_url = props['ChefClientUrl']
                  ssm_url = props['SSMAgentUrl']
                  urllib.request.urlretrieve(chef_url, '/tmp/chef-client.rpm')
                  urllib.request.urlretrieve(ssm_url, '/tmp/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm')
                  s3.upload_file('/tmp/chef-client.rpm', bucket, 'chef-client.rpm')
                  s3.upload_file('/tmp/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm', bucket, 'amazon-ssm-agent.rpm')
                  send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, event.get('PhysicalResourceId'))
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception(e)
                  send(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)}, event.get('PhysicalResourceId'))

  ArtifactLoaderFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ArtifactLoaderFunction
      Principal: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/${AWS::StackName}/*

  ArtifactLoaderResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: ArtifactLoaderFunctionPermission
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ArtifactLoaderFunction.Arn
      Bucket: !Ref SampleArtifactBucket

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Installs and runs Chef Client on Linux
      Data: !Sub |
        name: sample-component
        description: Installs and runs Chef Client on Linux
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefClient
                action: WebDownload
                inputs:
                  - source: https://${SampleArtifactBucket}.s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/chef-client.rpm
                    destination: /tmp/chef-client.rpm
                    overwrite: true
              - name: InstallChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum install -y /tmp/chef-client.rpm
              - name: RunChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo chef-client --version || sudo /opt/chef/bin/chef-client --version

  SampleWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Type: BUILD
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
      Data: !Sub |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        steps:
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            inputs:
              instanceId: "{{ imagebuilder:instanceId }}"
              documentName: AWS-RunShellScript
              parameters:
                commands:
                  - aws s3 cp s3://${SampleArtifactBucket}/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm /tmp/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm
                  - sudo rpm -Uvh /tmp/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm

            action: CreateImage
            inputs:
              - name: imageName
                value: sample-image-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}

  SampleRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image-recipe/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/1.0.0
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SampleComponent
        - ComponentArn: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/1.0.0
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2

  SampleInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  SampleDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "sample-image-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            AmiTags:
              Environment: Dev
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    DependsOn: ArtifactLoaderResource
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref SampleRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleDistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 9 * * ? *)"
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !Ref SampleWorkflow
      Status: ENABLED

  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: LifecyclePolicyFunctionPermission
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyFunction.Arn
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn

        Environment: Dev
      PolicyDetails:

            Type: AGE
            Unit: DAYS
            Value: 180
      Status: ENABLED

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito authentication layer for Lex chatbot web UI

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: identity pool
    Description: Name for the Cognito Identity Pool
  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: OrderFlowers
    Description: Name of the Lex V1 bot (used when LexV2BotId is empty)
  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Lex V2 Bot ID (if provided, Lex V2 is used)
  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Lex V2 Bot Alias ID (required if LexV2BotId is provided)
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, deny unauthenticated Lex and API actions
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, add execute-api invoke permission for live chat
  LiveChatApiId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: API Gateway ID for live chat (required if ShouldEnableLiveChat is true)

Conditions:
  HasLexV2BotId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, '']]
  IsForceCognitoLogin: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'true']
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, 'true']

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${IdentityPoolName}-web-ui-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false

  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}'

  AuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-auth-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LexBotPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: !If
                  - HasLexV2BotId
                  - [lex:RecognizeText, lex:RecognizeUtterance]
                  - [lex:PostText, lex:PostContent]
                Resource: !If
                  - HasLexV2BotId
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*'
        - PolicyName: PollyPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: '*'
        - !If
          - EnableLiveChat
          - PolicyName: LiveChatPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${LiveChatApiId}/*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  UnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-unauth-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LexBotPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: !If
                  - HasLexV2BotId
                  - [lex:RecognizeText, lex:RecognizeUtterance]
                  - [lex:PostText, lex:PostContent]
                Resource: !If
                  - HasLexV2BotId
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*'
        - !If
          - IsForceCognitoLogin
          - PolicyName: DenyPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - lex:*
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - EnableLiveChat
          - PolicyName: LiveChatPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${LiveChatApiId}/*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: Cognito Identity Pool ID
    Value: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool Client ID
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Customer support authentication infrastructure using Amazon Cognito"

Parameters:
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$"
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: List<String>
    Default: "https://app.example.com/callback"
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: List<String>
    Default: "https://app.example.com/logout"

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: customersupport-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt AddCustomerToGroupLambda.Arn

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupName: admin
      Description: "Administrator group with higher precedence"
      Precedence: 10

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupName: customer
      Description: "Default group for customer support users"
      Precedence: 5

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: agentcore
      Name: agentcore
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: "Read access to agent core customer support resources"

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-web-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agentcore/read
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-m2m-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agentcore/read
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub "${DomainPrefix}-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  LambdaExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: customersupport-lambda-execution-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAdminAddUserToGroup
            Effect: Allow
            Action: cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
            Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AddCustomerToGroupLambda}:*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AddCustomerToGroupLambda}:log-stream:*"

  AddCustomerToGroupLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=event['userPoolId'],
                  Username=event['userName'],
                  GroupName='customer'
              )
              return event

  AddCustomerToGroupLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref AddCustomerToGroupLambda
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/userPoolId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: "Cognito user pool ID for customer support system"

  WebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/webClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient
      Description: "Cognito web app client ID for agent core"

  M2MClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/m2mClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MClient
      Description: "Cognito machine-to-machine client ID for agent core"

  OAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/oauthScope
      Type: String
      Value: agentcore/read
      Description: "Custom OAuth scope for agent core"

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/discoveryUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      Description: "OIDC discovery URL for the Cognito user pool"

  TokenEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/tokenEndpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
      Description: "OAuth2 token endpoint for the Cognito user pool"

  AuthorizeEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/authorizeEndpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"
      Description: "OAuth2 authorize endpoint for the Cognito user pool"

  DomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      Description: "Cognito hosted UI domain"
