AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public and private subnets, NAT Gateways, and routing"

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.10.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.0.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.1.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.10.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.11.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-InternetGateway"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1EIP"

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2EIP"

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable1"

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable2"

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "ID of the VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcCidr:
    Description: "CIDR block of the VPC"
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of availability zones used"
    Value: !Join [",", [!GetAtt PublicSubnet1.AvailabilityZone, !GetAtt PublicSubnet2.AvailabilityZone]]

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Route53 hosted zone for prxu.org (Production) with Google Workspace records,
  CloudFront CDN distributions with ACM certificates, and supporting DNS records.
  NOTE: This template assumes S3 bucket origins for CloudFront distributions.
  Additional Google Workspace records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) are out of scope.
  ACM DNS validation uses a custom Lambda function to create validation CNAMEs.
  By default (empty parameters), only MX, CDN alias, and legacy CNAMEs are created.
  The Google Workspace TXT record and feed-proxy/router CNAMEs are created only
  when the deployment pipeline supplies non‑empty values.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: prxu.org
    Description: The domain name for the hosted zone (e.g., prxu.org)
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    AllowedValues:
      - Production
      - Staging
      - Development
    Description: Environment tag value
  DeployCDN:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >
      Set to "true" only after the zone NS records have been delegated at the registrar.
      When false (default), the stack creates only DNS foundation (hosted zone, MX, legacy
      CNAMEs, and optional Google TXT/proxy/router records). When true, all CDN
      distributions, ACM certificates, KMS keys, WAF, and alias records are created.
  GoogleWorkspaceVerificationTXT:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    NoEcho: true
    Description: >
      The Google Workspace domain verification token (e.g., google-site-verification=...).
      Must be supplied by the deployment pipeline when creating the TXT record.
      An empty string (default) omits the record.
  LegacyCNAME1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: legacy1.prxu.org
    Description: First legacy CNAME record name (fully qualified)
  LegacyCNAME1Target:
    Type: String
    Default: dovetail-cdn.prxu.org
    Description: Target for first legacy CNAME (must be a dovetail-cdn subdomain)
  LegacyCNAME2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: legacy2.prxu.org
    Description: Second legacy CNAME record name (fully qualified)
  LegacyCNAME2Target:
    Type: String
    Default: dovetail-cdn-staging.prxu.org
    Description: Target for second legacy CNAME (must be a dovetail-cdn subdomain)
  FeedProxyProdTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Target CNAME for feed-proxy.prxu.org (e.g., some-load-balancer-123.elb.amazonaws.com). Empty default omits the record.
  FeedProxyStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Target CNAME for feed-proxy-staging.prxu.org. Empty default omits the record.
  RouterProdTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Target CNAME for router.prxu.org. Empty default omits the record.
  RouterStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Target CNAME for router-staging.prxu.org. Empty default omits the record.

Conditions:
  DeployCDNEnabled: !Equals [!Ref DeployCDN, "true"]
  HasGoogleWorkspaceVerificationTXT: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GoogleWorkspaceVerificationTXT, ""]]
  HasFeedProxyProdTarget: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FeedProxyProdTarget, ""]]
  HasFeedProxyStagingTarget: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FeedProxyStagingTarget, ""]]
  HasRouterProdTarget: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RouterProdTarget, ""]]
  HasRouterStagingTarget: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RouterStagingTarget, ""]]

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route53 Hosted Zone
  # NOTE: This zone must be created in a Route 53 account with no pre-existing
  #       hosted zone for the same domain. If previous deployments left orphaned
  #       zones, delete them out-of-band before re-deploying.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${DomainName}."
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub "Production hosted zone for ${DomainName}"
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # ACM Certificates (must be in us-east-1 for CloudFront)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  CDNCertificate:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub "dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}"
      SubjectAlternativeNames:
        - !Sub "dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}"
        - !Sub "f.${DomainName}"
        - !Sub "f-staging.${DomainName}"
        - !Sub "f.development.${DomainName}"
        - !Sub "a.${DomainName}"
        - !Sub "ryan-cdn.${DomainName}"
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Sub "dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
        - DomainName: !Sub "dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
        - DomainName: !Sub "f.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
        - DomainName: !Sub "f-staging.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
        - DomainName: !Sub "f.development.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
        - DomainName: !Sub "a.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
        - DomainName: !Sub "ryan-cdn.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FeedProxyCertificate:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub "feed-proxy.${DomainName}"
      SubjectAlternativeNames:
        - !Sub "feed-proxy-staging.${DomainName}"
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Sub "feed-proxy.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
        - DomainName: !Sub "feed-proxy-staging.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RouterCertificate:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub "router.${DomainName}"
      SubjectAlternativeNames:
        - !Sub "router-staging.${DomainName}"
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Sub "router.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
        - DomainName: !Sub "router-staging.${DomainName}"
          ValidationDomain: !Ref DomainName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda-backed custom resource for ACM DNS validation
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  ACMValidationRole:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ACMValidationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - acm:DescribeCertificate
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets
                  - route53:ListResourceRecordSets
                  - route53:GetChange
                Resource: '*'

  ACMValidationFunction:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt ACMValidationRole.Arn
      Timeout: 900
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, cfnresponse, time
          acm = boto3.client('acm')
          r53 = boto3.client('route53')

          def wait_for_records(cert_arn, timeout=800):
              deadline = time.time() + timeout
              while time.time() < deadline:
                  cert = acm.describe_certificate(CertificateArn=cert_arn)
                  opts = cert['Certificate']['DomainValidationOptions']
                  records = [(o['ResourceRecord']['Name'], o['ResourceRecord']['Type'], o['ResourceRecord']['Value'])
                              for o in opts if 'ResourceRecord' in o]
                  if len(records) == len(opts):
                      return records
                  time.sleep(5)
              raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for validation records from ACM")

          def upsert_records(zone_id, records):
              changes = [{
                  'Action': 'UPSERT',
                  'ResourceRecordSet': {
                      'Name': r[0],
                      'Type': r[1],
                      'TTL': 60,
                      'ResourceRecords': [{'Value': r[2]}]
                  }
              } for r in records]
              r53.change_resource_record_sets(HostedZoneId=zone_id, ChangeBatch={'Changes': changes})

          def delete_records(zone_id, records):
              changes = [{
                  'Action': 'DELETE',
                  'ResourceRecordSet': {
                      'Name': r[0],
                      'Type': r[1],
                      'TTL': 60,
                      'ResourceRecords': [{'Value': r[2]}]
                  }
              } for r in records]
              r53.change_resource_record_sets(HostedZoneId=zone_id, ChangeBatch={'Changes': changes})

          def wait_issuance(cert_arn, timeout=800):
              deadline = time.time() + timeout
              while time.time() < deadline:
                  cert = acm.describe_certificate(CertificateArn=cert_arn)
                  status = cert['Certificate']['Status']
                  if status == 'ISSUED':
                      return
                  if status in ['FAILED', 'VALIDATION_TIMED_OUT']:
                      raise RuntimeError(f"Certificate issuance failed with status {status}")
                  time.sleep(10)
              raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for certificate issuance")

          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              cert_arn = props.get('CertificateArn')
              zone_id = props.get('HostedZoneId')
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', cert_arn)
              request_type = event['RequestType']

              try:
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      records = wait_for_records(cert_arn)
                      upsert_records(zone_id, records)
                      wait_issuance(cert_arn)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          records = wait_for_records(cert_arn, timeout=30)
                      except Exception:
                          # certificate already deleted, nothing to clean
                          cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                          return
                      delete_records(zone_id, records)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Message': str(e)}, physical_id)

  ACMValidationPermission:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt ACMValidationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/${AWS::StackName}/*"
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  CDNValidationRecords:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ACMValidationFunction.Arn
      CertificateArn: !Ref CDNCertificate
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

  FeedProxyValidationRecords:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ACMValidationFunction.Arn
      CertificateArn: !Ref FeedProxyCertificate
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

  RouterValidationRecords:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ACMValidationFunction.Arn
      CertificateArn: !Ref RouterCertificate
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Key for S3 bucket encryption (customer-managed)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  OriginEncryptionKey:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for S3 bucket encryption in ${AWS::StackName}"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  OriginEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Condition: DeployCDNEnabled
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-s3-origin-encryption"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref OriginEncryptionKey

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # WAF WebACL for CloudFront
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  # Unconditional record group (always created)

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      RecordSets:
        # Google Workspace MX records
        - Name: !Ref DomainName
          Type: MX
          TTL: 300
          ResourceRecords:
            - "10 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
            - "20 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
            - "20 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
            - "30 ASPMX2.GOOGLEMAIL.COM."
            - "30 ASPMX3.GOOGLEMAIL.COM."
            - "30 ASPMX4.GOOGLEMAIL.COM."
            - "30 ASPMX5.GOOGLEMAIL.COM."

        # Legacy CNAME records (assumed names, adjust as needed)
        - Name: !Ref LegacyCNAME1Name
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref LegacyCNAME1Target
        - Name: !Ref LegacyCNAME2Name
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref LegacyCNAME2Target

        - Name: !Sub "dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}"

          AliasTarget:

            DNSName: !GetAtt DovetailCDNDistribution.DomainName

          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

          AliasTarget:

          AliasTarget:

          AliasTarget:

            DNSName: !GetAtt FeederDevelopmentDistribution.DomainName
        - Name: !Sub "a.${DomainName}"

          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
            DNSName: !GetAtt DovetailCDNDistribution.DomainName

        - Name: !Sub "f-staging.${DomainName}"

        - Name: !Sub "a.${DomainName}"

        - Name: !Sub "ryan-cdn.${DomainName}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained, learning-purpose VPC stack for a greenfield AWS account.
  This template creates a VPC and optional internet gateway, public subnet,
  route table, and security group controlled by boolean parameters. Every
  resource referenced is created inside this template; no pre-existing VPC,
  subnet, gateway, security group, or external infrastructure is used.

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Prefix applied to the Name tags of all created resources.

  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet.

  SourceIPRange:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    Description: Source IP range allowed to reach HTTP and HTTPS on the security group.

  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the internet gateway and gateway attachment.

  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the public subnet.

  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the route table.

  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the security group.

Conditions:
  IsCreateInternetGateway: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, 'true']
  IsCreatePublicSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, 'true']
  IsCreateRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, 'true']
  IsCreateSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, 'true']
  IsCreateIGWRoute: !And
    - !Condition IsCreateRouteTable
    - !Condition IsCreateInternetGateway
  IsCreateSubnetRouteAssoc: !And
    - !Condition IsCreateRouteTable
    - !Condition IsCreatePublicSubnet

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: IsCreateInternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: IsCreateInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsCreatePublicSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-public-subnet"

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsCreateRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-rt"

  Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsCreateIGWRoute
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsCreateSubnetRouteAssoc
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: IsCreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group allowing HTTP and HTTPS from the specified source IP range.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-sg"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Landing Zone Hub VPC with Transit Gateway, VPC Endpoints, and Flow Logs'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Prefix used for naming resources and tags

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ1

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ2

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ1

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ2

  TransitGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: Private ASN for Transit Gateway

  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: Retention period for VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-public-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-public-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-private-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-private-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-nat-eip-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-nat-eip-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-nat-gw-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-nat-gw-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Tables (one per AZ)
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-private-rt-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-private-rt-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Private routes to NAT Gateways
  PrivateRoute1Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  # Private routes to Transit Gateway (10.0.0.0/8)
  PrivateRoute1ToTgw:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - TransitGateway
      - TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateRoute2ToTgw:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - TransitGateway
      - TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # Subnet associations for private subnets
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # Transit Gateway
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Transit Gateway VPC Attachment
  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-tgw-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogCloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentPrefix}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-flow-log-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogCloudWatchLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Security Group for VPC Endpoints
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # VPC Interface Endpoints
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ssm-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ec2messages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ssmmessages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # VPC Gateway Endpoint for S3
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-s3-gateway-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: LandingZone
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:

    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-id'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-public-subnet-ids'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Private subnet IDs

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-private-subnet-ids'

    Export:

    Export:

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID for VPC endpoints
    Value: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-endpoint-sg-id'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Student Services Agent Infrastructure

Resources:
  StudentServicesBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Path: /student-services/
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "bedrock:InvokeModel"
              - "bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream"
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*'
          - Sid: BedrockAgentCoreCloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "cloudwatch:PutMetricData"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cloudwatch:namespace": "bedrock-agentcore"
          - Sid: BedrockAgentCoreCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
              - "logs:CreateLogStream"
              - "logs:PutLogEvents"
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*'
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "xray:PutTraceSegments"
              - "xray:PutTelemetryRecords"
              - "xray:GetSamplingRules"
              - "xray:GetSamplingTargets"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: StudentServicesParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ssm:GetParameter"
              - "ssm:GetParameters"
              - "ssm:GetParametersByPath"
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*'

  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: student-services-agent-orchestrator
      Path: /student-services/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockAgentCoreAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                "aws:SourceArn": !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy

  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: course-registration-agent
      Path: /student-services/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockAgentCoreAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                "aws:SourceArn": !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: course-registration-dynamodb-full-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: FullDynamoDBAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "dynamodb:*"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*'

  CourseCatalogExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: course-catalog-agent
      Path: /student-services/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockAgentCoreAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                "aws:SourceArn": !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: course-catalog-knowledge-base-retrieve
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RetrieveFromKnowledgeBases
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "bedrock:Retrieve"
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:knowledge-base/*'

  CourseReviewExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: course-review-agent
      Path: /student-services/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockAgentCoreAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                "aws:SourceArn": !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: course-review-dynamodb-read-only
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadOnlyDynamoDBAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "dynamodb:GetItem"
                  - "dynamodb:BatchGetItem"
                  - "dynamodb:Query"
                  - "dynamodb:Scan"
                  - "dynamodb:DescribeTable"
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'

  LoanApplicationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: loan-application-agent
      Path: /student-services/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockAgentCoreAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                "aws:SourceArn": !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Policies:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - Log-Based Monitoring Controls"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used as prefix for resource names.
  LogGroupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: Number of days to retain log events in the CloudWatch Logs log group.
Resources:
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-CloudTrailLogGroup"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionDays
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:GetKeyPolicy
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:EnableKey
              - kms:UpdateKeyDescription
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: "*"
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-AlarmNotifications"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  SNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: "*"
      Topics:
        - !Ref SNSTopic
  UnauthorizedAPICallsMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-UnauthorizedAPICalls-MetricFilter"
      FilterPattern: |-
        { ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied") || ($.errorCode = "UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "Client.UnauthorizedOperation") }
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-UnauthorizedAPICalls"
          MetricNamespace: CIS3
          MetricValue: "1"
  ConsoleSignInWithoutMFAMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA-MetricFilter"
      FilterPattern: |-
        { ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") }
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA"
          MetricNamespace: CIS3
          MetricValue: "1"
  RootAccountUsageMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-RootAccountUsage-MetricFilter"
      FilterPattern: |-
        { ($.userIdentity.type = "Root") }
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-RootAccountUsage"
          MetricNamespace: CIS3
          MetricValue: "1"
  IAMPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-IAMPolicyChanges-MetricFilter"
      FilterPattern: |-
        { ($.eventName = "CreatePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachRolePolicy") }
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-IAMPolicyChanges"
          MetricNamespace: CIS3
          MetricValue: "1"
  CloudTrailConfigurationChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-CloudTrailConfigurationChanges-MetricFilter"
      FilterPattern: |-
        { ($.eventName = "CreateTrail") || ($.eventName = "UpdateTrail") || ($.eventName = "DeleteTrail") || ($.eventName = "StartLogging") || ($.eventName = "StopLogging") }
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-CloudTrailConfigurationChanges"
          MetricNamespace: CIS3
          MetricValue: "1"
  ConsoleLoginFailuresMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-ConsoleLoginFailures-MetricFilter"
      FilterPattern: |-
        { ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.errorCode != "") }
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-ConsoleLoginFailures"
          MetricNamespace: CIS3
          MetricValue: "1"
  KMSKeyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-KMSKeyChanges-MetricFilter"
      FilterPattern: |-
        { ($.eventName = "DisableKey") || ($.eventName = "ScheduleKeyDeletion") || ($.eventName = "CancelKeyDeletion") }
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3-KMSKeyChanges"
          MetricNamespace: CIS3
          MetricValue: "1"
  S3BucketPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Event-driven Security Hub deployment across an AWS Control Tower organization.
  Registers the Control Tower audit account as the Security Hub delegated
  administrator, enables Security Hub in the log archive account and new Control
  Tower managed accounts, and manages member invitations using SSM Automation,
  EventBridge, Lambda, and IAM.
Resources:
  ControlTowerAccountLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ControlTowerAccountLookup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListOrganizationAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action: organizations:ListAccounts
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PutSuperwerkerParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*'
  ControlTowerAccountLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ControlTowerAccountLookupRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import logging
          import re

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          organizations = boto3.client('organizations')
          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

          def normalize(value):
              return re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', value.lower())

          def get_account_id_by_aliases(aliases):
              paginator = organizations.get_paginator('list_accounts')
              normalized_aliases = {normalize(alias) for alias in aliases}
              for page in paginator.paginate():
                  for account in page.get('Accounts', []):
                      if normalize(account.get('Name', '')) in normalized_aliases:
                          return account['Id']
              return None

          def put_parameter(name, value):
              ssm.put_parameter(
                  Name=name,
                  Value=value,
                  Type='String',
                  Overwrite=True
              )

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or event['StackId']
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      audit_account_id = get_account_id_by_aliases([
                          'audit',
                          'audit account',
                          'aws-control-tower-audit',
                          'aws control tower audit',
                          'control tower audit'
                      ])
                      log_archive_account_id = get_account_id_by_aliases([
                          'log-archive',
                          'log archive',
                          'logarchive',
                          'log archive account',
                          'aws-control-tower-log-archive',
                          'aws control tower log archive'
                      ])
                      audit_parameter = props.get(
                          'AuditParameterName',
                          '/superwerker/audit_account_id'
                      )
                      log_archive_parameter = props.get(
                          'LogArchiveParameterName',
                          '/superwerker/log_archive_account_id'
                      )
                      put_parameter(
                          audit_parameter,
                          audit_account_id if audit_account_id else 'pending'
                      )
                      put_parameter(
                          log_archive_parameter,
                          log_archive_account_id if log_archive_account_id else 'pending'
                      )
                      if not audit_account_id or not log_archive_account_id:
                          logger.warning(
                              'Control Tower audit/log-archive accounts not found yet; '
                              'parameters left at pending for late-binding population.'
                          )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.exception('Control Tower account lookup custom resource failed')
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {},
                      physical_id,
                      reason=str(exc)
                  )
  AccountLookupCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ControlTowerAccountLookupFunction.Arn
      AuditParameterName: /superwerker/audit_account_id
      LogArchiveParameterName: /superwerker/log_archive_account_id
  SecurityHubAutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubAutomationExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Organizations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecurityHub
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:CreateMembers
                  - securityhub:InviteMembers
                  - securityhub:AcceptAdministratorInvitation
                  - securityhub:ListMembers
                  - securityhub:UpdateOrganizationConfiguration
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadWriteSuperwerkerParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*'
              - Sid: AssumeControlTowerExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
  EventBridgeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSecurityHubAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassAutomationRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  SecurityHubDelegatedAdminDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enable Security Hub in the Control Tower audit account and register it as the Security Hub delegated administrator.
        assumeRole: '{{ AssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AssumeRole:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Comprehensive SQS test infrastructure: FIFO and standard queues, DLQs, KMS encryption, and CloudWatch alarms with actions disabled."

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: "Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting all SQS test queues"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow SQS service to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
            Resource: "*"

  FifoNoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub
        - "FifoNoDlq-${QueueSuffix}.fifo"
        - QueueSuffix: !Select [2, !Split ["/", !Ref AWS::StackId]]
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  FifoWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub
        - "FifoWithDlq-${QueueSuffix}.fifo"
        - QueueSuffix: !Select [2, !Split ["/", !Ref AWS::StackId]]
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoWithDlqDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 3

  FifoWithDlqDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

      InsufficientDataActions: []

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Private ROSA networking infrastructure with egress VPC and Transit Gateway'

Parameters:
  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the ROSA VPC
  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC
  NumberOfAzs:
    Type: Number
    AllowedValues: [1, 3]
    Default: 1
    Description: Number of Availability Zones for ROSA subnets (1 or 3)
  RosaSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR for ROSA subnet in first AZ
  RosaSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for ROSA subnet in second AZ (used only if NumberOfAzs = 3)
  RosaSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR for ROSA subnet in third AZ (used only if NumberOfAzs = 3)
  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR for the egress public subnet
  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for the egress private subnet
  CreateElbServiceRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: [true, false]
    Default: false
    Description: Whether to create the ELB service-linked role
  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: [true, false]
    Default: false
    Description: Whether to enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs

Conditions:
  IsThreeAzs: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAzs, 3]
  CreateElbServiceRoleCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateElbServiceRole, "true"]
  EnableFlowLogsCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableFlowLogs, "true"]

Resources:
  # VPCs
  RosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-VPC

  EgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-VPC

  # ROSA VPC Subnets
  RosaSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet1Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Subnet-1

  RosaSubnet2:
    Condition: IsThreeAzs
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet2Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Subnet-2

  RosaSubnet3:
    Condition: IsThreeAzs
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet3Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Subnet-3

  # Egress VPC Subnets
  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Public-Subnet

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Private-Subnet

  # Egress VPC Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Egress VPC Public Route Table
  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Public-RT

  EgressPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  # Egress VPC NAT Gateway
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-NAT

  # Egress VPC Private Route Table
  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Private-RT

  EgressPrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  # Transit Gateway
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: "disable"
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: "disable"
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Egress-TGW

  # Transit Gateway Attachments
  RosaTransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds: !If
        - IsThreeAzs
        - [!Ref RosaSubnet1, !Ref RosaSubnet2, !Ref RosaSubnet3]
        - [!Ref RosaSubnet1]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-TGW-Attachment

  EgressTransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      SubnetIds: [!Ref EgressPrivateSubnet]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-TGW-Attachment

  # Transit Gateway Route Table
  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Egress-TGW-RT

  # Route Table Associations
  RosaAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  EgressAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # Route Table Propagations
  RosaAttachmentPropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  EgressAttachmentPropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # Transit Gateway Routes
  DefaultRouteToEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  RosaVpcRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  EgressVpcRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # ELB Service-Linked Role (conditional)
  ElbServiceRole:
    Condition: CreateElbServiceRoleCondition
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonELBServiceRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ELB-Service-Linked-Role

  # VPC Flow Logs Resources (conditional)
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FlowLogs-KMS-Key

  FlowLogsRole:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncryptFrom
                  - kms:ReEncryptTo
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FlowLogs-Role

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs

  RosaFlowLog:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: RosaVPC-FlowLog

  EgressFlowLog:
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EgressVPC-FlowLog
