AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'PCI DSS remediation prerequisites and SSM Automation documents'

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs Log Group (stateful, retained)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogs
      RetentionInDays: 1827
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. KMS Customer Master Key for CloudTrail encryption (stateful, retained)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for CloudTrail encryption - PCI DSS remediation'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable root full access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudTrail to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  CloudTrailKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cloudtrail-pci-kms
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailKMSKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. IAM Role for SSM Automations to assume
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
      Path: /
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. IAM Role for CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs integration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${CloudTrailLogGroup}:log-stream:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. SSM Document: PCI-Remediation-CloudTrailKMSEncryptionWithCW
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DocCloudTrailKMSEncryptionWithCW:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-Remediation-CloudTrailKMSEncryptionWithCW
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Encrypt CloudTrail trail with KMS key and integrate with CloudWatch Logs'
            assumeRole: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            parameters:
              TrailName:
                type: String
                description: 'Name of the CloudTrail trail'
              KmsKeyId:
                type: String
                description: 'KMS key ARN'
                default: ${CloudTrailKMSKeyArn}
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
                type: String
                description: 'CloudWatch Logs log group ARN'
                default: ${CloudTrailLogGroupArn}
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
                type: String
                description: 'IAM role ARN for CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs integration'
                default: ${CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRoleArn}
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                description: 'IAM role to assume by the automation'
                default: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            mainSteps:
              - name: UpdateTrail
                action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  Service: cloudtrail
                  Api: UpdateTrail
                  Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
                  KmsKeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'
                  CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
                  CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
              - name: StartLogging
                action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  Service: cloudtrail
                  Api: StartLogging
                  Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
          - SSMAutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
            CloudTrailKMSKeyArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailKMSKey.Arn
            CloudTrailLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
            CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. SSM Document: PCI-Remediation-EnableKMSKeyRotation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DocEnableKMSKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-Remediation-EnableKMSKeyRotation
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Enable key rotation for a KMS key'
            assumeRole: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            parameters:
              KeyId:
                type: String
                description: 'KMS key ID or ARN'
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                description: 'IAM role to assume by the automation'
                default: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            mainSteps:
              - name: EnableKeyRotation
                action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  Service: kms
                  Api: EnableKeyRotation
                  KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'
          - SSMAutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. SSM Document: PCI-Remediation-CloudTrailCloudWatchIntegration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DocCloudTrailCloudWatchIntegration:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-Remediation-CloudTrailCloudWatchIntegration
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Integrate CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs'
            assumeRole: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            parameters:
              TrailName:
                type: String
                description: 'Name of the CloudTrail trail'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
                type: String
                description: 'CloudWatch Logs log group ARN'
                default: ${CloudTrailLogGroupArn}
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
                type: String
                description: 'IAM role ARN for CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs integration'
                default: ${CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRoleArn}
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                description: 'IAM role to assume by the automation'
                default: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            mainSteps:
              - name: UpdateTrail
                action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  Service: cloudtrail
                  Api: UpdateTrail
                  Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
                  CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
                  CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
              - name: StartLogging
                action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  Service: cloudtrail
                  Api: StartLogging
                  Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
          - SSMAutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
            CloudTrailLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
            CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. SSM Document: PCI-Remediation-IAMPasswordPolicy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DocIAMPasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-Remediation-IAMPasswordPolicy
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Update IAM account password policy to PCI DSS requirements'
            assumeRole: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            parameters:
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                description: 'IAM role to assume by the automation'
                default: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            mainSteps:
              - name: UpdatePasswordPolicy
                action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  Service: iam
                  Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
                  MinimumPasswordLength: 14
                  RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
                  RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
                  RequireNumbers: true
                  RequireSymbols: true
                  AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
                  HardExpiry: true
                  MaxPasswordAge: 90
                  PasswordReusePrevention: 24
          - SSMAutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. SSM Document: PCI-Remediation-CloudTrailLogValidationMultiRegion
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DocCloudTrailLogValidationMultiRegion:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-Remediation-CloudTrailLogValidationMultiRegion
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Enable log file validation and multi-region trail with CloudWatch integration'
            assumeRole: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            parameters:
              TrailName:

    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:

      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Revoke all inbound and outbound rules of a default security group'
            assumeRole: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            parameters:
              SecurityGroupId:
                type: String
                description: 'ID of the default security group'
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                description: 'IAM role to assume by the automation'
                default: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            mainSteps:
              - name: RevokeAllRules
                action: 'aws:executeScript'
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  Runtime: python3.12
                  Handler: revoke_rules
                  InputPayload:
                    SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
                  Script: |-
                    import boto3
                    def revoke_rules(events, context):
                        ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                        sg_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                        try:
                            sg = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[sg_id])['SecurityGroups'][0]
                        except Exception as e:
                            return {'Success': False, 'Message': str(e)}
                        for perm in sg.get('IpPermissions', []):
                            ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=[perm])
                        for perm in sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', []):

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DocReleaseElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-Remediation-ReleaseElasticIP
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Release an unused Elastic IP address'
            assumeRole: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            parameters:
              AllocationId:
                type: String
                description: 'Allocation ID of the Elastic IP'
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                description: 'IAM role to assume by the automation'
                default: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            mainSteps:
              - name: CheckAndRelease
                action: 'aws:executeScript'
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  Runtime: python3.12
                  Handler: release_eip
                  InputPayload:
                    AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
                  Script: |-
                    import boto3
                    def release_eip(events, context):
                        ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                        alloc_id = events['AllocationId']
                        try:
                            addr = ec2.describe_addresses(AllocationIds=[alloc_id])['Addresses'][0]
                        except Exception as e:
                            return {'Success': False, 'Message': str(e)}
                        if 'AssociationId' in addr:
                            return {'Success': False, 'Message': 'EIP is still associated, cannot release'}
                        ec2.release_address(AllocationId=alloc_id)
                        return {'Success': True, 'Message': 'EIP released'}
          - SSMAutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. SSM Document: PCI-Remediation-CodeBuildRemoveCredentials
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DocCodeBuildRemoveCredentials:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-Remediation-CodeBuildRemoveCredentials
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Remove hardcoded AWS credentials from CodeBuild project environment variables'
            assumeRole: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            parameters:
              ProjectName:
                type: String
                description: 'Name of the CodeBuild project'
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                description: 'IAM role to assume by the automation'
                default: ${SSMAutomationRoleArn}
            mainSteps:
              - name: RemoveCredentials
                action: 'aws:executeScript'
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  Runtime: python3.12
                  Handler: remove_creds
                  InputPayload:
                    ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
                  Script: |-
                    import boto3
                    def remove_creds(events, context):
                        codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                        project_name = events['ProjectName']
                        try:
                            project = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])['projects'][0]
                        except Exception as e:
                            return {'Success': False, 'Message': str(e)}
                        env = project.get('environment', {})
                        original_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', [])
                        filtered = [v for v in original_vars if v['name'] not in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')]
                        if len(filtered) == len(original_vars):
                            return {'Success': True, 'Message': 'No credentials to remove'}
                        env['environmentVariables'] = filtered
                        # Preserve all other environment fields
                        codebuild.update_project(
                            name=project_name,
                            environment=env
                        )
                        return {'Success': True, 'Message': 'Credentials removed'}
          - SSMAutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

                        "expression": "SUM(SEARCH('{CoWork/} MetricName=\"CacheReadTokens\"', 'Sum', 300))",

                  ],
                  "view": "timeSeries",

                  "period": 300,
                  "title": "Cache Hit Tokens"

              },

                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 6,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [
                      {
                        "expression": "SUM(SEARCH('{CoWork/} MetricName=\"InputTokens\"', 'Sum', 300))",

                        "expression": "SUM(SEARCH('{CoWork/} MetricName=\"OutputTokens\"', 'Sum', 300))",

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: This template provisions the AWS CDK bootstrap toolkit environment for a greenfield account. It creates the required asset storage, container repository, encryption key, IAM roles, and version-tracking SSM parameter using only resources defined within this template and pseudo parameters for account, region, and partition references.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,10}$
    ConstraintDescription: Qualifier must be 1-10 alphanumeric, underscore, or hyphen characters.
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom name for the file assets S3 bucket. When empty, the generated CDK bootstrap bucket name is used.
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional external account IDs allowed to assume the deployment, file publishing, and image publishing roles.
  TrustedAccountsForLookup:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional external account IDs allowed to assume the lookup role.
  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
    Description: Comma-separated list of managed policy ARNs attached to the CloudFormation execution role.
  FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional existing KMS key ID or ARN for file asset bucket encryption. When empty, a dedicated KMS key is created.

Conditions:
  HasCustomBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BucketName, ""]]
  HasCustomEncryptionKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, ""]]
  KeyNeedsToBeCreated: !Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, ""]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref TrustedAccounts], ""]]
  HasTrustedAccountsForLookup: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup], ""]]

Resources:
  FileAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasCustomBucketName
        - !Ref BucketName
        - !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - HasCustomEncryptionKey
                - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
                - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  FileAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub
                - "${FileAssetsBucketArn}/*"
                - FileAssetsBucketArn: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": "false"

  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImagePublishing
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:PutImage
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
          - Sid: AllowImagePull
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage

  FileAssetsBucketKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: KeyNeedsToBeCreated
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFullAdminAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowS3UseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "s3.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "kms:ViaService": !Sub "s3.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
          - Sid: AllowFilePublishingAndDeployment
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: KeyNeedsToBeCreated
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKey

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "cloudformation.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deployment-action-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                Fn::Split:
                  - ","
                  - Fn::Join:
                      - ","
                      - - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
                        - !If
                          - HasTrustedAccounts
                          - !Sub
                            - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${TrustedAccounts}:root"
                            - TrustedAccounts:
                                Fn::Join:
                                  - ":root,arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::"
                                  - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  DeploymentActionRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deployment-action-policy-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Roles:
        - !Ref DeploymentActionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AssumeCloudFormationExecutionRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
          - Sid: ReadBootstrapVersion
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:GetParameter
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
          - Sid: ReadFileAssetObjects
            Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub
              - "${FileAssetsBucketArn}/*"
              - FileAssetsBucketArn: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
          - Sid: ReadFileAssetBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
          - Sid: DescribeContainerAssets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:DescribeImages
            Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
          - Sid: GetContainerAuthToken
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: "*"

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                Fn::Split:
                  - ","
                  - Fn::Join:
                      - ","
                      - - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
                        - !If
                          - HasTrustedAccounts
                          - !Sub
                            - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${TrustedAccounts}:root"
                            - TrustedAccounts:
                                Fn::Join:
                                  - ":root,arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::"
                                  - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  FilePublishingRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-policy-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Roles:
        - !Ref FilePublishingRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadWriteFileAssetObjects
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub
              - "${FileAssetsBucketArn}/*"
              - FileAssetsBucketArn: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
          - Sid: ReadFileAssetBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
          - Sid: UseFileAssetsKey
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: !If
              - HasCustomEncryptionKey
              - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketKmsKey.Arn

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                Fn::Split:
                  - ","
                  - Fn::Join:
                      - ","
                      - - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
                        - !If
                          - HasTrustedAccounts
                          - !Sub
                            - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${TrustedAccounts}:root"
                            - TrustedAccounts:
                                Fn::Join:
                                  - ":root,arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::"
                                  - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ImagePublishingRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-policy-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImagePublishingRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: PushContainerAssets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:PutImage
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
            Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
          - Sid: GetContainerAuthToken
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: "*"

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                Fn::Split:
                  - ","
                  - Fn::Join:
                      - ","
                      - - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
                        - !If
                          - HasTrustedAccountsForLookup
                          - !Sub
                            - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${TrustedAccountsForLookup}:root"
                            - TrustedAccountsForLookup:
                                Fn::Join:
                                  - ":root,arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::"
                                  - !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup
                          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LookupRolePolicy

  LookupRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-policy-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadFileAssetObjects
            Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub
              - "${FileAssetsBucketArn}/*"
              - FileAssetsBucketArn: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
          - Sid: ListFileAssetBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
          - Sid: DescribeContainerAssets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:DescribeImages
            Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
          - Sid: GetContainerAuthToken
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ReadBootstrapVersion
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:GetParameter
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
          - Sid: DescribeFileAssetsKey
            Effect: Allow
            Action: kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: !If
              - HasCustomEncryptionKey
              - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketKmsKey.Arn

  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
      Type: String
      Value: "20"

Outputs:
  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the CDK file assets S3 bucket.
    Value: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
  FileAssetsBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the CDK file assets S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
  ContainerAssetsRepositoryName:
    Description: Name of the CDK container assets ECR repository.
    Value: !Ref ContainerAssetsRepository
  ContainerAssetsRepositoryArn:
    Description: ARN of the CDK container assets ECR repository.
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn

  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:

    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
  DeploymentActionRoleArn:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for the ML workshop. Creates
  admin and user portfolios, seven products, dedicated launch roles, launch
  constraints, and switch-role IAM principals for the workshop. Product
  templates are published to a stack-managed S3 bucket so no external object
  keys are required.
Parameters:
  RootS3Url:
    Type: String
    Default: 'https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps'
    Description: Root S3 URL where the nested Service Catalog product templates were originally published.
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    MaxLength: '20'
    ConstraintDescription: EnvironmentPrefix must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Unique prefix used to namespace all resources in this workshop environment.

Resources:
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-admin-portfolio'
      ProviderName: AWS
      Description: !Sub 'Admin portfolio for ${EnvironmentPrefix}. Hosts the VPC, IAM/KMS/S3, AWS Data Exchange, and infrastructure products. Source: ${RootS3Url}'

  UserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-user-portfolio'
      ProviderName: AWS
      Description: !Sub 'End-user portfolio for ${EnvironmentPrefix}. Hosts the application, SageMaker notebook, and third-party ML model products. Source: ${RootS3Url}'

  TemplateBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  TemplateBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TemplateBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:GetObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${TemplateBucket.Arn}/*'

  TemplatePublisherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-template-publisher-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${TemplateBucket.Arn}/*'

  TemplatePublisherFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-publisher'
      Role: !GetAtt TemplatePublisherRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      Code:
        ZipFile: !Sub |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')

          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              bucket = props.get('Bucket')
              templates = props.get('Templates', {})
              response_data = {}
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      for key, body in templates.items():
                          s3.put_object(
                              Bucket=bucket,
                              Key=key,
                              Body=body.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(body, str) else body,
                              ContentType='application/x-yaml'
                          )
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      for key in templates.keys():
                          try:
                              s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
                          except Exception:
                              pass
                  base_url = f"https://{bucket}.s3.amazonaws.com"
                  response_data = {
                      'VpcUrl': f"{base_url}/vpc.yaml",
                      'IamUrl': f"{base_url}/iam-kms-s3.yaml",
                      'DataExchangeUrl': f"{base_url}/data-exchange.yaml",
                      'InfrastructureUrl': f"{base_url}/infrastructure.yaml",
                      'ApplicationUrl': f"{base_url}/application.yaml",
                      'SageMakerUrl': f"{base_url}/sagemaker.yaml",
                      'MlModelUrl': f"{base_url}/ml-model.yaml"
                  }
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data)
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Message': str(e)})

  TemplatePublisher:
    Type: Custom::TemplatePublisher
    DependsOn: TemplateBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TemplatePublisherFunction.Arn
      Bucket: !Ref TemplateBucket
      Templates:
        vpc.yaml: |
          AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
          Description: VPC product for ML workshop
          Parameters:
            EnvironmentPrefix:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            VPC:
              Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
              Properties:
                CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
                EnableDnsSupport: true
                EnableDnsHostnames: true
                Tags:
                  - Key: Name
                    Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc'
            PrivateSubnet1:
              Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
              Properties:
                VpcId: !Ref VPC
                CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
                AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
                MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
            PrivateSubnet2:
              Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
              Properties:
                VpcId: !Ref VPC
                CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
                AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
                MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
            S3Endpoint:
              Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
              Properties:
                VpcId: !Ref VPC
                ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
                VpcEndpointType: Gateway
            SSMEndpoint:
              Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
              Properties:
                VpcId: !Ref VPC
                ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
                VpcEndpointType: Interface
                SubnetIds:
                  - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
                  - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
                PrivateDnsEnabled: true
          Outputs:
            VpcId:
              Value: !Ref VPC
            PrivateSubnet1:
              Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            PrivateSubnet2:
              Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        iam-kms-s3.yaml: |
          AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
          Description: IAM, KMS, and S3 product for ML workshop
          Parameters:
            EnvironmentPrefix:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            KmsKey:
              Type: AWS::KMS::Key
              DeletionPolicy: Retain
              UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
              Properties:
                Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-key'
                Enabled: true
                EnableKeyRotation: true
                KeyPolicy:
                  Version: '2012-10-17'
                  Statement:
                    - Effect: Allow
                      Principal:
                        AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                      Action: 'kms:*'
                      Resource: '*'
            ArtifactBucket:
              Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
              DeletionPolicy: Retain
              UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
              Properties:
                BucketName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop-bucket'
                PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                  BlockPublicAcls: true
                  BlockPublicPolicy: true
                  IgnorePublicAcls: true
                  RestrictPublicBuckets: true
                Tags:
                  - Key: provisioning
                    Value: 'true'
            ArtifactBucketPolicy:
              Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
              Properties:
                Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
                PolicyDocument:
                  Version: '2012-10-17'
                  Statement:
                    - Effect: Deny
                      Principal: '*'
                      Action: 's3:*'
                      Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
                      Condition:
                        Bool:
                          'aws:SecureTransport': false
            BucketParameter:
              Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
              Properties:
                Name: !Sub '/MLWorkshop/${EnvironmentPrefix}/bucket'
                Type: String
                Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
          Outputs:
            BucketName:
              Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
            KmsKeyArn:
              Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
        data-exchange.yaml: |
          AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
          Description: AWS Data Exchange product for ML workshop
          Parameters:
            EnvironmentPrefix:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            DataSet:
              Type: AWS::DataExchange::DataSet
              DeletionPolicy: Retain
              UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
              Properties:
                AssetType: S3_SNAPSHOT
                Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-dataset'
                Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-dataset'
            Revision:
              Type: AWS::DataExchange::Revision
              Properties:
                DataSetId: !Ref DataSet
                Comment: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} initial revision'
          Outputs:
            DataSetId:
              Value: !Ref DataSet
            RevisionId:
              Value: !Ref Revision
        infrastructure.yaml: |
          AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
          Description: Infrastructure product for ML workshop
          Parameters:
            EnvironmentPrefix:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            ECRRepository:
              Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
              Properties:
                RepositoryName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-app'
            ECSCluster:
              Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
              Properties:
                ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-cluster'
          Outputs:
            ECRRepositoryArn:
              Value: !GetAtt ECRRepository.Arn
            ECSClusterName:
              Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        application.yaml: |
          AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
          Description: Application product for ML workshop
          Parameters:
            EnvironmentPrefix:
              Type: String
            Cluster:
              Type: String
            Subnets:
              Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
            SecurityGroupIds:
              Type: List<AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id>
          Resources:
            TaskDefinition:
              Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
              Properties:
                Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-app'
                RequiresCompatibilities:
                  - FARGATE
                NetworkMode: awsvpc
                Cpu: '256'
                Memory: '512'
                ContainerDefinitions:
                  - Name: app
                    Image: public.ecr.aws/ecs-sample-image/amazon-ecs-sample:latest
                    Essential: true
            Service:
              Type: AWS::ECS::Service
              Properties:
                Cluster: !Ref Cluster
                TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
                DesiredCount: 1
                LaunchType: FARGATE
                NetworkConfiguration:
                  AwsvpcConfiguration:
                    AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
                    SecurityGroups: !Ref SecurityGroupIds
                    Subnets: !Ref Subnets
          Outputs:
            ApplicationServiceName:
              Value: !Ref Service
        sagemaker.yaml: |
          AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
          Description: SageMaker notebook product for ML workshop
          Parameters:
            EnvironmentPrefix:
              Type: String
            VpcId:
              Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
            SubnetId:
              Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id
            SageMakerExecutionRoleArn:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            NotebookSecurityGroup:
              Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
              Properties:
                GroupDescription: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-notebook-sg'
                VpcId: !Ref VpcId
            NotebookInstance:
              Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
              Properties:
                NotebookInstanceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-notebook'
                InstanceType: ml.t3.medium
                RoleArn: !Ref SageMakerExecutionRoleArn
                SubnetId: !Ref SubnetId
                SecurityGroupIds:
                  - !Ref NotebookSecurityGroup
                DirectInternetAccess: Disabled
          Outputs:
            NotebookInstanceName:
              Value: !Ref NotebookInstance
        ml-model.yaml: |
          AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
          Description: Third-party ML model product for ML workshop
          Parameters:
            EnvironmentPrefix:
              Type: String
            ModelExecutionRoleArn:
              Type: String
            ModelImage:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            Model:
              Type: AWS::SageMaker::Model
              Properties:
                ModelName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-model'
                ExecutionRoleArn: !Ref ModelExecutionRoleArn
                PrimaryContainer:
                  Image: !Ref ModelImage
            EndpointConfig:
              Type: AWS::SageMaker::EndpointConfig
              Properties:
                EndpointConfigName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-endpoint-config'
                ProductionVariants:
                  - ModelName: !Ref Model
                    VariantName: AllTraffic
                    InitialInstanceCount: 1
                    InstanceType: ml.m5.large
            Endpoint:
              Type: AWS::SageMaker::Endpoint
              Properties:
                EndpointName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-endpoint'
                EndpointConfigName: !Ref EndpointConfig
          Outputs:
            EndpointName:
              Value: !Ref Endpoint

  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-product'
      Owner: AWS
      Description: !Sub 'VPC product for ${EnvironmentPrefix}. Creates a VPC with private subnets and required VPC endpoints.'
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: '1.0'
          Description: 'Initial VPC product artifact.'
          Info:

      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:

      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:

      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: '1.0'

    Properties:

      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: '1.0'

          Info:

    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-model-product'

      Description: !Sub 'Third-party ML model product for ${EnvironmentPrefix}. Creates a SageMaker model, endpoint configuration, and endpoint.'
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: '1.0'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: "VPC with dual-stack, public/private subnets, NACLs, placement group, DHCP options set"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
    Description: "Select environment: staging or production"
  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: "Whether to deploy a NAT Gateway for private subnets"
  BastionVpnPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1194
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: "Bastion VPN port for public NACL inbound rules"
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: example.local
    Description: "Domain name for the DHCP options set"

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCIDR: "10.0.0.0/16"
      PublicSubnetAz1CIDR1: "10.0.1.0/24"
      PublicSubnetAz1CIDR2: "10.0.2.0/24"
      PublicSubnetAz2CIDR: "10.0.3.0/24"
      PrivateAppSubnetAz1CIDR: "10.0.4.0/24"
      PrivateDataSubnetAz1CIDR: "10.0.5.0/24"
    production:
      VpcCIDR: "10.1.0.0/16"
      PublicSubnetAz1CIDR1: "10.1.1.0/24"
      PublicSubnetAz1CIDR2: "10.1.2.0/24"
      PublicSubnetAz2CIDR: "10.1.3.0/24"
      PrivateAppSubnetAz1CIDR: "10.1.4.0/24"
      PrivateDataSubnetAz1CIDR: "10.1.5.0/24"

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, VpcCIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-vpc"

  # VPC IPv6 CIDR
  VPCCidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Egress-Only Internet Gateway
  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  # Subnets
  PublicSubnetAz1First:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnetAz1CIDR1]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-az1-1"

  PublicSubnetAz1Second:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnetAz1CIDR2]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-az1-2"

  PublicSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnetAz2CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-az2"

  PrivateAppSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateAppSubnetAz1CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-app-az1"

  PrivateDataSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateDataSubnetAz1CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-data-az1"

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-rt"

  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  # Public subnet associations
  PublicSubnetAz1FirstAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1First
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetAz1SecondAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1Second
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetAz2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-rt"

  # NAT Gateway (conditional)
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1First
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-nat"

  PrivateRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # Private subnet associations
  PrivateAppSubnetAz1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateDataSubnetAz1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDataSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Public Network ACL
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-nacl"

  # Public NACL inbound rules
  PublicNaclInboundSSHv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicNaclInboundSSHv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicNaclInboundHTTPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicNaclInboundHTTPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 210
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicNaclInboundHTTPSv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicNaclInboundHTTPSv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 220
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicNaclInboundBastionVPNv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: !Ref BastionVpnPort
        To: !Ref BastionVpnPort

  PublicNaclInboundBastionVPNv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 230
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: !Ref BastionVpnPort
        To: !Ref BastionVpnPort

  PublicNaclInboundEphemeralv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PublicNaclInboundEphemeralv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 240
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Public NACL outbound rules (open egress)
  # trivy:ignore:AWS-0102
  PublicNaclOutboundv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"

  # trivy:ignore:AWS-0102
  PublicNaclOutboundv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"

  # Private Network ACL
  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-nacl"

  # Private NACL inbound rules (allow all)
  # trivy:ignore:AWS-0102
  PrivateNaclInboundv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"

  # trivy:ignore:AWS-0102
  PrivateNaclInboundv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"

  # Private NACL outbound rules (allow all)
  # trivy:ignore:AWS-0102
  PrivateNaclOutboundv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"

  # trivy:ignore:AWS-0102
  PrivateNaclOutboundv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"

  # Public NACL subnet associations
  PublicSubnetAz1FirstNaclAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1First
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicSubnetAz1SecondNaclAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1Second
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicSubnetAz2NaclAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  # Private NACL subnet associations
  PrivateAppSubnetAz1NaclAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnetAz1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateDataSubnetAz1NaclAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDataSubnetAz1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  # Placement Group
  PlacementGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PlacementGroup
    Properties:
      Strategy: cluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-cluster-pg"

  # DHCP Options Set
  DHCPOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-dhcp-options"

  VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptions

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"
  VpcCidr:
    Description: "VPC CIDR block"
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Movies API with DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway

Parameters:
  EnvironmentParam:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9]+$"
    Description: Environment name (used for API stage)

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Table
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH

  # IAM Role for Lambda
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCrud
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  # Lambda Functions
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing title'})
                      }
                  table.put_item(Item=body)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie created', 'item': body})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event['pathParameters']['title']
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
                  item = response.get('Item')
                  if not item:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 404,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Movie not found'})
                      }
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps(item)
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing title'})
                      }
                  # For simplicity, overwrite the item
                  table.put_item(Item=body)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie updated', 'item': body})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event['pathParameters']['title']
                  table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie deleted'})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

  # Lambda Permissions
