AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to provision a SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona with a self-contained VPC and domain, or using existing resources.

Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^d-.*$"
    Description: Optional existing SageMaker Studio Domain ID. If empty, a new domain with VPC will be created.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of subnet IDs for the existing domain (required if DomainId is provided).
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of security group IDs for the existing domain (required if DomainId is provided).

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, ""]
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainId, ""]]

Resources:
  # IAM Role for MLOps Engineer
  MLOpsEngineerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-mlops-engineer-execution-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsEngineerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              # General SageMaker permissions
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                Resource: "*"
              # Permission to pass the execution role (self-reference via constructed ARN)
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${AWS::StackName}-mlops-engineer-execution-role"
              # Ownership-restricted permissions for apps and spaces
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "sagemaker:UserProfileName": !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-mlops-engineer"

  # SageMaker User Profile
  UserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If [CreateDomain, !Ref Domain, !Ref DomainId]
      UserProfileName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-mlops-engineer"
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsEngineerExecutionRole.Arn

  # VPC and related resources (only if creating new domain)
  VPC:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  DefaultRoute:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-subnet"

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  Domain:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-domain"
      AuthMode: IAM
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsEngineerExecutionRole.Arn
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the created SageMaker Studio user profile
    Value: !GetAtt UserProfile.UserProfileArn
  DomainId:
    Description: The SageMaker Studio Domain ID (either provided or created)
    Value: !If [CreateDomain, !Ref Domain, !Ref DomainId]
  ExistingSubnetIds:
    Condition: UseExistingDomain
    Description: The subnet IDs used for the existing domain
    Value: !Ref SubnetIds
  ExistingSecurityGroupIds:
    Condition: UseExistingDomain
    Description: The security group IDs used for the existing domain
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroupIds

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudWatch monitoring for cross-language database encryption SDK performance benchmarks'

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: benchmark-logs
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group to receive benchmark events
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: Retention period for log events in days
  ThroughputDataSize:
    Type: String
    Default: '1024'
    Description: Data size (in bytes) for throughput test filter patterns

Resources:
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  # --- Java Metric Filters ---
  JavaMemEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "memory" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: $.memory_efficiency_ratio
          MetricNamespace: 'DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java'
          MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaMemPeak:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "memory" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: $.peak_memory_mb
          MetricNamespace: 'DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java'
          MetricName: PeakMemoryMB
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaThroughputP50:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: !Sub '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "throughput" && $.data_size = "${ThroughputDataSize}" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: $.p50_latency_ms
          MetricNamespace: 'DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java'
          MetricName: ThroughputP50Latency
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

            - Key: Language

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB, JavaScript resolvers, and real-time subscriptions'

Resources:
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: OwnerIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TableName: TodoTable

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*"

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: TodoAPIwithJs
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: TodoAPIwithJs

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId

  Schema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          createdAt: AWSDateTime!
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          todosByOwner(owner: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo: Todo
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo: Todo
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo: Todo
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }

        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }

  TodoTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoTableDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn

  CreateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: TodoTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: TodoTableDataSource
      Name: create_todo
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.arguments.input;
          const id = util.autoId();
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const item = {
            id: id,
            owner: input.owner,
            title: input.title,
            description: input.description,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(item)
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: TodoTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: TodoTableDataSource
      Name: update_todo
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.arguments.input;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const updates = {};
          if (input.owner !== undefined) updates.owner = input.owner;
          if (input.title !== undefined) updates.title = input.title;
          if (input.description !== undefined) updates.description = input.description;
          updates.updatedAt = now;
          const expression = 'SET ' + Object.keys(updates).map(k => `#${k} = :${k}`).join(', ');
          const expressionNames = {};
          const expressionValues = {};
          for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(updates)) {
            expressionNames[`#${k}`] = k;
            expressionValues[`:${k}`] = util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB(v);
          }
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: input.id }),
            update: {
              expression: expression,
              expressionNames: expressionNames,
              expressionValues: expressionValues
            },
            condition: {
              expression: 'attribute_exists(id)'
            }
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  DeleteTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: TodoTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: TodoTableDataSource
      Name: delete_todo
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.arguments.id })
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  GetTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: TodoTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: TodoTableDataSource
      Name: get_todo
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'GetItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.arguments.id })
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ListTodosFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: TodoTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: TodoTableDataSource
      Name: list_todos
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const limit = ctx.arguments.limit || 20;
          const nextToken = ctx.arguments.nextToken;
          return {
            operation: 'Scan',
            limit: limit,
            nextToken: nextToken
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  TodosByOwnerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: TodoTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: TodoTableDataSource
      Name: todos_by_owner
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const owner = ctx.arguments.owner;
          const limit = ctx.arguments.limit || 20;
          const nextToken = ctx.arguments.nextToken;
          return {
            operation: 'Query',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':owner': owner })
            },
            index: 'OwnerIndex',
            limit: limit,
            nextToken: nextToken
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt CreateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {}; }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result; }

  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt UpdateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {}; }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result; }

  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt DeleteTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {}; }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result; }

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {}; }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result; }

  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ListTodosFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {}; }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result; }

  TodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: todosByOwner
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt TodosByOwnerFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {}; }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result; }

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Composite CloudWatch alarms for cross-region failover application health monitoring

Parameters:
  ApiGatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: Remittance
    Description: Name of the existing API Gateway REST API
  ApiGatewayStage:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Deployment stage of the API Gateway
  GetRemittancesLambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: Name of the GetRemittances Lambda function
  CreateRemittanceLambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: Name of the CreateRemittance Lambda function
  RdsInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: Identifier of the RDS DB instance

Resources:
  # API Gateway underlying alarms
  ApiGateway4xxErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ApiGateway-4xxError"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on API Gateway 4XX errors averaging above 0 over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayStage

  ApiGateway5xxErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ApiGateway-5xxError"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on API Gateway 5XX errors averaging above 1 over 60 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayStage

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ApiGateway-Latency"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on API Gateway latency at or above 10000 ms over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: Latency
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayStage

  # Lambda underlying alarms for GetRemittances
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GetRemittances-Errors"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on GetRemittances Lambda summed errors exceeding 0 over 60 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesLambdaFunctionName

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GetRemittances-Invocations"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on GetRemittances Lambda summed invocations exceeding 2 over 60 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: Invocations
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesLambdaFunctionName

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GetRemittances-Duration"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on GetRemittances Lambda average duration at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: Duration
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesLambdaFunctionName

  # Lambda underlying alarms for CreateRemittance
  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CreateRemittance-Errors"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on CreateRemittance Lambda summed errors exceeding 0 over 60 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceLambdaFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CreateRemittance-Invocations"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on CreateRemittance Lambda summed invocations exceeding 2 over 60 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: Invocations
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceLambdaFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CreateRemittance-Duration"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on CreateRemittance Lambda average duration at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: Duration
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceLambdaFunctionName

  # RDS underlying alarms
  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS-CPUUtilization"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on RDS CPU utilization at or above 70% over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS-DatabaseConnections"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on RDS database connections at or above 100 over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS-Deadlocks"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on RDS deadlocks at or above 10 over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS-NetworkTransmitThroughput"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on RDS network transmit throughput at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS-NetworkReceiveThroughput"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on RDS network receive throughput at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS-Queries"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on RDS queries at or above 100 over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: Queries
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS-DiskQueueDepth"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on RDS disk queue depth at or above 50 over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS-ReadLatency"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on RDS read latency at or above 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS-WriteLatency"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm on RDS write latency at or above 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  # Composite alarms
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-API Gateway Health"
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm for API Gateway health (OR of 4XX errors, 5XX errors, and latency)
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(\"${Child1}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child2}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child3}\")"
        - Child1: !GetAtt ApiGateway4xxErrorAlarm.Arn
          Child2: !GetAtt ApiGateway5xxErrorAlarm.Arn
          Child3: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm.Arn

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Lambda Health"
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm for Lambda health (OR of errors and duration alarms for both functions)
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(\"${Child1}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child2}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child3}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child4}\")"
        - Child1: !GetAtt GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm.Arn
          Child2: !GetAtt GetRemittancesDurationAlarm.Arn
          Child3: !GetAtt CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm.Arn
          Child4: !GetAtt CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm.Arn

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RDS Health"
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm for RDS health (OR of all nine RDS metric alarms)
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(\"${Child1}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child2}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child3}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child4}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child5}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child6}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child7}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child8}\") OR ALARM(\"${Child9}\")"
        - Child1: !GetAtt RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm.Arn
          Child2: !GetAtt RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm.Arn
          Child3: !GetAtt RdsDeadlocksAlarm.Arn
          Child4: !GetAtt RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm.Arn
          Child5: !GetAtt RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm.Arn
          Child6: !GetAtt RdsQueriesAlarm.Arn
          Child7: !GetAtt RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm.Arn
          Child8: !GetAtt RdsReadLatencyAlarm.Arn
          Child9: !GetAtt RdsWriteLatencyAlarm.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Comprehensive monitoring and data extraction pipeline for QuickSight admin console'

Parameters:
  ScriptBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: 'S3 bucket name where Glue scripts are stored (must be pre-uploaded)'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9.-]{3,63}$'
    Default: 'my-quicksight-scripts'
  ScriptKeyPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: 'S3 key prefix for Glue scripts (e.g., scripts/)'
    Default: 'scripts/'

Resources:
  # S3 Bucket for output
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey

  # Customer managed KMS key for S3 encryption
  AdminSuiteKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Description: 'KMS key for encrypting AdminSuite S3 bucket'
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  # KMS alias for easier identification
  AdminSuiteKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey

  # IAM Role
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuitePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:CreateJob
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucket}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:CreateDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:UpdateDestination
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'

  # Glue Jobs - Python Shell (5)
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # Glue Jobs - ETL (2)
  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account-id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # Glue Triggers (Scheduled every 3 hours)
  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-assets-access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  TriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-assets-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata

  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-folder-assets
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  TriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-q-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  TriggerQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-q-access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQAccess

  TriggerDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-ds-properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDsProperties

  TriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-datasource-properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  # Kinesis Firehose Delivery Streams (DirectPut, S3 destination)
  FirehoseStream1:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight-stream1/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  FirehoseStream2:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight-stream2/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  FirehoseStream3:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight-stream3/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  FirehoseStream4:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight-stream4/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  FirehoseStream5:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight-stream5/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  # CloudWatch Metric Streams (JSON output, filtered to specific metrics)
  MetricStream1:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: QuickSightIngestionMetrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseStream1.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount

  MetricStream2:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: QuickSightViewMetrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseStream2.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - VisualLoadTime
            - DashboardViewLoadTime
            - DashboardViewCount
            - VisualLoadErrorCount

  MetricStream3:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: QuickSightSPICEMetrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseStream3.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityLimitInMB
            - SPICECapacityConsumedInMB

  MetricStream4:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: QuickSightIndexMetrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseStream4.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QuickIndexDocumentCount
            - QuickIndexExtractedTextSize

  MetricStream5:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: QuickSightActionMetrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseStream5.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - ActionInvocationError
            - ActionInvocationCount

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless CRUD API for Kitten service'

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Table
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # Lambda Execution Role
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/KittenLambda:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  # Lambda Function
  KittenLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaExecutionRole
    Properties:
      FunctionName: KittenLambda
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import uuid
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def build_response(status_code, body, cors=True):
              headers = {
                  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'
              }
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': headers,
                  'body': json.dumps(body)
              }

          def handler(event, context):
              http_method = event['httpMethod']
              path = event['resource']
              path_params = event.get('pathParameters', {}) or {}
              body = {}
              if event.get('body'):
                  try:
                      body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
                      return build_response(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON body'})

              try:
                  if path == '/kitten' and http_method == 'POST':
                      kitten_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return build_response(400, {'error': 'name and color are required'})
                      item = {
                          'KittenId': kitten_id,
                          'name': name,
                          'color': color
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return build_response(201, item)

                  elif path == '/kitten' and http_method == 'GET':
                      response = table.scan()
                      items = response.get('Items', [])
                      return build_response(200, items)

                  elif path == '/kitten/{id}' and http_method == 'GET':
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return build_response(400, {'error': 'Missing id parameter'})
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      item = response.get('Item')
                      if not item:
                          return build_response(404, {'error': 'Kitten not found'})
                      return build_response(200, item)

                  elif path == '/kitten/{id}' and http_method == 'PUT':
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return build_response(400, {'error': 'Missing id parameter'})
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return build_response(400, {'error': 'name and color are required'})
                      # Check if item exists
                      existing = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id}).get('Item')
                      if not existing:
                          return build_response(404, {'error': 'Kitten not found'})
                      item = {'KittenId': kitten_id, 'name': name, 'color': color}
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return build_response(200, item)

                  elif path == '/kitten/{id}' and http_method == 'DELETE':
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return build_response(400, {'error': 'Missing id parameter'})
                      existing = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id}).get('Item')
                      if not existing:
                          return build_response(404, {'error': 'Kitten not found'})
                      table.delete_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      return build_response(200, {'message': 'Kitten deleted'})

                  else:
                      return build_response(400, {'error': 'Unsupported route'})

              except ClientError as e:
                  return build_response(500, {'error': str(e)})
              except Exception as e:
                  return build_response(500, {'error': 'Internal server error'})
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref KittenTable

  # CloudWatch Log Group for Lambda
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${KittenLambdaFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  # API Gateway REST API
  KittenRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenAPI
      Description: 'REST API for Kitten CRUD'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      MinimumCompressionSize: 1024

  # API Gateway Resources
  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt KittenRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten

  KittenIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ParentId: !Ref KittenResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  # OPTIONS Method for /kitten
  OptionsKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{ "statusCode": 200 }'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'General purpose VPC with NAT gateways, flow logs, S3 gateway endpoint, and ECR interface endpoints'

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: Retention period in days for VPC flow logs in CloudWatch Logs
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture in VPC flow logs

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Tables (one per AZ)
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlog-role'
  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlog'

  # S3 Gateway Endpoint
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # Security Group for Interface Endpoints
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints (ECR)
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  # Interface Endpoint for ECR API
  ECRApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecr-api-endpoint'

  # Interface Endpoint for ECR Docker Registry
  ECRDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecr-dkr-endpoint'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  VpcCidr:
    Description: VPC CIDR block
    Value: !Ref VpcCidr
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: First Availability Zone name
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone1'
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Second Availability Zone name
    Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone2'
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'
  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for interface endpoints
    Value: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroupId'

        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ2

        - Key: Name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained SageMaker Domain in VPC Only mode with test user profile and dedicated IAM role'

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'MySageMakerDomain'
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain
  TestUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'test-user'
    Description: Name of the test user profile

Resources:
  DefaultS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'sagemaker-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref SageMakerBucketKey

  SageMakerBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Description: KMS key for SageMaker default bucket encryption
      Enabled: true

  SageMakerVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  SageMakerSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false

  SageMakerSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false

  SageMakerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Domain
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:UpdateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:UpdateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DescribeContext
                  - sagemaker:ListContexts
                  - sagemaker:CreateContext
                  - sagemaker:UpdateContext
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:CreateAction
                  - sagemaker:UpdateAction
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedNotebookInstanceUrl
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DefaultS3Bucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${DefaultS3Bucket.Arn}/*'

  SageMakerPassRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SageMakerPassRole
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${SageMakerExecutionRole}'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com

  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      AuthMode: IAM
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          - !Ref SageMakerSecurityGroup
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SageMakerSubnet1
        - !Ref SageMakerSubnet2

  SageMakerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainId: !Ref SageMakerDomain
      UserProfileName: !Ref TestUserName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn

Outputs:
  DomainId:
    Description: ID of the SageMaker Domain
    Value: !Ref SageMakerDomain
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM execution role
    Value: !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
  StudioConsoleUrl:
    Description: Direct URL to the SageMaker Studio console for the new domain
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/home?region=${AWS::Region}#/studio/${SageMakerDomain}'
