AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudWatch Logs Insights saved queries for Claude Code metrics (approx. 19 queries)"
Parameters:
  MetricsLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group containing Claude Code metrics"
Resources:
  # Real-time monitoring queries
  SavedQueryRealTimeTokenRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-RealTime-TokenRatePerUser"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, tokens
        | filter tokens > 0
        | stats sum(tokens) as total_tokens by user
        | sort total_tokens desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryRealTimeRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-RealTime-RequestRatePerUser"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user
        | stats count() as request_count by user
        | sort request_count desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryRealTimeCurrentTPM:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-RealTime-CurrentTPM"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, tokens
        | filter @timestamp > ago(1m)
        | stats avg(tokens) as avg_tpm
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryRealTimeCurrentRPM:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-RealTime-CurrentRPM"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp
        | filter @timestamp > ago(1m)
        | stats count() as rpm
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryRealTimeRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-RealTime-RateLimitRisk"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, tokens
        | filter tokens > 100000
        | stats count() as high_token_requests by user
        | sort high_token_requests desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  # User and session analytics queries
  SavedQueryUserSessionSessionUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-UserSession-SessionUsage"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, sessionId, user, tokens, cost
        | stats sum(tokens) as total_tokens, sum(cost) as total_cost, count() as request_count by sessionId, user
        | sort total_tokens desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryUserSessionHourlyActivity:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-UserSession-HourlyActivity"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user
        | stats count() by bin(1h) as hour, user
        | sort hour asc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryUserSessionErrorDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-UserSession-ErrorDetection"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, error
        | filter error is not null
        | stats count() as error_count by user, error
        | sort error_count desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryUserSessionThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-UserSession-ThrottlingDetection"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, throttle
        | filter throttle = true
        | stats count() as throttle_count by user
        | sort throttle_count desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  # Cost and attribution reporting queries
  SavedQueryCostCostByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Cost-CostByUser"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, cost
        | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by user
        | sort total_cost desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryCostCostByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Cost-CostByModel"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, cost
        | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by model
        | sort total_cost desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryCostCostByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Cost-CostByOrganization"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, organization, cost
        | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by organization
        | sort total_cost desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryCostCostOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Cost-CostOverTime"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, cost
        | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by bin(1h) as hour
        | sort hour asc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  # Additional debugging and analysis queries
  SavedQueryDebugModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Debug-ModelEfficiency"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, tokens, cost
        | stats avg(tokens) as avg_tokens_per_request, avg(cost) as avg_cost_per_request by model
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryDebugCacheHitMissOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Debug-CacheHitMissOverall"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, cacheHit, cacheMiss
        | stats count(cacheHit) as cache_hits, count(cacheMiss) as cache_misses, (count(cacheHit) / (count(cacheHit)+count(cacheMiss)) * 100) as hit_rate
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryDebugCacheHitMissOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Debug-CacheHitMissOverTime"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, cacheHit, cacheMiss
        | stats count(cacheHit) as cache_hits, count(cacheMiss) as cache_misses by bin(1h) as hour
        | sort hour asc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryDebugPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Debug-PeakUsageWindows"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user
        | stats count() as request_count by bin(1h) as hour
        | sort request_count desc
        | limit 10
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryDebugDeepDiveSession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Debug-DeepDiveSession"
      QueryString: |
        # Replace <sessionId> with the actual session ID before running
        fields @timestamp, user, tokens, cost, model, cacheHit, cacheMiss, error, throttle
        | filter sessionId = "<sessionId>"
        | sort @timestamp asc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
  SavedQueryDebugDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ClaudeCode-Debug-DailyUsageSummary"
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, tokens, cost
        | stats sum(tokens) as total_tokens, sum(cost) as total_cost, count() as total_requests by bin(1d) as day
        | sort day asc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
Outputs:
  QueryDefinitionIds:
    Description: "List of all saved query definition IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ", "
      - - !Ref SavedQueryRealTimeTokenRatePerUser
        - !Ref SavedQueryRealTimeRequestRatePerUser
        - !Ref SavedQueryRealTimeCurrentTPM
        - !Ref SavedQueryRealTimeCurrentRPM
        - !Ref SavedQueryRealTimeRateLimitRisk
        - !Ref SavedQueryUserSessionSessionUsage
        - !Ref SavedQueryUserSessionHourlyActivity
        - !Ref SavedQueryUserSessionErrorDetection
        - !Ref SavedQueryUserSessionThrottlingDetection
        - !Ref SavedQueryCostCostByUser
        - !Ref SavedQueryCostCostByModel
        - !Ref SavedQueryCostCostByOrganization
        - !Ref SavedQueryCostCostOverTime
        - !Ref SavedQueryDebugModelEfficiency
        - !Ref SavedQueryDebugCacheHitMissOverall
        - !Ref SavedQueryDebugCacheHitMissOverTime
        - !Ref SavedQueryDebugPeakUsageWindows
        - !Ref SavedQueryDebugDeepDiveSession
        - !Ref SavedQueryDebugDailyUsageSummary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB data sources and logging"

Resources:
  # CloudWatch Logs log group for AppSync API logs
  AppSyncLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/appsync/apis/SuperCoolAPI"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # IAM role for AppSync to publish logs to CloudWatch Logs
  AppSyncLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AppSyncLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${AppSyncLogGroup.Arn}:*"

  # AppSync GraphQL API
  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: "SuperCoolAPI"
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLogRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL

  # DynamoDB table
  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: "Table1"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: description
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: description-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: description
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # IAM role for AppSync data sources to access DynamoDB
  AppSyncDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
                  - !Sub "${Table1.Arn}/index/*"

  # DynamoDB data source using !Ref for table name and !Ref AWS::Region for region
  DDBDataSource1:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: "DDBDataSource1"
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # DynamoDB data source using !Ref for table name and extracting region from table ARN
  DDBDataSource2:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: "DDBDataSource2"
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Select [3, !Split [":", !GetAtt Table1.Arn]]

  # GraphQL schema
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM identities and policies for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) with EKS"

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles and Instance Profiles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LegacyInTreeCloudProviderPolicy
        - !Ref NodeRegistrationAndImagePullPolicy
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerInfrastructurePolicy
        - !Ref ClusterAPIEKSClusterManagementPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-control-plane"

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-controllers-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerInfrastructurePolicy
        - !Ref ClusterAPIEKSClusterManagementPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-controllers"

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-controllers-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nodes-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - !Ref NodeRegistrationAndImagePullPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nodes"

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nodes-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS Service Roles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eks-control-plane-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eks-control-plane"

  EKSFargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eks-fargate-execution-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eks-fargate-execution"

  EKSManagedNodeGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eks-managed-node-group-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eks-managed-node-group"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer Managed Policies
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  LegacyInTreeCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-legacy-in-tree-cloud-provider-policy"
      Description: "Permissions for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider (EC2, Auto Scaling, ELB, KMS)"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
      # Roles property intentionally omitted to avoid circular dependency.
      # Attachment is done via ControlPlaneRole.ManagedPolicyArns.

  NodeRegistrationAndImagePullPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-node-registration-image-pull-policy"
      Description: "Permissions for node registration and image pull (EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager, SSM)"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
            Resource: "*"
      # Roles property intentionally omitted to avoid circular dependency.
      # Attachment is done via ControlPlaneRole.ManagedPolicyArns and NodesRole.ManagedPolicyArns.

  ClusterAPIControllerInfrastructurePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-capi-infrastructure-policy"
      Description: "Broad permissions for Cluster API controllers to manage infrastructure (EC2, ASG, ELB, launch templates, SLR)"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:Associate*
              - ec2:Disassociate*
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroup*
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroup*
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - autoscaling:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: "*"
      # Roles property intentionally omitted to avoid circular dependency.
      # Attachment is done via ControllersRole.ManagedPolicyArns and ControlPlaneRole.ManagedPolicyArns.

  ClusterAPIEKSClusterManagementPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-capi-eks-management-policy"
      Description: "EKS-specific permissions for Cluster API to manage clusters, node groups, add-ons, Fargate profiles, and related IAM/KMS"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:*
              - iam:PassRole
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: "*"
      # Roles property intentionally omitted to avoid circular dependency.
      # Attachment is done via ControllersRole.ManagedPolicyArns and ControlPlaneRole.ManagedPolicyArns.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared VPC for EMR on EKS and Celeborn shuffle service with VPC endpoints, Flow Logs, and KMS encryption

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 (AZ1)

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 (AZ2)

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.128.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 (AZ1)

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.144.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 (AZ2)

  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period for VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedVPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPC-IGW

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway-AZ2

    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable

      VpcId: !Ref VPC

        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable-AZ2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  # SSM endpoints
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # EC2 endpoint
  EC2Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # CloudWatch Logs endpoint
  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # CloudWatch Monitoring endpoint
  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # STS endpoint
  STSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # KMS endpoint
  KMSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # KMS key for Flow Logs encryption
  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPCFlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPCFlowLogRole

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates a VPC with IPv4 and IPv6 CIDRs across three Availability Zones,
  private subnets (always), and optionally public subnets with an Internet Gateway.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    Default: MyVPC
    Description: Name tag for the VPC (alphanumeric and hyphens only).
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
  CreatePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: true
    Description: Whether to create public subnets and associated resources.

Conditions:
  HasPublicSubnets: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnets, true]

Resources:
  # VPC with IPv4 CIDR
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName

  # Associate an Amazon-provided IPv6 CIDR with the VPC
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # Internet Gateway (created unconditionally, but only attached to route table if public subnets exist)
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Generate 6 IPv4 /20 subnets from VPC CIDR (first 3 for private, next 3 for public)

  # Private subnets (always created)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 4]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-a"
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 4]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-b"
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 4]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-c"
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  # Private route table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-rt"

  # Private subnet associations
  PrivateSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Public subnets (conditional)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 4]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-a"
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 4]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-b"
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 4]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-c"
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  # Public route table (conditional)
  PublicRouteTable:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-rt"

  # Default routes to Internet Gateway (conditional)
  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnet associations (conditional)
  PublicSubnet1Association:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2Association:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3Association:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs (empty if not created)
    Value: !If
      - HasPublicSubnets
      - !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
      - ''

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'IAM roles, policies, instance profiles, group, and user for Cluster API Provider for AWS (CAPA) bootstrap'

Parameters:
  EksOidcProviderArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the EKS OIDC provider for the management cluster (e.g., arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.region.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED)
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws:iam::\d{12}:oidc-provider/.*$'
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:oidc-provider/placeholder'
  Namespace:
    Type: String
    Description: Namespace where the CAPA controller runs (default capa-system)
    Default: capa-system
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
  ServiceAccountName:
    Type: String
    Description: Kubernetes service account name for the CAPA controller (default capa-controller-manager)
    Default: capa-controller-manager
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'

Resources:
  # Customer managed policy: Cloud Provider (EC2, ELB, ASG, ECR, Secrets Manager, SSM)
  CloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Policy for self-managed Kubernetes control plane and worker nodes to interact with AWS cloud provider
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ec2:*'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:*'
              - 'autoscaling:*'
              - 'ecr:*'
              - 'secretsmanager:*'
              - 'ssm:*'
            Resource: '*'

  # Customer managed policy: CAPA Controller (broader permissions for Cluster API)
  CAPAControllerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Policy for Cluster API Provider for AWS controllers and EKS control plane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ec2:*'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:*'
              - 'autoscaling:*'
              - 'eks:*'
              - 'iam:PassRole'
              - 'iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole'
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Resource: '*'

  # IAM role for self-managed Kubernetes control plane
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPA-ControlPlaneRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CloudProviderPolicy
      Path: /

  # Instance profile for control plane
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: CAPA-ControlPlaneInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # IAM role for self-managed worker nodes
  WorkerNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPA-WorkerNodeRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CloudProviderPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
      Path: /

  # Instance profile for worker nodes
  WorkerNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: CAPA-WorkerNodeInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole

  # IAM role for EKS cluster control plane (EKS service)
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPA-EKSControlPlaneRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControllerPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Path: /

  # IAM role for CAPA controllers (assumable by EC2 and EKS OIDC)
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPA-ControllersRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Ref EksOidcProviderArn
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'oidc.eks.amazonaws.com:aud': 'sts.amazonaws.com'
                'oidc.eks.amazonaws.com:sub': !Sub 'system:serviceaccount:${Namespace}:${ServiceAccountName}'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControllerPolicy
      Path: /

  # IAM group for bootstrapper
  BootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: CAPA-BootstrapperGroup
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControllerPolicy

  # IAM user for bootstrapper (programmatic access only; console password can be set separately)
  BootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: CAPA-BootstrapperUser
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup

  # Access keys for bootstrapper user
  BootstrapperAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref BootstrapperUser
      Status: Active

  # Secret for storing bootstrapper password (optional; can be used to enable console access)
  BootstrapperPassword:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: CAPA-BootstrapperPassword
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 20
        ExcludePunctuation: true

Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the self-managed control plane role
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
  WorkerNodeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the worker node role
    Value: !GetAtt WorkerNodeRole.Arn
  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS control plane role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers role
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn
  BootstrapperUserAccessKey:
    Description: Access key ID for bootstrapper user
    Value: !Ref BootstrapperAccessKey
  BootstrapperUserSecretKey:
    Description: Secret access key for bootstrapper user (visible only on creation)
    Value: !GetAtt BootstrapperAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
  CloudProviderPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the cloud provider policy
    Value: !Ref CloudProviderPolicy
  CAPAControllerPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controller policy
    Value: !Ref CAPAControllerPolicy
  BootstrapperPasswordSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret containing the bootstrapper password
    Value: !Ref BootstrapperPassword

    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'

  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2'

  NATGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-3'

  # Private Route Tables (one per AZ)
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsPerAZNAT, !Ref NATGateway2, !Ref NATGateway1]

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3'

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsPerAZNAT, !Ref NATGateway3, !Ref NATGateway1]

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      TrafficType: ALL
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 1 ID
    Value: !Ref NATGateway1

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 2 ID (empty if Single NAT)
    Value: !If [IsPerAZNAT, !Ref NATGateway2, '']

  NatGateway3Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 3 ID (empty if Single NAT)
    Value: !If [IsPerAZNAT, !Ref NATGateway3, '']

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Isolated private VPC for AI customer support application with VPC endpoints and Flow Logs

Mappings:
  # Known DynamoDB prefix list IDs per region (add more as needed)
  RegionPrefixList:
    us-east-1:
      DynamoDB: "pl-02cd2c6b"
    us-east-2:
      DynamoDB: "pl-02b8f7b3"
    us-west-1:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0abf5b6a"
    us-west-2:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0b5d9b6c"
    eu-west-1:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0c7b7b6a"
    eu-west-2:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0d8c7b6b"
    eu-central-1:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0e9d8b6c"
    ap-southeast-1:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0f0e9b6d"
    ap-southeast-2:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0a1f0b6e"
    ap-northeast-1:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0b2a1b6f"
    ap-northeast-2:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0c3b2b70"
    ap-south-1:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0d4c3b71"
    sa-east-1:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0e5d4c72"
    ca-central-1:
      DynamoDB: "pl-0f6e5d73"

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AI-Support-VPC
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Private-Subnet-1
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Private-Subnet-2
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Private-Subnet-3

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Private-RouteTable

  # Subnet Associations
  SubnetRouteTableAssoc1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  SubnetRouteTableAssoc2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  SubnetRouteTableAssoc3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # KMS Key for Flow Logs (with permission for CloudWatch Logs)
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow VPC Flow Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  # Log Group for Flow Logs (using KMS key ARN)
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/ai-support-vpc
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # IAM Role for Flow Logs
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  # VPC Flow Log
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs

  # Security Group for VPC Endpoints
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Endpoint-SG

  # Ingress rules for EndpointSecurityGroup
  EndpointSGIngressAgent:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
  EndpointSGIngressMCP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
  EndpointSGIngressLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup

  # Component Security Groups
  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Agent Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Agent-Runtime-SG
  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for MCP Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MCP-Runtime-SG
  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Lambda functions
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lambda-SG

  # Egress rules for component SGs: HTTPS to endpoint SG, and HTTPS to DynamoDB prefix list
  # Agent Runtime egress
  AgentRuntimeEgressToEndpointSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
  AgentRuntimeEgressToDynamoDB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !FindInMap [RegionPrefixList, !Ref "AWS::Region", DynamoDB]
  # MCP Runtime egress
  MCPRuntimeEgressToEndpointSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
  MCPRuntimeEgressToDynamoDB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !FindInMap [RegionPrefixList, !Ref "AWS::Region", DynamoDB]
  # Lambda egress
  LambdaEgressToEndpointSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
  LambdaEgressToDynamoDB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !FindInMap [RegionPrefixList, !Ref "AWS::Region", DynamoDB]

  # Gateway Endpoints (S3 and DynamoDB)
  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  DynamoDBEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Interface Endpoints
  BedrockRuntimeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock-runtime
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ECRApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ECRDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  RDSDataEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.rds-data
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KMSEndpoint:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC infrastructure for Amazon EKS with public/private subnets across 3 AZs, NAT gateways, and security groups."

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name used to tag resources"
    Default: "EKS-VPC"
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: "^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR between /16 and /28"
  PublicSubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ1"
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR between /24 and /32"
  PublicSubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ2"
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR between /24 and /32"
  PublicSubnetCidr3:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ3"
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR between /24 and /32"
  PrivateSubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ1"
    Default: "10.0.4.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR between /24 and /32"
  PrivateSubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ2"
    Default: "10.0.5.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR between /24 and /32"
  PrivateSubnetCidr3:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ3"
    Default: "10.0.6.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR between /24 and /32"
  AppCustomPorts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: "Custom TCP ports to expose on the application ingress security group"
    Default: "8443,15021"

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr3
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-3"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr3
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-3"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-1"
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-2"
  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-3"

  # Private Route Tables (one per AZ)
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1"
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2"
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3"
  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # Security Groups
  SecurityGroupEKSControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for EKS control plane communication with worker nodes"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-eks-control-plane-sg"
  SecurityGroupAppIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for application ingress / service mesh"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Select [0, !Ref AppCustomPorts]
          ToPort: !Select [0, !Ref AppCustomPorts]
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Select [1, !Ref AppCustomPorts]
          ToPort: !Select [1, !Ref AppCustomPorts]
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-app-ingress-sg"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security group ID for EKS control plane"
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroupEKSControlPlane
  AppIngressSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security group ID for application ingress"
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroupAppIngress
  SubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of all subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
