AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM execution role for SageMaker HyperPod with EKS integration"

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "SageMakerHyperPod"
    Description: Prefix for naming the IAM role (will append "ExecRole")
  EksClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: VPC ID for scoping permissions
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: List of security group IDs for ENI policies
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: List of private subnet IDs for ENI policies
  LifecycleScriptBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: S3 bucket name for lifecycle scripts
  RigFlag:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: Enable RIG policy creation
  RigInputBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: S3 bucket name for RIG input (required if RigFlag is true)
  RigOutputBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: S3 bucket name for RIG output (optional)
  GatedAccessFlag:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: Enable gated access permissions (requires RigFlag=true)

Conditions:
  HasPrefix:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref ResourceNamePrefix, ""]]
  HasVpcId:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
  HasEksClusterName:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref EksClusterName, ""]]
  HasLifecycleBucket:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref LifecycleScriptBucket, ""]]
  HasRigFlag:
    !Equals [!Ref RigFlag, "true"]
  HasRigInputBucket:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigInputBucket, ""]]
  HasRigOutputBucket:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputBucket, ""]]
  HasGatedAccess:
    !Equals [!Ref GatedAccessFlag, "true"]
  CreateRigPolicy:
    !And [Condition: HasRigFlag, Condition: HasRigInputBucket]
  CreateGatedPolicy:
    !And [Condition: HasRigFlag, Condition: HasGatedAccess]
  CreateOutputBucketPolicy:
    !And [Condition: HasRigFlag, Condition: HasRigOutputBucket]

  # Conditions for subnet and security group policies (first element only)
  HasSubnet0:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Fn::Join:
              - ""
              - !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
          - ""
  HasSG0:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Fn::Join:
              - ""
              - !Ref SecurityGroupIds
          - ""

  # Composite conditions combining HasPrefix with specific guards
  VpcPolicyCondition:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasPrefix
      - Condition: HasVpcId
  EksAuthPolicyCondition:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasPrefix
      - Condition: HasEksClusterName
  LifecycleBucketPolicyCondition:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasPrefix
      - Condition: HasLifecycleBucket
  Subnet0PolicyCondition:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasPrefix
      - Condition: HasSubnet0
  SG0PolicyCondition:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasPrefix
      - Condition: HasSG0
  RIGInputPolicyCondition:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasPrefix
      - Condition: CreateRigPolicy
  RIGOutputPolicyCondition:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasPrefix
      - Condition: CreateOutputBucketPolicy
  GatedAccessPolicyCondition:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasPrefix
      - Condition: CreateGatedPolicy

Resources:
  SageMakerExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasPrefix
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCNIPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: ENIManagementAndServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*"
                  - "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: sagemaker-hyperpod-prereq
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  # Conditional VPC ENI policy
  VpcENIPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: VpcPolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-VpcENI"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:vpc/${VpcId}"

  # Conditional EKS auth policy
  EksAuthPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: EksAuthPolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-EksAuth"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:eks:*:*:cluster/${EksClusterName}"

  # Conditional lifecycle bucket policy
  LifecycleBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: LifecycleBucketPolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-LifecycleBucket"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptBucket}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptBucket}/*"

  # Subnet-specific ENI policy (first subnet)
  SubnetENIPolicy0:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: Subnet0PolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-SubnetENI0"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: !Join ["", ["arn:aws:ec2:*:*:subnet/", !Select [0, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]]]

  # Security group-specific ENI policy (first security group)
  SGENIPolicy0:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: SG0PolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-SGENI0"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: !Join ["", ["arn:aws:ec2:*:*:security-group/", !Select [0, !Ref SecurityGroupIds]]]

  # RIG Input Bucket Policy (conditional)
  RIGInputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: RIGInputPolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-RIGInput"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucket}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucket}/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                "lambda:FunctionName":
                  - "*SageMaker*"
                  - "*sagemaker*"

  # RIG Output Bucket Policy (conditional)
  RIGOutputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: RIGOutputPolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-RIGOutput"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RigOutputBucket}/*"

  # Gated Access Policy (conditional)
  GatedAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: GatedAccessPolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-GatedAccess"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucket}/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                "sqs:QueueName":
                  - "*SageMaker*"
                  - "*sagemaker*"

Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Condition: HasPrefix
    Description: Name of the created IAM execution role
    Value: !Ref SageMakerExecRole
  RoleArn:
    Condition: HasPrefix
    Description: ARN of the created IAM execution role
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerExecRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for private subnets with NAT gateways, route tables, network ACL associations, and S3 VPC endpoint. Fully self-contained for greenfield deployments.'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.24.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnets for NAT Gateways
  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetA"

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetB"

  PublicSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetC"

  # Public route table with default route to IGW
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociationA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociationB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociationC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  EIPA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EIP-A"

  EIPB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EIP-B"

  EIPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EIP-C"

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-A"

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-B"

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-C"

  # Network ACL (no custom rules – uses default allow-all rules)
  MyNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NetworkAcl"

  # Private subnets (as originally specified)
  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.24.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetA"

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.25.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetB"

  PrivateSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.26.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetC"

  # Private route tables (one per AZ)
  RouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableA"

  RouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableB"

  RouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableC"

  # Routes to NAT Gateways
  RouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  RouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  RouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

  # Subnet to route table associations
  SubnetRouteTableAssociationA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableA

  SubnetRouteTableAssociationB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableB

  SubnetRouteTableAssociationC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableC

  # Subnet to Network ACL associations
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociationA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      NetworkAclId: !Ref MyNetworkAcl

  SubnetNetworkAclAssociationB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      NetworkAclId: !Ref MyNetworkAcl

  SubnetNetworkAclAssociationC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      NetworkAclId: !Ref MyNetworkAcl

  # S3 VPC Gateway Endpoint
  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref RouteTableA
        - !Ref RouteTableB
        - !Ref RouteTableC
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-S3VpcEndpoint"

Outputs:
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnetA, !Ref PrivateSubnetB, !Ref PrivateSubnetC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds"

  PrivateRouteTableIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private route table IDs.
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref RouteTableA, !Ref RouteTableB, !Ref RouteTableC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableIds"

  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet group.
    Value: "10.24.24.0/21"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetCidr"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Baseline IAM groups, roles, instance profiles, and managed policies for operational personas.

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Policies
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: SystemAdministratorPolicy
      Description: Allows all actions except IAM, requires MFA, denies billing console access, denies KMS logging key tampering.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - iam:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:kms:*:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:ResourceTag/KeyPurpose: 'logging'

  IAMAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: IAMAdministratorPolicy
      Description: Allows full IAM access, requires MFA, denies billing console access, denies KMS logging key tampering.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:kms:*:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:ResourceTag/KeyPurpose: 'logging'

  InstanceOperationsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: InstanceOperationsPolicy
      Description: Allows EC2, ELB, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling; denies VPC networking modifications; requires MFA; denies billing console access; denies KMS logging key tampering.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - cloudwatch:*
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:kms:*:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:ResourceTag/KeyPurpose: 'logging'

  ReadOnlyAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ReadOnlyAdminPolicy
      Description: Broad read-only access across core services; requires MFA; denies billing console access; denies KMS logging key tampering.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - s3:Get*
              - s3:List*
              - rds:Describe*
              - lambda:Get*
              - lambda:List*
              - cloudwatch:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:Get*
              - logs:Describe*
              - logs:Get*
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:GetKeyPolicy
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:kms:*:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:ResourceTag/KeyPurpose: 'logging'

  BillingReadOnlyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BillingReadOnlyPolicy
      Description: Read-only billing access; no MFA requirement; no billing console denial; no KMS logging key denial.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - aws-portal:View*
              - budgets:View*
              - ce:*
              - pricing:*
            Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Groups
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdministrators:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorPolicy

  IAMAdministrators:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: IAMAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorPolicy

  InstanceOperators:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: InstanceOperators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdmins:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: ReadOnlyAdmins
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminPolicy

  BillingReaders:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: BillingReaders
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BillingReadOnlyPolicy

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Roles (EC2-assumable) and Instance Profiles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SystemAdministratorRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorPolicy

  SystemAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: SystemAdministratorInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorRole

  IAMAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: IAMAdministratorRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorPolicy

  IAMAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: IAMAdministratorInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorRole

  InstanceOperatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: InstanceOperatorRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsPolicy

  InstanceOperatorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: InstanceOperatorInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOperatorRole

  ReadOnlyAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ReadOnlyAdminRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: ReadOnlyAdminInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminRole

Outputs:
  SystemAdminsGroupId:
    Description: Group ID for SystemAdministrators
    Value: !Ref SystemAdministrators
  IamAdminsGroupId:
    Description: Group ID for IAMAdministrators
    Value: !Ref IAMAdministrators
  InstanceOpsGroupId:
    Description: Group ID for InstanceOperators
    Value: !Ref InstanceOperators
  ReadOnlyAdminsGroupId:
    Description: Group ID for ReadOnlyAdmins
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyAdmins
  BillingReadersGroupId:
    Description: Group ID for BillingReaders
    Value: !Ref BillingReaders

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC with three-tier architecture (Web, App, DB) across three Availability Zones'

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web Subnets (Public)
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az1'

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.1.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az2'

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.2.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az3'

  # Web Subnet to Public Route Table Associations
  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ in the Web subnets)
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az3'

  # Application Subnets (Private)
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.10.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az1'

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.11.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az2'

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.12.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az3'

  # Application Route Tables and Routes (one per AZ, tied to respective NAT Gateway)
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az1'

  AppRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway1
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az2'

  AppRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway2
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az3'

  AppRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway3
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # Database Subnets (Private)
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.20.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az1'

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.21.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az2'

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.22.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az3'

  # Database Route Tables and Routes (one per AZ, tied to respective NAT Gateway)
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-az1'

  DbRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway1
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1

  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-az2'

  DbRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway2
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2

  DbRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-az3'

  DbRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway3
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: The three Availability Zones used
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - [!Select [0, !GetAZs ''], !Select [1, !GetAZs ''], !Select [2, !GetAZs '']]

  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: The list of web (public) subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - [!Ref WebSubnet1, !Ref WebSubnet2, !Ref WebSubnet3]

  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: The list of application (private) subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]

  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: The list of database (private) subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - [!Ref DbSubnet1, !Ref DbSubnet2, !Ref DbSubnet3]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates shared IAM roles and instance profiles for Amazon EKS Quick Start'

Resources:
  # Lambda Execution Roles
  CopyZipArtifactsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CopyZipArtifactsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CopyZipArtifacts
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: '*'

  ReadResourceInfoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ReadResourceInfoRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  CreateVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CreateVpcRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateVpc
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVpc
                  - ec2:CreateSubnet
                  - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-DeleteBucketContentsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteBucketContents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*'

  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CleanupLoadBalancersRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLoadBalancers
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
                Resource: '*'

  CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupSecurityGroupDependencies
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: '*'

  CleanupLambdaFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CleanupLambdaFunctionsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLambdaFunctions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: '*'

  ResolveCallerArnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ResolveCallerArnRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveCallerArn
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'

  RegisterCustomResourceTypeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-RegisterCustomResourceTypeRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegisterCustomResourceType
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeVersions
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                Resource: '*'

  ManageNodeSecurityGroupsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ManageNodeSecurityGroupsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageNodeSecurityGroups
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'

  CreateFargateProfilesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CreateFargateProfilesRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateFargateProfiles
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn

  ResolveSsmParametersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ResolveSsmParametersRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveSsmParameters
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: 'arn:aws:ssm:*:*:parameter/quickstart/amazon-eks/*'

  # EKS Control Plane Role
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-EKSControlPlaneRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSControlPlaneAdditional
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'

  # Fargate Execution Role
  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-FargateExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy

  # Managed Node Instance Role and Instance Profile
  ManagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ManagedNodeInstanceRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-ManagedNodeInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeInstanceRole

  # Unmanaged Node Instance Role and Instance Profile
  UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole

  # Role Creation Role
  RoleCreationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-RoleCreationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateKubernetesVpcRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                Resource: 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                Resource: 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PolicyARN':
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # SSM Parameters to store role ARNs
  CopyZipArtifactsRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/CopyZipArtifactsRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt CopyZipArtifactsRole.Arn

  ReadResourceInfoRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/ReadResourceInfoRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ReadResourceInfoRole.Arn

  CreateVpcRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/CreateVpcRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt CreateVpcRole.Arn

  DeleteBucketContentsRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/DeleteBucketContentsRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt DeleteBucketContentsRole.Arn

  CleanupLoadBalancersRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/CleanupLoadBalancersRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt CleanupLoadBalancersRole.Arn

  CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole.Arn

  CleanupLambdaFunctionsRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/CleanupLambdaFunctionsRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt CleanupLambdaFunctionsRole.Arn

  ResolveCallerArnRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/ResolveCallerArnRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ResolveCallerArnRole.Arn

  RegisterCustomResourceTypeRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/RegisterCustomResourceTypeRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt RegisterCustomResourceTypeRole.Arn

  ManageNodeSecurityGroupsRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/ManageNodeSecurityGroupsRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManageNodeSecurityGroupsRole.Arn

  CreateFargateProfilesRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/CreateFargateProfilesRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt CreateFargateProfilesRole.Arn

  ResolveSsmParametersRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/ResolveSsmParametersRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ResolveSsmParametersRole.Arn

  EKSControlPlaneRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/EKSControlPlaneRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn

  FargateExecutionRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/FargateExecutionRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn

  ManagedNodeInstanceRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/ManagedNodeInstanceRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeInstanceRole.Arn

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceRoleParam:

    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/UnmanagedNodeInstanceRoleArn
      Type: String

  RoleCreationRoleParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/RoleCreationRoleArn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt RoleCreationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Lab VPC with web and application subnets, security group, S3 gateway endpoint, Kinesis endpoints'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

Resources:
  LabVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabVPC
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Lab

  WebSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!GetAtt LabVPC.CidrBlock, 5, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnetA
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Web
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Lab

  WebSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!GetAtt LabVPC.CidrBlock, 5, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnetB
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Web
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Lab

  AppSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!GetAtt LabVPC.CidrBlock, 5, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnetA
        - Key: Tier
          Value: App
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Lab

  AppSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!GetAtt LabVPC.CidrBlock, 5, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnetB
        - Key: Tier
          Value: App
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Lab

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedRouteTable
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Lab

  WebSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web tier security group - allow HTTPS from VPC
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt LabVPC.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !GetAtt LabVPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Lab

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
            Resource: '*'

  KinesisFirehoseEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnetA
        - !Ref WebSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KinesisFirehoseEndpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Lab

  KinesisStreamsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnetA
        - !Ref WebSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KinesisStreamsEndpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Lab

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref LabVPC
  WebSubnetAId:
    Description: Web subnet A ID
    Value: !Ref WebSubnetA
  WebSubnetBId:
    Description: Web subnet B ID
    Value: !Ref WebSubnetB
  AppSubnetAId:
    Description: App subnet A ID
    Value: !Ref AppSubnetA
  AppSubnetBId:
    Description: App subnet B ID
    Value: !Ref AppSubnetB
  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Web security group ID
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Shared IAM roles for EKS cluster deployments"

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    Description: "Common prefix for all IAM role and instance profile names."

Resources:
  # Lambda execution roles
  LambdaAssetCopyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-lambda-asset-copy"
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AssetCopyPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"

  LambdaResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-lambda-resource-reader"
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResourceReaderPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - ec2:Describe*

                  - eks:Describe*
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles

Description: 'Self-contained IAM user and group configuration with Secrets Manager secret'

Parameters:
  ID:
    Type: String
    Default: '999hadvhgchjesr'
    Description: 'Identifier used to name the IAM group'

Resources:
  # Secrets Manager secret with generated username and password
  MinesweeperSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: 'Minesweeper user secret'
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"minesweeper-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: 'password'
        PasswordLength: 15
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
        ExcludeCharacters: '|;,."<>%`'

  # IAM group named minesweeper-{ID}
  MinesweeperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub 'minesweeper-${ID}'

  # Inline policy for the group granting full access to ec2, cloudformation, secretsmanager
  MinesweeperGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      Groups:
        - !Ref MinesweeperGroup
      PolicyName: 'minesweeper-full-access'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ec2:*'
              - 'cloudformation:*'
              - 'secretsmanager:*'
            Resource: '*'

  # IAM role for the Lambda function
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'SecretsManagerAccess'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'secretsmanager:GetSecretValue'
                Resource: !Ref MinesweeperSecret
        - PolicyName: 'IAMUserManagement'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:CreateUser'
                  - 'iam:DeleteUser'
                  - 'iam:GetUser'
                  - 'iam:CreateLoginProfile'
                  - 'iam:DeleteLoginProfile'
                  - 'iam:AddUserToGroup'
                  - 'iam:RemoveUserFromGroup'
                  - 'iam:ListGroups'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: 'CloudWatchLogs'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: 'arn:aws:logs:*:*:*'

  # Lambda function to create IAM user and set login profile
  UserCreatorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              secret_arn = props['SecretArn']
              group_name = props['GroupName']

              secretsmanager = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
              iam = boto3.client('iam')

              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create' or request_type == 'Update':
                      # Retrieve secret value
                      response = secretsmanager.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
                      secret = json.loads(response['SecretString'])
                      username = secret['username']
                      password = secret['password']

                      # Create IAM user
                      try:
                          iam.create_user(UserName=username)
                      except iam.exceptions.EntityAlreadyExistsException:
                          pass  # If user already exists, continue (update case)

                      # Create login profile (set password)
                      try:
                          iam.create_login_profile(UserName=username, Password=password, PasswordResetRequired=False)
                      except iam.exceptions.EntityAlreadyExistsException:
                          iam.update_login_profile(UserName=username, Password=password, PasswordResetRequired=False)

                      # Add user to group
                      iam.add_user_to_group(GroupName=group_name, UserName=username)

                      physical_resource_id = username

                      # Get user ARN
                      user = iam.get_user(UserName=username)
                      user_arn = user['User']['Arn']

                      response_data = {'UserARN': user_arn}
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data, physical_resource_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_resource_id:
                          username = physical_resource_id
                          # Remove user from group
                          try:
                              iam.remove_user_from_group(GroupName=group_name, UserName=username)
                          except iam.exceptions.NoSuchEntityException:
                              pass
                          # Delete login profile if exists
                          try:
                              iam.delete_login_profile(UserName=username)
                          except iam.exceptions.NoSuchEntityException:
                              pass
                          # Delete user
                          try:
                              iam.delete_user(UserName=username)
                          except iam.exceptions.NoSuchEntityException:
                              pass
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_resource_id)

              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error: {str(e)}")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)}, physical_resource_id)

  # Custom resource that invokes the Lambda (implicit dependencies via Ref/GetAtt)
  MinesweeperUserResource:
    Type: Custom::MinesweeperUserCreator
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt UserCreatorFunction.Arn
      SecretArn: !Ref MinesweeperSecret
      GroupName: !Ref MinesweeperGroup

    Description: 'ARN of the created IAM user'
    Value: !GetAtt MinesweeperUserResource.UserARN

          import base64
          import boto3
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import json
          import os

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

          def sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()

          def smtp_password(secret, region):
              key = ('AWS4' + secret).encode()
              for part in ('20120214', region, 'ses', 'aws4_request'):

                  'Reason': reason or 'See CloudWatch logs',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': data
              })
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'],
                  data=body.encode(),
                  headers={'Content-Type': ''},
                  method='PUT'
              )

              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              username = props['IAMUserName']
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or username + '-ses-smtp-credentials'

                  try:

                          try:

                          except Exception:
                              pass
                      respond(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)
                  except Exception as e:
                      respond(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_id, str(e))
                  return

                  secret = props['SecretAccessKey']
                  region = props.get('Region', os.environ['AWS_REGION'])

                          'Value': value,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_arn:
                          kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_arn
                      ssm.put_parameter(**kwargs)
                  respond(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  respond(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_id, str(e))

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  WebSocket API for grant-processing status updates, backed by a single Lambda
  function, with encrypted environment variables and access logs.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: The name of the API stage (e.g., prod, dev)

Resources:
  # ===========================================================================
  # WebSocket API
  # ===========================================================================
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: GrantStatusWebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Routes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "$connect"
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${Integration}"

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "$disconnect"
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${Integration}"

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "$default"
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${Integration}"

  SendMessageRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "sendmessage"
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${Integration}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Integration (shared by all routes)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Integration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      PayloadFormatVersion: "1.0"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Deployment & Stage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - SendMessageRoute
      - Integration

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        DetailedMetricsEnabled: true
        LoggingLevel: INFO
      AccessLogSettings:

  # ===========================================================================

  # ===========================================================================
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
