      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*"

  # ===========================================================================
  # IAM Roles
  # ===========================================================================
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: GrantStatusWebSocketLambdaRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/GrantStatusWebSocketHandler*"
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: ManageConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/@connections/*"

  RelatedFunctionRole1:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: GrantStatusWebSocketRelatedRole1
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  RelatedFunctionRole2:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: GrantStatusWebSocketRelatedRole2
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ApiGatewayLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ApiGatewayCloudWatchLoggingRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"

  # ===========================================================================
  # IAM Policy for KMS access (attached to LambdaExecutionRole)
  # ===========================================================================
  LambdaKmsAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LambdaKMSDecrypt
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${LambdaEnvKmsKey}"

  # ===========================================================================
  # DynamoDB Table (connection tracking)
  # ===========================================================================
  ConnectionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: GrantStatusConnections
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # ===========================================================================
  # KMS Keys
  # ===========================================================================
  LambdaEnvKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Lambda environment variables
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt RelatedFunctionRole1.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt RelatedFunctionRole2.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"

  LambdaEnvKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/lambda-env-encryption-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKmsKey

  CloudWatchLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting API Gateway access logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
            Resource: "*"

  CloudWatchLogsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cloudwatch-logs-encryption-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudWatchLogsKmsKey

  # ===========================================================================
  # CloudWatch Log Group (API Gateway access logs)
  # ===========================================================================
  AccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/apigateway/websocket-${StageName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${CloudWatchLogsKmsKey}"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # ===========================================================================
  # API Gateway Account-Level CloudWatch Logging
  # ===========================================================================
  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLoggingRole.Arn

# =============================================================================
# Stack Outputs
# =============================================================================
Outputs:
  WebSocketConnectionUrl:
    Description: WebSocket connection URL (WSS)
    Value: !GetAtt WebSocketApi.ApiEndpoint

  SecureWssEndpointUrl:
    Description: Secure WSS endpoint URL for the deployed stage
    Value: !Sub "${WebSocketApi.ApiEndpoint}/${StageName}"

  ApiArn:
    Description: API ARN
    Value: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for a Kinesis data stream with a single shard, server-side encryption using the default AWS managed KMS key, and exports for cross-stack consumption.'
Resources:
  TestKinesisStream:
    Type: AWS::Kinesis::Stream
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ShardCount: 1
      StreamEncryption:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KeyId: alias/aws/kinesis
Outputs:
  KinesisStreamName:
    Description: Name of the Kinesis stream
    Value: !Ref TestKinesisStream
    Export:
      Name: TestKinesisStreamName
  KinesisStreamArn:
    Description: ARN of the Kinesis stream
    Value: !GetAtt TestKinesisStream.Arn

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: webhook-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role:

      Environment:
        Variables:

          import json
          import hmac
          import hashlib
          import urllib.request
          import os
          import logging
          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              headers = event.get('headers', {})
              signature = headers.get('Stripe-Signature', '')
              payload = event.get('body', '')
              secret = os.environ['STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET']
              expected_sig = compute_signature(payload, secret)
              if not signature or not hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected_sig):
                  logger.error("Invalid signature")
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Invalid signature'}

              try:
                  data = json.loads(payload)
              except:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Invalid JSON'}

          def compute_signature(payload, secret):
              return hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

        - IpProtocol: tcp

          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet2CIDR

        - IpProtocol: tcp

          ToPort: 6379

        - IpProtocol: tcp

          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet2CIDR

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-redis'

                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {"Service": "cloudwatch.amazonaws.com"},
                "Action": ["sns:Publish"],
                "Resource": "arn:aws:sns:*:*:*"

                "Sid": "AllowAccountManagement",
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {"AWS": "${AccountId}"},
                "Action": ["sns:Publish", "sns:Subscribe", "sns:GetTopicAttributes", "sns:SetTopicAttributes"],
                "Resource": "arn:aws:sns:*:*:*"

          }'
        - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
  IamRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-automation'

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ssm-automation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'

        - Key: Name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API for a songs service with IAM auth, DynamoDB storage, and a two-step Lambda pipeline resolver for addSong.
Resources:
  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncServiceRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${SongsTable}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ValidateArtist.Arn
                  - !GetAtt WriteSong.Arn

  ValidateArtistRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ValidateArtistLambdaLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  WriteSongRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WriteSongLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${SongsTable}

  ValidateArtist:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ValidateArtist
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ValidateArtistRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import re

          def handler(event, context):
              arguments = event.get('arguments', {})
              if not isinstance(arguments, dict):
                  arguments = {}

              artist = arguments.get('artist')

              if not isinstance(artist, str) or not artist or not re.match(r'^[A-Za-z]+$', artist):
                  return {
                      'type': 'ValidationError',
                      'message': 'Artist must be a non-empty string containing only letters.'
                  }

              return event

  WriteSong:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WriteSong
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt WriteSongRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SONGS_TABLE: !Ref SongsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import uuid
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['SONGS_TABLE']

          def handler(event, context):
              arguments = event.get('arguments', event)
              if not isinstance(arguments, dict):
                  arguments = {}

              song = {
                  'id': str(uuid.uuid4()),
                  'name': arguments.get('name'),
                  'artist': arguments.get('artist')
              }

              dynamodb.Table(table_name).put_item(Item=song)
              return song

  ValidateArtistPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ValidateArtist
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: appsync.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.Arn

  WriteSongPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:

      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: appsync.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.Arn

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SongsGraphQLApi
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song!]!
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String!): Song
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  SongsTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsTableDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  ValidateArtistDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidateArtistDataSource
      Type: AWS_LAMBDA
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      LambdaConfig:
        LambdaFunctionArn: !GetAtt ValidateArtist.Arn

  WriteSongDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: WriteSongDataSource
      Type: AWS_LAMBDA
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      LambdaConfig:
        LambdaFunctionArn: !GetAtt WriteSong.Arn

  ValidateArtistFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidateArtistFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt ValidateArtistDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Invoke",
          "payload": {
            "arguments": $util.toJson($ctx.arguments)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if ($ctx.result.type && $ctx.result.message)
          $util.error($ctx.result.message, $ctx.result.type)
        #else
          $util.toJson($ctx.result.arguments)
        #end

  WriteSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: WriteSongFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt WriteSongDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Invoke",
          "payload": $util.toJson({ "arguments": $ctx.prev.result })
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsTableDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "Scan"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result.items)

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidateArtistFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt WriteSongFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {}
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Description: "Cognito user pool, app client, and regional REST API with Cognito authorizer and Lambda proxy integration."

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  AuthFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              path = event.get("resource") or event.get("requestContext", {}).get("resourcePath", "")

              if path == "/me":
                  claims = event["requestContext"]["authorizer"]["claims"]
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 200,
                      "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": json.dumps({"message": "Authenticated request", "claims": claims}, default=str)
                  }

              if path == "/open":
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 200,
                      "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": json.dumps({"message": "Open endpoint", "claims": None}, default=str)
                  }

              return {
                  "statusCode": 404,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"error": "Not found"}, default=str)
                  }

  LambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AuthFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/prod/GET/*"

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  MeMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${AuthFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  OpenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${AuthFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeMethod
      - OpenMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment for auth API

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - LambdaPermission
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage

Outputs:

    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool

    Description: Cognito User Pool App Client ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  ApiInvokeURL:
    Description: Full invoke URL for the prod API stage
    Value: !Sub "https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/prod"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Connects this AWS account to marbot.io monitoring, including heartbeat, registration, and a cross-account monitoring role."
Parameters:
  MarbotEndpointID:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder"
    Description: "Marbot endpoint identifier used to construct marbot API URLs and derive the API key."
  MarbotAccountID:
    Type: String
    Default: "000000000000"
    Description: "AWS account ID owned by marbot that is allowed to assume the cross-account monitoring role."
  StackName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MarbotStack"
    Description: "Name used to identify this stack in marbot's service."
  AutoCloudWatchAlarms:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Enable marbot to manage CloudWatch alarms and EventBridge monitoring rules."
  EnrichAccountIDs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Enable marbot to enrich account IDs with friendly account aliases."
  EmbedMetricGraphs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Enable marbot to embed metric graphs in CloudWatch alarm notifications."
  ApproveCodePipeline:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Enable marbot to approve or reject CodePipeline manual approval actions."
Conditions:
  IsAutoCloudWatchAlarmsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref AutoCloudWatchAlarms, "true"]
  IsEnrichAccountIDsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnrichAccountIDs, "true"]
  IsEmbedMetricGraphsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EmbedMetricGraphs, "true"]
  IsApproveCodePipelineEnabled: !Equals [!Ref ApproveCodePipeline, "true"]
  IsMarbotAccountReal: !Not [!Equals [!Ref MarbotAccountID, "000000000000"]]
Resources:
  ApiKeySecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Marbot API key for endpoint ${MarbotEndpointID} in stack ${StackName}"

  ApiKeyDerivationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: marbot-create-secret
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: marbot-write-secret
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Ref ApiKeySecret
        - PolicyName: marbot-lambda-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  ApiKeyDerivationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ApiKeyDerivationRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 300
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
                  arn = props.get('SecretArn', '')
                  api_key = ''
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      api_key = hmac.new(
                          props['StackID'].encode('utf-8'),
                          props['EndpointID'].encode('utf-8'),
                          hashlib.sha256
                      ).hexdigest()
                      boto3.client('secretsmanager').put_secret_value(SecretId=arn, SecretString=api_key)
                  response_data = {'SecretArn': arn}
                  if api_key:
                      response_data['ApiKeyValue'] = api_key
                  event['PhysicalResourceId'] = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or ('marbot-secret-' + arn)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {})

  ApiKeyDerivationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ApiKeyDerivationFunction
      Principal: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Ref "AWS::StackId"

  ApiKeyDerivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: ApiKeyDerivationPermission
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ApiKeyDerivationFunction.Arn
      EndpointID: !Ref MarbotEndpointID
      StackID: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      SecretArn: !Ref ApiKeySecret

  MarbotConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Properties:
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      Description: !Sub "Marbot connection for endpoint ${MarbotEndpointID}"
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: x-api-key
          ApiKeyValue: !GetAtt ApiKeyDerivation.ApiKeyValue

  MarbotApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt MarbotConnection.Arn
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub "https://api.marbot.io/endpoint/${MarbotEndpointID}/heartbeat"
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 10

  EventBridgeInvocationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: marbot-invoke-api-destination
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:InvokeApiDestination
                Resource: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn

  MarbotHeartbeatRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Sends a 30-day heartbeat to marbot for endpoint ${MarbotEndpointID}"
      ScheduleExpression: "rate(30 days)"
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MarbotHeartbeat
          Arn: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvocationRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub '{"account": "${AWS::AccountId}", "region": "${AWS::Region}", "stack": "${StackName}", "endpoint": "${MarbotEndpointID}"}'

  PermissionsBoundary:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: IsAutoCloudWatchAlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Permissions boundary for the marbot cross-account role in ${StackName}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowReadOnlyMonitoring
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - events:DescribeRule
              - events:ListRules
              - events:ListTargetsByRule
              - iam:ListAccountAliases
              - codepipeline:GetPipeline
              - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
              - codepipeline:ListPipelines
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: CreateMonitoringResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
              - events:PutRule
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ManageTaggedMonitoringResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
              - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
              - events:DeleteRule
              - events:PutTargets
              - events:RemoveTargets
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:ResourceTag/marbot:managed": "true"
          - Sid: ApproveTaggedCodePipelines
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:ResourceTag/marbot:managed": "true"

  MarbotRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsMarbotAccountReal
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${MarbotAccountID}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      PermissionsBoundary:
        Fn::If:
          - IsAutoCloudWatchAlarmsEnabled
          - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - Fn::If:
            - IsAutoCloudWatchAlarmsEnabled
            - PolicyName: marbot-auto-cloudwatch-alarms
              PolicyDocument:
                Version: "2012-10-17"
                Statement:
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                      - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
                      - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric
                      - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                      - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                      - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                      - events:DescribeRule
                      - events:ListRules
                      - events:ListTargetsByRule
                      - events:PutRule
                      - events:DeleteRule
                      - events:PutTargets
                      - events:RemoveTargets
                    Resource: "*"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - Fn::If:
            - IsEnrichAccountIDsEnabled
            - PolicyName: marbot-enrich-account-ids
              PolicyDocument:
                Version: "2012-10-17"
                Statement:
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - iam:ListAccountAliases
                    Resource: "*"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - Fn::If:
            - IsEmbedMetricGraphsEnabled
            - PolicyName: marbot-embed-metric-graphs
              PolicyDocument:
                Version: "2012-10-17"
                Statement:
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                      - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                      - cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage
                    Resource: "*"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - Fn::If:
            - IsApproveCodePipelineEnabled
            - PolicyName: marbot-approve-codepipeline
              PolicyDocument:
                Version: "2012-10-17"
                Statement:
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                      - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                      - codepipeline:ListPipelines
                      - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
                    Resource: "*"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  RegistrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: marbot-read-secret
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref ApiKeySecret
        - PolicyName: marbot-lambda-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  RegistrationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt RegistrationRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 300
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import urllib.request
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      api_key = boto3.client('secretsmanager').get_secret_value(SecretId=props['SecretArn'])['SecretString']
                      payload = {
                          'endpoint': props['EndpointID'],
                          'apiKey': api_key,
                          'account': props['AccountID'],
                          'region': props['Region'],
                          'stack': props['StackName'],
                          'externalId': props['ExternalID'],
                          'roleArn': props.get('RoleArn', '')
                      }
                      req = urllib.request.Request(
                          props['RegistrationUrl'],
                          data=json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8'),
                          method='POST',
                          headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
                      )
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                          print(resp.status)
                  event['PhysicalResourceId'] = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or ('marbot-registration-' + props.get('EndpointID', ''))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {})

  RegistrationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref RegistrationFunction
      Principal: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Ref "AWS::StackId"

  AccountRegistration:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Condition: IsMarbotAccountReal
    DependsOn:
      - ApiKeyDerivation
      - RegistrationPermission
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt RegistrationFunction.Arn
      EndpointID: !Ref MarbotEndpointID
      SecretArn: !Ref ApiKeySecret
      AccountID: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      Region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      StackName: !Ref StackName
      ExternalID: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotRole.Arn
      RegistrationUrl: !Sub "https://api.marbot.io/endpoint/${MarbotEndpointID}/register"
Outputs:
  MarbotCrossAccountRoleArn:
    Condition: IsMarbotAccountReal
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role that marbot can assume."
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotRole.Arn
  MarbotApiKeySecretArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained backend for mobile/web app with DynamoDB, Cognito, and IAM"

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "id"
          AttributeType: "N"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "id"
          KeyType: "HASH"
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 10
        WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: "id-index"
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: "id"
              KeyType: "HASH"
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: "ALL"
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 10

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: "AppIdentityPool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: "CognitoUnauthenticatedRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "UnauthenticatedPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: "mobileanalytics:SubmitEvent"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: "cognito-sync:StartSync"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: "sns:Publish"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "dynamodb:PutItem"
                  - "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
                  - "dynamodb:DeleteItem"
                  - "dynamodb:BatchWriteItem"
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Glue Data Catalog database with optional crawler and Spark ETL job for data lake catalog and transform layer.'
Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Prefix for naming resources.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name.
  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:s3:::example-source-bucket
    Description: ARN of the existing source S3 bucket. Replace with your actual bucket ARN.
  SourceBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: data/
    Description: Prefix within the source bucket for the crawler to scan.
  EnableCrawler:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Toggle to create the Glue crawler.
  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: '0 0 * * ? *'
    Description: Cron schedule for the crawler.
  EnableJob:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Toggle to create the Glue Spark ETL job.
  JobWorkerType:
    Type: String
    Default: Standard
    Description: Worker type for the Glue job.
  JobWorkerCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Number of workers for the Glue job.
  JobTimeoutMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    Description: Timeout in minutes for the Glue job.
  JobMaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Maximum concurrent runs for the Glue job.
  JobScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://example-source-bucket/scripts/etl.py
    Description: S3 path to the ETL script. Replace with your actual script location.
  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of the target S3 bucket for ETL output (optional).
  TargetBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Prefix within the target bucket for ETL output (optional).
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention days for CloudWatch log group.
Conditions:
  CreateCrawler: !Equals [!Ref EnableCrawler, 'true']
  CreateJob: !Equals [!Ref EnableJob, 'true']
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, '']]
Resources:
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_database'
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_log_group'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
  IAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
  IAMPolicyRead:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_read_policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Join
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:s3:::'
                  - !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
              - !Join
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:s3:::'
                  - !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
                  - '/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - glue:StartJobRun
              - glue:GetJob
              - glue:GetJobRun
              - glue:GetDatabase
              - glue:UpdateDatabase
            Resource: '*'
  IAMPolicyWrite:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasTargetBucket
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_write_policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Join
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:s3:::'
                  - !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref TargetBucketArn]]
              - !Join
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:s3:::'
                  - !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref TargetBucketArn]]
                  - '/*'
  IAMPolicyCloudWatch:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_cloudwatch_policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Join
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:logs:'
                  - !Ref AWS::Region
                  - ':'
                  - !Ref AWS::AccountId
                  - ':log-group:'
                  - !Ref LogGroup
              - !Join
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:logs:'
                  - !Ref AWS::Region
                  - ':'
                  - !Ref AWS::AccountId
                  - ':log-group:'
                  - !Ref LogGroup
                  - ':log-stream:*'
  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: CreateCrawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_crawler'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Join
              - ''
              - - 's3://'
                - !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
                - '/'
                - !Ref SourceBucketPrefix
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      Role: !Ref IAMRole
  GlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: CreateJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_job'
      Role: !Ref IAMRole
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref JobScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      WorkerType: !Ref JobWorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref JobWorkerCount
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeoutMinutes
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref JobMaxConcurrentRuns
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark': 'job-bookmark-on'
        '--output_path': !If
          - HasTargetBucket
          - !Join
            - ''
            - - 's3://'
              - !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref TargetBucketArn]]
              - '/'
              - !Ref TargetBucketPrefix
          - ''
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--continuous-log-logGroup': !Ref LogGroup
        '--continuous-log-logStreamPrefix': !Sub '${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_'
        '--database-name': !Ref GlueDatabase

          import json

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates a customer-managed KMS key with key rotation, alias, and optional EventBridge alerting for key deletion/disable events."

Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional parent stack name that exports an SNS topic ARN with export name '<StackName>-SnsTopicArn'. If provided, an EventBridge rule will be created to send alerts on key deletion/disable."
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: "ALL_SERVICES"
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL_SERVICES
      - S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces
    Description: "Service to scope KMS cryptographic operations. Use 'ALL_SERVICES' for no restriction, 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS' for S3 public decryption, or a specific service name."

Conditions:
  HasParentAlertStack: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, ""]]
  IsAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, "ALL_SERVICES"]
  IsS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, "S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS"]
  IsConnect: !Equals [!Ref Service, "connect"]
  IsDms: !Equals [!Ref Service, "dms"]
  IsSsm: !Equals [!Ref Service, "ssm"]
  IsEc2: !Equals [!Ref Service, "ec2"]
  IsElasticfilesystem: !Equals [!Ref Service, "elasticfilesystem"]
  IsEs: !Equals [!Ref Service, "es"]
  IsKinesis: !Equals [!Ref Service, "kinesis"]
  IsKinesisvideo: !Equals [!Ref Service, "kinesisvideo"]
  IsLambda: !Equals [!Ref Service, "lambda"]
  IsLex: !Equals [!Ref Service, "lex"]
  IsRedshift: !Equals [!Ref Service, "redshift"]
  IsRds: !Equals [!Ref Service, "rds"]
  IsSecretsmanager: !Equals [!Ref Service, "secretsmanager"]
  IsSes: !Equals [!Ref Service, "ses"]
  IsS3: !Equals [!Ref Service, "s3"]
  IsImportexport: !Equals [!Ref Service, "importexport"]
  IsSqs: !Equals [!Ref Service, "sqs"]
  IsWorkmail: !Equals [!Ref Service, "workmail"]
  IsWorkspaces: !Equals [!Ref Service, "workspaces"]

Resources:
  MyKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer-managed KMS key for ${AWS::StackName}"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "EnableRootAdminPermissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "AllowCryptographicOperationsForCaller"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Fn::If:
                - IsAllServices
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
                - StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService:
                      Fn::If:
                        - IsS3PublicAccess
                        - "s3.amazonaws.com"
                        - !If
                          - IsConnect
                          - "connect.amazonaws.com"
                          - !If
                            - IsDms
                            - "dms.amazonaws.com"
                            - !If
                              - IsSsm
                              - "ssm.amazonaws.com"
                              - !If
                                - IsEc2
                                - "ec2.amazonaws.com"
                                - !If
                                  - IsElasticfilesystem
                                  - "elasticfilesystem.amazonaws.com"
                                  - !If
                                    - IsEs
                                    - "es.amazonaws.com"
                                    - !If
                                      - IsKinesis
                                      - "kinesis.amazonaws.com"
                                      - !If
                                        - IsKinesisvideo
                                        - "kinesisvideo.amazonaws.com"
                                        - !If
                                          - IsLambda
                                          - "lambda.amazonaws.com"
                                          - !If
                                            - IsLex
                                            - "lex.amazonaws.com"
                                            - !If
                                              - IsRedshift
                                              - "redshift.amazonaws.com"
                                              - !If
                                                - IsRds
                                                - "rds.amazonaws.com"
                                                - !If
                                                  - IsSecretsmanager
                                                  - "secretsmanager.amazonaws.com"
                                                  - !If
                                                    - IsSes
                                                    - "ses.amazonaws.com"
                                                    - !If
                                                      - IsS3
                                                      - "s3.amazonaws.com"
                                                      - !If
                                                        - IsImportexport
                                                        - "importexport.amazonaws.com"
                                                        - !If
                                                          - IsSqs
                                                          - "sqs.amazonaws.com"
                                                          - !If
                                                            - IsWorkmail
                                                            - "workmail.amazonaws.com"
                                                            - !If
                                                              - IsWorkspaces
                                                              - "workspaces.amazonaws.com"
                                                              - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  MyKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MyKey

  KmsAlertRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasParentAlertStack
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Monitors KMS key ${MyKey} for ScheduleKeyDeletion and DisableKey events"
      State: "ENABLED"
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - "aws.kms"
        detail-type:
          - "AWS API Call via CloudTrail"
        detail:
          eventName:
            - "ScheduleKeyDeletion"
            - "DisableKey"
          requestParameters:
            keyId:
              - !Ref MyKey
      Targets:
        - Arn:
            Fn::ImportValue: !Sub "${ParentAlertStack}-SnsTopicArn"
          Id: "KmsAlertTarget"

Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: "KMS Key ID"
    Value: !Ref MyKey
  KeyArn:
    Description: "KMS Key ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt MyKey.Arn

Description: "CloudFormation template to create a DLM lifecycle policy and IAM role for automated EBS snapshot management."

Parameters:
  DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
    Type: String
    Default: "17:00"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-1][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$"

  SnapshotInterval:
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    AllowedValues: [2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24]
    MinValue: 1
  SnapshotRetainRule:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1

    Type: String
    Default: "WebServers"
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: "production"
    AllowedValues: ["production", "test", "development"]
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "createdby"
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "aws-cloudformation-templates"

Resources:
  DLMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DLMExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: LogicalName
          Value: !Ref LogicalName
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue

        TargetTags:

          - Key: !Ref TagKey

        Schedules:

        - Key: !Ref TagKey

      Content: !Sub |
        {
          "schemaVersion": "0.3",
          "description": "Enforce S3 Block Public Access at account level",
          "assumeRole": "${SSMExecutionRole.Arn}",
          "mainSteps": [
            {
              "name": "BlockPublicAccess",
              "action": "aws:executeAwsApi",
              "inputs": {
                "Service": "s3control",
                "Api": "PutPublicAccessBlock",
                "AccountId": "${AWS::AccountId}",
                "PublicAccessBlockConfiguration": {
                  "BlockPublicAcls": true,
                  "BlockPublicPolicy": true,
                  "IgnorePublicAcls": true,
                  "RestrictPublicBuckets": true
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }
  SSMExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SSMExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3BlockPublicAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'
  StartAutomationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: StartAutomationLambdaRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${S3PublicAccessBlockDocument}'
        - PolicyName: LambdaLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/StartAutomationFunction:*'
  StartAutomationFunction:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Cognito authentication layer for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway using OAuth2 client credentials flow."

Parameters:
  RequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Whether the password policy requires symbols."

Conditions:
  RequireSymbolsCondition:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref RequireSymbols
      - "true"

Resources:
  # Extract stack name from StackId for domain prefix
  StackNameFragment:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Value: !Select
        - 1
        - !Split
          - "/"
          - !Select
            - 5
            - !Split
              - ":"
              - !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      Name: !Sub "/protein-agent/cognito/stack-name-fragment"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # 1. User Pool
  UserPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPool"
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: "agentcore-gateway-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - "email"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - "email"
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If [RequireSymbolsCondition, true, false]
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # 2. Hosted Domain
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain"
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub
        - "${Region}-${StackName}"
        - Region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
          StackName: !Select
            - 1
            - !Split
              - "/"
              - !Select
                - 5
                - !Split
                  - ":"
                  - !Ref "AWS::StackId"
    DependsOn: UserPool

  # 3. Resource Server
  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer"
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: "agentcore-gateway"
      Name: "AgentCore Gateway"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: "read"
          ScopeDescription: "Read access"
        - ScopeName: "write"
          ScopeDescription: "Write access"
        - ScopeName: "admin"
          ScopeDescription: "Admin access"

  # 4. App Client (confidential)
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    Properties:
      ClientName: "agentcore-gateway-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - "client_credentials"
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - "agentcore-gateway/read"
        - "agentcore-gateway/write"
        - "agentcore-gateway/admin"
      ExplicitAuthFlows: []
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer

  # 5. IAM Role for Lambda
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "secretsmanager:CreateSecret"
                  - "secretsmanager:UpdateSecret"
                  - "secretsmanager:DeleteSecret"
                  - "secretsmanager:DescribeSecret"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"

  # 6. Lambda Function
  ClientSecretLambda:
    Type: "AWS::Lambda::Function"
    Properties:
      Runtime: "python3.12"
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              client_id = props['ClientId']
              user_pool_id = props['UserPoolId']
              secret_name = "protein-engineering/cognito/client-secret"

              cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              secrets = boto3.client('secretsmanager')

              try:
                  if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      # Describe user pool client to get secret
                      response = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          ClientId=client_id
                      )
                      client_secret = response['UserPoolClient']['ClientSecret']

                      secret_value = {
                          'clientId': client_id,
                          'clientSecret': client_secret,
                          'userPoolId': user_pool_id
                      }

                      # Check if secret already exists
                      try:
                          secrets.describe_secret(SecretId=secret_name)
                          # Update existing secret
                          secrets.put_secret_value(
                              SecretId=secret_name,
                              SecretString=json.dumps(secret_value)
                          )
                      except secrets.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          # Create new secret
                          secrets.create_secret(
                              Name=secret_name,
                              SecretString=json.dumps(secret_value)
                          )

                      # Physical resource ID = secret name
                      physical_id = secret_name
                      response_data = {
                          'SecretName': secret_name,
                          'SecretArn': secrets.describe_secret(SecretId=secret_name)['ARN']
                      }
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data, physical_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      # Force delete the secret
                      try:
                          secrets.delete_secret(
                              SecretId=secret_name,
                              ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True
                          )
                      except secrets.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          pass
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})

              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  # 7. Custom Resource to invoke Lambda
  ClientSecretCustomResource:
    Type: "AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource"
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ClientSecretLambda.Arn
      ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
    DependsOn:
      - UserPool
      - UserPoolClient
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  # 8. SSM Parameters
  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/discovery-url"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
    DependsOn: UserPool

  SSMClientId:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/client-id"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolClient

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
    DependsOn: UserPool

  SSMUserPoolArn:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    DependsOn: UserPool

  SSMDomainUrl:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/domain-url"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  ClientId:
    Description: "Cognito App Client ID"
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: "OIDC Discovery URL"
    Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"

  DomainUrl:
    Description: "Hosted Domain URL"
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"

  TokenEndpointUrl:
    Description: "OAuth2 Token Endpoint URL"
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"

  ScopeList:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of custom OAuth2 scopes"
    Value: "agentcore-gateway/read,agentcore-gateway/write,agentcore-gateway/admin"

  ParameterNames:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of SSM parameter names"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - "/protein-agent/cognito/discovery-url"
        - "/protein-agent/cognito/client-id"
        - "/protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id"
        - "/protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn"
        - "/protein-agent/cognito/domain-url"

  SecretName:
    Description: "Name of the Secrets Manager secret containing client credentials"
    Value: "protein-engineering/cognito/client-secret"

Conditions:

  HasExtra3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute3Name, '']]
  HasGSI1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1IndexName, '']]
  HasGSI1SortKey: !And [!Condition HasGSI1, !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1SortKeyName, '']]]
  HasGSI2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2IndexName, '']]
  HasGSI2SortKey: !And [!Condition HasGSI2, !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2SortKeyName, '']]]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TimeToLiveAttribute, '']]
  HasStreams: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, '']]

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [IsTableNameProvided, !Ref TableName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasExtra1
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasExtra2
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasExtra3
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI1SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityMax
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityMax
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI1IndexName
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI1SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI2IndexName
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI2SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If

        - AttributeName: !Ref TimeToLiveAttribute
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - HasStreams
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - IsPITREnabled
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      SSESpecification: !If
        - IsSSEEnabled

        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy

        Resources:
