AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "DynamoDB tables and Application Auto Scaling for account-vending automation tool"

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"
    Description: "Stage name appended to all table names (e.g., dev, prod)"
    Default: "dev"

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Application Auto Scaling
  AutoScalingDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - application-autoscaling:DescribeScalableTargets
                  - application-autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
                  - application-autoscaling:RegisterScalableTarget
                  - application-autoscaling:DeregisterScalableTarget
                  - application-autoscaling:PutScalingPolicy
                  - application-autoscaling:DeleteScalingPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/talr-taskStatus-${Stage}"

  # DynamoDB Tables
  TalrCbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-cbInfo-${Stage}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrAccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-accountInfo-${Stage}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrTaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-taskStatus-${Stage}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrNipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrOpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-ops-${Stage}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrDxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-dxInterface-${Stage}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-claStatus-${Stage}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  # Application Auto Scaling for talr-accountInfo table
  AccountInfoReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingDynamoDBRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingDynamoDBRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "accountInfo-read-scaling-${Stage}"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  AccountInfoWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "accountInfo-write-scaling-${Stage}"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  # Application Auto Scaling for talr-accountInfo GSI gsiRequestId
  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiRequestId"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingDynamoDBRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiRequestId"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingDynamoDBRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "accountInfo-gsiRequestId-read-scaling-${Stage}"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling

      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "accountInfo-gsiRequestId-write-scaling-${Stage}"

      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0

        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

  # Application Auto Scaling for talr-accountInfo GSI gsiAccountId
  AccountInfoGsiAccountIdReadScalableTarget:

      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingDynamoDBRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "accountInfo-gsiAccountId-read-scaling-${Stage}"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling

      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling

      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60

        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  # Application Auto Scaling for talr-taskStatus table
  TaskStatusReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/talr-taskStatus-${Stage}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingDynamoDBRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Secure and highly available network foundation for a containerised Streamlit application

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - "0"
        - Fn::GetAZs:
            Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitPublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - "1"
        - Fn::GetAZs:
            Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitPublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - "0"
        - Fn::GetAZs:
            Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitPrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - "1"
        - Fn::GetAZs:
            Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitPrivateSubnet2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitPublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitNatGateway1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitNatGateway2

    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitPrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitPrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:

        Version: "2012-10-17"

                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${VpcFlowLogsLogGroup}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${VpcFlowLogsLogGroup}:log-stream:*"

  VpcFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:

      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsRole.Arn

      ClusterName: StreamlitCluster
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second public subnet

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless AI Campaign Orchestration Platform'
Parameters:
  SenderEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder@example.com
    Description: Email address for campaign failure alerts and sender identity
  SenderPhone:
    Type: String
    Default: +1234567890
    Description: Phone number for SMS sender identity (placeholder)
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable OpenSearch Serverless vector collection for semantic search
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-v2
    Description: Amazon Bedrock model ID for generative steps
Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']
Resources:
  # KMS Key and Alias
  CampaignKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for campaign data encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
  CampaignKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/campaign-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignKey

  # DynamoDB Tables
  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: CustomerProfiles
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKey
  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: ChannelRateLimits
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: channel
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: channel
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKey
  MessageDeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: MessageDeliveryTracking
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKey

  # S3 Bucket for Campaign Assets
  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub campaign-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref CampaignKey
  CampaignAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRequiredRolesReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::campaign-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
              - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::campaign-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*

  # Cognito User Pool and Client
  CampaignUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: CampaignUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
  CampaignUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: CampaignAPIClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref CampaignUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # HTTP API Gateway
  CampaignHTTPApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: CampaignHTTPApi
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins:
          - '*'
        AllowMethods:
          - GET
          - POST
          - PUT
          - DELETE
          - OPTIONS
        AllowHeaders:
          - '*'
        AllowCredentials: false
  CampaignHTTPApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHTTPApi
      StageName: prod
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '$context.requestId $context.identity.sourceIp $context.requestTime $context.httpMethod $context.routeKey $context.status $context.protocol $context.responseLength'
  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/api-gateway/campaign-http-api
      RetentionInDays: 14
  # Cognito Authorizer for API
  CampaignApiAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHTTPApi
      AuthorizerType: JWT
      IdentitySource:
        - $request.header.Authorization
      JwtConfiguration:
        Audience:
          - !Ref CampaignUserPoolClient
        Issuer: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CampaignUserPool}
      Name: CampaignCognitoAuthorizer

  # Routes and Integrations
  CampaignLauncherIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHTTPApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt CampaignLauncherFunction.Arn
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
  CampaignLauncherRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:

      Environment:
        Variables:
          KMS_KEY_ARN: !Ref CampaignKey
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Sub arn:aws:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:CampaignOrchestrator
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              sm = boto3.client('stepfunctions')
              body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
              response = sm.start_execution(
                  stateMachineArn=os.environ['STATE_MACHINE_ARN'],
                  input=json.dumps(body)
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'executionArn': response['executionArn']})

          import json, boto3, os

              table = dd.Table(os.environ['TRACKING_TABLE'])
              campaign_id = event.get('pathParameters', {}).get('campaignId')
              response = table.get_item(Key={'messageId': campaign_id})
              item = response.get('Item', {})

      Environment:
        Variables:

          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTrackingTable
          SHARED_SECRET_ARN: !Ref DeliveryCallbackSecret
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os, hmac, hashlib
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              secret_arn = os.environ['SHARED_SECRET_ARN']
              sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
              secret = json.loads(sm.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)['SecretString'])
              expected = secret['sharedSecret']
              headers = event.get('headers', {})
              provided = headers.get('X-Shared-Secret', '')
              if provided != expected:
                  return {'statusCode': 403, 'body': 'Forbidden'}
              body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
              dd = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
              table = dd.Table(os.environ['TRACKING_TABLE'])
              table.put_item(Item=body)
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'OK'}

  # Step Functions State Machine
  CampaignOrchestratorStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: CampaignOrchestrator
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Campaign Orchestration Pipeline",
          "StartAt": "ParseInstruction",
          "States": {
            "ParseInstruction": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:ParseInstruction",
              "ResultPath": "$.parsed",
              "Next": "SegmentCustomers"
            },
            "SegmentCustomers": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:SegmentCustomers",
              "ResultPath": "$.segments",
              "Next": "PredictChannel"
            },
            "PredictChannel": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:PredictChannel",
              "ResultPath": "$.channels",
              "Next": "SafetyCheck"
            },
            "SafetyCheck": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:SafetyCheck",
              "ResultPath": "$.safeContent",
              "Next": "AdaptContent"
            },
            "AdaptContent": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:AdaptContent",
              "ResultPath": "$.adapted",
              "Next": "DeliverMessages"
            },
            "DeliverMessages": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:DeliverMessages",
              "ResultPath": "$.deliveryStatus",
              "Next": "RecordResults"
            },
            "RecordResults": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:RecordResults",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless URL Shortener: DynamoDB-backed with API Gateway and Lambda'

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
  FunctionNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Prefix for Lambda function names
  Runtime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.12
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.12
      - python3.11
      - python3.10
    Description: Python runtime for Lambda functions
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service tag value
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: team
    Description: Owner tag value
  ApplicationUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com
    Description: Base URL for shortened links (no trailing slash)

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Table
  ShortenerTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: shortId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: shortId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # IAM Role for Lambda
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ShortenerTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # Create Lambda Function
  CreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-create'
      Runtime: !Ref Runtime
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import secrets
          import string
          import boto3
          import os

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          base_url = os.environ['APPLICATION_URL']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  long_url = body['url']
              except (KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Invalid request body'})
                  }

              # Generate short identifier 12-16 characters (lowercase letters and digits)
              length = secrets.randbelow(5) + 12  # 12 to 16
              alphabet = string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits
              short_id = ''.join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(length))

              # Store in DynamoDB
              table.put_item(Item={'shortId': short_id, 'longUrl': long_url})

              short_url = f"{base_url}/{short_id}"
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': json.dumps({'shortUrl': short_url, 'shortId': short_id})
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
          APPLICATION_URL: !Ref ApplicationUrl
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # Retrieve Lambda Function
  RetrieveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve'
      Runtime: !Ref Runtime
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def handler(event, context):
              short_id = event['pathParameters']['shortId']
              response = table.get_item(Key={'shortId': short_id})
              item = response.get('Item')
              if not item:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 404,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Short URL not found'})
                  }
              long_url = item['longUrl']
              return {
                  'statusCode': 302,
                  'headers': {
                      'Location': long_url,
                      'Content-Type': 'text/plain'
                  },
                  'body': ''
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # API Gateway REST API
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: URL Shortener API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # API Gateway Resources
  CreateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: create

  AdminResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: admin

  ShortIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: '{shortId}'

  # API Gateway Methods
  CreateMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref CreateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
        - StatusCode: 400

  RetrieveMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ShortIdResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${RetrieveFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 302
        - StatusCode: 404

  # Lambda Permissions for API Gateway
  CreateFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/POST/create'

  RetrieveFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref RetrieveFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/{shortId}'

  # API Gateway CloudWatch Logging Role and Account Settings
  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  # API Gateway Deployment and Stage
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMethod
      - RetrieveMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: test
      Description: Deployment to test stage
      StageDescription:
        Tags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: Service
            Value: !Ref Service
          - Key: Owner
            Value: !Ref Owner

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: Base URL for the API (test stage)
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test'
  CreateEndpoint:
    Description: POST endpoint to create short URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test/create'
  RetrieveExample:
    Description: GET endpoint to retrieve original URL (replace {shortId})
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test/{shortId}'
  TableNameOutput:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref TableName
  CreateFunctionName:
    Description: Create Lambda function name
    Value: !Ref CreateFunction
  RetrieveFunctionName:
    Description: Retrieve Lambda function name
    Value: !Ref RetrieveFunction

                  "Type": "Parallel",
                  "Next": "Success",
                  "Branches": [
                    {
                      "StartAt": "ImmediateNotification",
                      "States": {

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Simple Todo GraphQL API with AppSync and DynamoDB using JavaScript resolvers'

Resources:
  # DynamoDB table with GSI on owner
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: TodoTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # IAM role for AppSync to access DynamoDB
  AppSyncRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*"

  # AppSync GraphQL API
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SimpleTodoAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  # API Key for testing
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId

  # Inline GraphQL schema
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean!
          owner: String!
          createdAt: AWSDateTime!
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
        }
        input CreateTodoInput {
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
          owner: String!
        }
        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          title: String
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
          owner: String
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos: [Todo]
          listTodosByOwner(owner: String!): [Todo]
        }
        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  # DynamoDB data source
  DataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # Resolver for createTodo mutation
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { title, description, completed, owner } = ctx.args.input;
          const id = util.autoId();
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const item = {
            id: id,
            title: title,
            description: description || null,
            completed: completed !== undefined ? completed : false,
            owner: owner,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(item)
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # Resolver for updateTodo mutation
  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { id, ...fields } = ctx.args.input;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const updates = { updatedAt: now };
          if (fields.title !== undefined) updates.title = fields.title;
          if (fields.description !== undefined) updates.description = fields.description;
          if (fields.completed !== undefined) updates.completed = fields.completed;
          if (fields.owner !== undefined) updates.owner = fields.owner;
          const expressionParts = [];
          const expressionNames = {};
          const expressionValues = {};
          for (const key in updates) {
            expressionParts.push(`#${key} = :${key}`);
            expressionNames[`#${key}`] = key;
            expressionValues[`:${key}`] = util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB(updates[key]);
          }
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id }),
            update: {
              expression: `SET ${expressionParts.join(', ')}`,
              expressionNames,
              expressionValues
            },
            returnValues: 'ALL_NEW'
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # Resolver for deleteTodo mutation
  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id }),
            returnValues: 'ALL_OLD'
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # Resolver for getTodo query
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'GetItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id })
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # Resolver for listTodos query
  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'Scan',
            limit: 100
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

  # Resolver for listTodosByOwner query
  ListTodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodosByOwner
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'Query',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':owner': ctx.args.owner })
            },
            index: 'owner-index',
            limit: 100
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

Outputs:

    Description: URL of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  ApiKeyId:
    Description: ID of the generated API key
    Value: !Ref ApiKey
  ApiKeyValue:
    Description: Value of the generated API key for testing
    Value: !GetAtt ApiKey.ApiKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Encryption-at-rest foundation for the Restaurant Assistant application: customer-managed KMS key with rotation, KMS-encrypted DynamoDB tables, and KMS-encrypted S3 buckets with access logging."

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: restaurant-assistant
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: "ProjectName must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens."
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    ConstraintDescription: "Environment must be one of: dev, staging, prod."

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment} customer-managed KMS key"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-kms-key-policy"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "EnableRootAccountAdministration"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "AllowDynamoDbToUseTheKey"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext"
              - "kms:ReEncryptFrom"
              - "kms:ReEncryptTo"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "kms:ViaService": !Sub "dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
          - Sid: "AllowDynamoDbToCreateGrants"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "kms:CreateGrant"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "kms:CallerAccount": !Ref AWS::AccountId
                "kms:ViaService": !Sub "dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
              Bool:
                "kms:GrantIsForAWSResource": "true"
          - Sid: "AllowS3ToUseTheKey"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "s3.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:ReEncryptFrom"
              - "kms:ReEncryptTo"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "kms:ViaService": !Sub "s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
          - Sid: "AllowS3LogDeliveryToUseTheKey"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - "logging.s3.amazonaws.com"
                - "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Project"
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: !Ref Environment

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  SessionsTable:

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:

      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: data_type
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: data_type

        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

        SSEType: KMS

        - Key: "Project"

        - Key: "Environment"

    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-market-prices"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: market_name
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: last_updated_time
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: market_name
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: IngredientLastUpdatedIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ingredient
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: last_updated_time
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      Tags:
        - Key: "Project"
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RemindersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reminders"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: reminder_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: reminder_id
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      Tags:
        - Key: "Project"
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rate-limits"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: rate_limit_id

        - AttributeName: rate_limit_id

        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      Tags:
        - Key: "Project"
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: "Project"
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "AllowS3LogDelivery"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

                - "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "s3:PutObject"
            Resource:
              Fn::Sub:
                - "${BucketArn}/*"
                - BucketArn: !GetAtt LogBucket.Arn
            Condition:

          - Sid: "DenyIncorrectEncryptionHeader"

          import json
          import logging
          from urllib.error import URLError
          from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          secretsmanager = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def send_response(event, context, status, data, physical_resource_id, reason=None, no_echo=False):
              response_body = {
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or "See CloudWatch Logs",
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_resource_id,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "NoEcho": no_echo,
                  "Data": data,
              }
              body = json.dumps(response_body).encode("utf-8")
              headers = {"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))}
              request = Request(event["ResponseURL"], data=body, headers=headers, method="PUT")
              with urlopen(request) as response:
                  logger.info("CFN response status: %s", response.status)


          def get_password(secret_id):
              response = secretsmanager.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_id)
              secret_string = response["SecretString"]
              try:
                  parsed = json.loads(secret_string)
                  if isinstance(parsed, dict) and "password" in parsed:
                      return parsed["password"]
              except (TypeError, ValueError):
                  pass
              return secret_string


          def create_or_update_user(pool_id, username, email, password):
              try:
                  cognito.admin_create_user(
                      UserPoolId=pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {"Name": "email", "Value": email},
                          {"Name": "email_verified", "Value": "true"},
                      ],
                      MessageAction="SUPPRESS",
                      TemporaryPassword=password,
                  )
              except cognito.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                  logger.info("User already exists: %s", username)
              cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                  UserPoolId=pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  Password=password,
                  Permanent=True,
              )
              logger.info("Set permanent password for %s", username)


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              pool_id = props["UserPoolId"]
              username = props["Username"]
              email = props["Email"]
              secret_id = props["SecretId"]
              physical_resource_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or f"{pool_id}:{username}:password"
              data = {}

              try:
                  request_type = event["RequestType"]
                  if request_type in ("Create", "Update"):
                      password = get_password(secret_id)
                      create_or_update_user(pool_id, username, email, password)
                      data["Username"] = username
                  elif request_type == "Delete":
                      logger.info("User lifecycle is handled by AWS::Cognito::UserPoolUser; skipping delete")
                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", data, physical_resource_id)
              except Exception as error:
                  logger.exception("Custom resource failed")
                  send_response(
                      event,
                      context,
                      "FAILED",
                      {"Error": str(error)},
                      physical_resource_id,
                      reason=str(error),
                  )
